185.s: a̱rdhamṛ̱cairu̱kthānā̍m̐ rū̱paṃ pa̱dairāpno̍ti ni̱vida̍ḥ pra̱ṇa̱vaiḥ śa̱strāṇā̍m̐ rū̱paṃ paya̍sā̱ soma̍ āpyate
185.d: अ̱र्धमृ̱चैरु̱क्थाना̍म्̐ रू̱पं प̱दैराप्नो̍ति नि̱विद̍ः प्र̱ण̱वैः श̱स्त्राणा̍म्̐ रू̱पं पय̍सा̱ सोम̍ आप्यते
185.m: Half of the ukthas is reached by the verses; one reaches the nivids by the quarter-verses; / The form of the śastras by the praṇavas; Soma is reached by milk.

185.s: a̱śvibhyā̍ṃ prā̱taḥsa̱vana̱mindre̱ṇaindra̱ṃ mādhya̍ṃdinam vaiśva̱devam̐ sara̍svatyā tṛ̱tīya̍māptam̐ sava̍nam
185.d: अ̱श्विभ्या̍ं प्रा̱तःस̱वन̱मिन्द्रे̱णैन्द्र̱ं माध्य̍ंदिनम् वैश्व̱देवम्̐ सर̍स्वत्या तृ̱तीय̍माप्तम्̐ सव̍नम्
185.m: The morning pressing is reached with the Aśvins, the midday [pressing] dedicated to Indra with Indra; / The third pressing, dedicated to the All-Gods, is reached with Sarasvatī.

185.s: vā̱ya̱vyai̍rvāya̱vyā̍nyāpno̍ti̱ satai̍na droṇakala̱śam ku̱mbhībhyā̍mambhṛ̱ṇau su̱te sthā̱lībhi̍ḥ sthā̱līrāpno̍ti
185.d: वा̱य̱व्यै̍र्वाय̱व्या̍न्याप्नो̍ति̱ सतै̍न द्रोणकल̱शम् कु̱म्भीभ्या̍मम्भृ̱णौ सु̱ते स्था̱लीभि̍ः स्था̱लीराप्नो̍ति
185.m: One reaches the Vāyu cups with the Vāyu cups, the wooden vat with the satra cup; / The two ambrṛṇa tubs with the two jars, one reaches the platters with the platters at the pressing.

185.s: yaju̍bhirāpyante̱ grahā̱ grahai̍ sto̱mā̍śca vi̱ṣṭutī̍ḥ chando̍bhiru̱kthāśa̱strāṇi̱ sāmnā̍vabhṛ̱tha ā̍pyate
185.d: यजु̍भिराप्यन्ते̱ ग्रहा̱ ग्रहै̍ स्तो̱मा̍श्च वि̱ष्टुती̍ः छन्दो̍भिरु̱क्थाश̱स्त्राणि̱ साम्ना̍वभृ̱थ आ̍प्यते
185.m: The cups are reached by the yajus formulas, the stomas and viṣṭutis by the cups; / The ukthas and śastras by metres; the final bath is reached by the sāman.

185.s: iḷā̍bhirmṛ̱kṣānapno̍ti sūktavā̱kenā̱śiṣa̍ḥ śa̱ṃyunā̱ patnī̍saṃyā̱jānsami̍ṣṭaya̱juṣā̍ sam̐sthā̱m
185.d: इऌआ̍भिर्मृ̱क्षानप्नो̍ति सूक्तवा̱केना̱शिष̍ः श̱ंयुना̱ पत्नी̍संया̱जान्समि̍ष्टय̱जुषा̍ सम्̐स्था̱म्
185.m: One reaches the portions of food by the iḷās, the blessings by the sūktavāka; / The patnīsaṃyājas by the śaṃyu, the completion [of the sacrifice] by the samiṣṭayajus.

185.s: vra̱tena̍ dī̱kṣāmāpno̍ti dī̱kṣayā̍pnoti̱ dakṣi̍ṇām dakṣi̍ṇā śra̱ddhāmāpno̍ti śra̱ddhayā̍ sa̱tyamā̍pyate
185.d: व्र̱तेन̍ दी̱क्षामाप्नो̍ति दी̱क्षया̍प्नोति̱ दक्षि̍णाम् दक्षि̍णा श्र̱द्धामाप्नो̍ति श्र̱द्धया̍ स̱त्यमा̍प्यते
185.m: By the vow one reaches consecration, by consecration one reaches the sacrificial gift; / By the sacrificial gift one reaches faith, by faith truth is reached.

185.s: e̱tāva̍drū̱paṃ ya̱jñasya̱ yadde̱vairbrahma̍ṇā kṛ̱tam | tade̱tatsarva̍māpnoti ya̱jñe sau̍trāma̱ṇau su̱te
185.d: ए̱ताव̍द्रू̱पं य̱ज्ञस्य̱ यद्दे̱वैर्ब्रह्म̍णा कृ̱तम् । तदे̱तत्सर्व̍माप्नोति य̱ज्ञे सौ̍त्राम̱णौ सु̱ते
185.m: This much is the form of the sacrifice, which was made by the gods and by Brahman; / One reaches all of it in the Sautrāmaṇī sacrifice when it is pressed.

186.s: (2) su̱rāva̍ntaṃ ba̱rhiṣada̍m̐ suvī̱raṃ ya̱jñam̐ hi̍nvanti mahi̱ṣā namo̍bhiḥ dadhā̍nā̱ḥ soma̍ṃ di̱vi de̱vatā̍su̱ made̍mendra̱ṃ yaja̍mānāḥ sva̱rkāḥ
186.d: (2) सु̱राव̍न्तं ब̱र्हिषद̍म्̐ सुवी̱रं य̱ज्ञम्̐ हि̍न्वन्ति महि̱षा नमो̍भिः दधा̍ना̱ः सोम̍ं दि̱वि दे̱वता̍सु̱ मदे̍मेन्द्र̱ं यज̍मानाः स्व̱र्काः
186.m: The mighty ones impel with homages the sacrifice accompanied by surā, seated on the sacred grass, rich in heroes, / Placing Soma in heaven among the deities; the sacrificers, singing sweet hymns, revel with Indra.

186.s: yaste̱ rasa̍ḥ sa̱ṃbhṛta̱ oṣa̍dhīṣu so̱masya̍ śu̱ṣmaḥ su̱rayā̍ su̱tasya̍ tena̍ jinva̱ yaja̍māna̱ṃ made̍na̱ sara̍svatīma̱śvinā̱ indra̍ma̱gnim
186.d: यस्ते̱ रस̍ः स̱ंभृत̱ ओष̍धीषु सो̱मस्य̍ शु̱ष्मः सु̱रया̍ सु̱तस्य̍ तेन̍ जिन्व̱ यज̍मान̱ं मदे̍न̱ सर̍स्वतीम̱श्विना̱ इन्द्र̍म̱ग्निम्
186.m: That sap of yours gathered in the plants, that vigor of Soma pressed with surā, / With that exhilarating draught invigorate the sacrificer, Sarasvatī, the Aśvins, Indra, and Agni.

186.s: yama̱śvinā̱ namu̍cerāsu̱rādadhi̱ sara̍svatyasu̍nodindri̱yāya̍ i̱maṃ tam̐ śu̱kraṃ madhu̍manta̱mindum̐ soma̱ṃ rājā̍nami̱ha bha̍kṣayāmi
186.d: यम̱श्विना̱ नमु̍चेरासु̱रादधि̱ सर̍स्वत्यसु̍नोदिन्द्रि̱याय̍ इ̱मं तम्̐ शु̱क्रं मधु̍मन्त̱मिन्दुम्̐ सोम̱ं राजा̍नमि̱ह भ̍क्षयामि
186.m: Which the Aśvins and Sarasvatī pressed out from the asura Namuci for sensory power, / That bright, sweet drop, King Soma, I consume here.

186.s: yadtra̍ ri̱ptam̐ ra̱sina̍ḥ su̱tasya̱ yadindro̍ api̍ba̱cchacī̍bhiḥ a̱haṃ tada̍sya̱ mana̍sā śi̱vena̱ soma̱ṃ rājā̍nami̱ha bha̍kṣayāmi
186.d: यद्त्र̍ रि̱प्तम्̐ र̱सिन̍ः सु̱तस्य̱ यदिन्द्रो̍ अपि̍ब̱च्छची̍भिः अ̱हं तद̍स्य̱ मन̍सा शि̱वेन̱ सोम̱ं राजा̍नमि̱ह भ̍क्षयामि
186.m: What was smeared here of the savory pressed [draught], what Indra drank by his powers, / That of his, King Soma, with a gracious mind I consume here.

186.s: pi̱tṛbhya̍ḥ sva̱dhāyibhya̍ḥ sva̱dhā nama̍ḥ pitāma̱hebhya̍ḥ sva̱dhāyibhya̍ḥ sva̱dhā nama̍ḥ prapi̍tāmahebhyaḥ sva̱dhāyibhya̍ḥ sva̱dhā nama̍ḥ
186.d: पि̱तृभ्य̍ः स्व̱धायिभ्य̍ः स्व̱धा नम̍ः पिताम̱हेभ्य̍ः स्व̱धायिभ्य̍ः स्व̱धा नम̍ः प्रपि̍तामहेभ्यः स्व̱धायिभ्य̍ः स्व̱धा नम̍ः
186.m: To the fathers entitled to svadhā, svadhā, homage! To the grandfathers entitled to svadhā, svadhā, homage! / To the great-grandfathers entitled to svadhā, svadhā, homage!

186.s: akṣa̍n pi̱taro'mī̍madanta pi̱taro'tī̍tṛpanta pi̱tara̍ḥ | pi̱tara̍ḥ śundha̍dhvam
186.d: अक्ष̍न् पि̱तरोऽमी̍मदन्त पि̱तरोऽती̍तृपन्त पि̱तर̍ः । पि̱तर̍ः शुन्ध̍ध्वम्
186.m: The fathers have eaten, the fathers have rejoiced, the fathers have been satisfied; fathers, cleanse yourselves!

186.s: puna̍ntu mā pi̱tara̍ḥ so̱myāsa̍ḥ puna̍ntu mā pitāma̱hāḥ puna̍ntu prapi̍tāmahāḥ pa̱vitre̍ṇa śa̱tāyu̍ṣā
186.d: पुन̍न्तु मा पि̱तर̍ः सो̱म्यास̍ः पुन̍न्तु मा पिताम̱हाः पुन̍न्तु प्रपि̍तामहाः प̱वित्रे̍ण श̱तायु̍षा
186.m: May the Soma-loving fathers purify me; may the grandfathers purify me; may the great-grandfathers purify me / With a strainer of a hundred lifespans!

186.s: puna̍ntu mā pitāma̱hāḥ puna̍ntu prapi̍tāmahāḥ | pa̱vitre̍ṇa śa̱tāyu̍ṣā viśva̱māyu̱rvya̍śnavai
186.d: पुन̍न्तु मा पिताम̱हाः पुन̍न्तु प्रपि̍तामहाः । प̱वित्रे̍ण श̱तायु̍षा विश्व̱मायु̱र्व्य̍श्नवै
186.m: May the grandfathers purify me; may the great-grandfathers purify me; / With a strainer of a hundred lifespans may I attain a complete lifespan!

186.s: agna̱ āyū̍m̐ṣi pavasa̱ ā suvorja̱miṣa̍ṃ ca naḥ | āre bā̍dhasva ducchunā̍m
186.d: अग्न̱ आयू̍म्̐षि पवस̱ आ सुवोर्ज̱मिष̍ं च नः । आरे बा̍धस्व दुच्छुना̍म्
186.m: O Agni, you purify lifespans; impel vigorous food and refreshment to us; / Drive misfortune far away!

186.s: punantu̍ mā devaja̱nāḥ punantu̱ mana̍sā dhiya̍ḥ | punantu̱ viśvā̍ bhū̱tāni̍ jā̱tave̍daḥ punīhi mā̍
186.d: पुनन्तु̍ मा देवज̱नाः पुनन्तु̱ मन̍सा धिय̍ः । पुनन्तु̱ विश्वा̍ भू̱तानि̍ जा̱तवे̍दः पुनीहि मा̍
186.m: May the divine folk purify me; may insights purify me through mind; / May all creatures purify me; O Jātavedas, purify me!

186.s: pa̱vitre̍ṇa punīhi mā śu̱kreṇa̍ deva̱ dīdya̍t | agne̱ kratvā̱ kratū̱ṃranu̍
186.d: प̱वित्रे̍ण पुनीहि मा शु̱क्रेण̍ देव̱ दीद्य̍त् । अग्ने̱ क्रत्वा̱ क्रतू̱ंरनु̍
186.m: Purify me with the strainer, gleaming bright, O god, / O Agni, according to your purpose, along with my purposes!

186.s: yatte̍ pa̱vitra̍ma̱rciṣyagne̱ vita̍tamanta̱rā | brahma̱ tena̍ punātu mā
186.d: यत्ते̍ प̱वित्र̍म̱र्चिष्यग्ने̱ वित̍तमन्त̱रा । ब्रह्म̱ तेन̍ पुनातु मा
186.m: That strainer of yours, O Agni, which is stretched across in the flame, / With that sacred formulation may it purify me!

186.s: pava̍māna̱ḥ so a̱dya na̍ḥ pa̱vitre̍ṇa vicarṣa̱ṇiḥ | yaḥ potā̱ sa pu̍nātu mā
186.d: पव̍मान̱ः सो अ̱द्य न̍ः प̱वित्रे̍ण विचर्ष̱णिः । यः पोता̱ स पु̍नातु मा
186.m: May Pavamāna, he who is widely active today, purify us with the strainer; / He who is the purifier, may he purify me!

186.s: u̱bhābhyā̍ṃ deva savitaḥ pa̱vitre̍ṇa sa̱vena̍ ca | māṃ pu̍nīhi vi̱śvata̍ḥ
186.d: उ̱भाभ्या̍ं देव सवितः प̱वित्रे̍ण स̱वेन̍ च । मां पु̍नीहि वि̱श्वत̍ः
186.m: With both, O divine Savitṛ, with the strainer and with the impulse, / Purify me all around!

186.s: vai̱śva̱de̱vī puna̍tī de̱vyāgā̱dyasyai̍mi̱mā ba̱hvya̍sta̱nvo̍ vītapṛ̍ṣṭhāḥ tayā̱ mada̍ntaḥ sadha̱māde̍ṣu va̱yam̐ syā̍ma̱ pata̍yo rayī̱ṇām
186.d: वै̱श्व̱दे̱वी पुन̍ती दे̱व्यागा̱द्यस्यै̍मि̱मा ब̱ह्व्य̍स्त̱न्वो̍ वीतपृ̍ष्ठाः तया̱ मद̍न्तः सध̱मादे̍षु व̱यम्̐ स्या̍म̱ पत̍यो रयी̱णाम्
186.m: The purifying goddess belonging to all the gods has come, she whose many forms are smooth-backed; / Rejoicing with her at joint feasts, may we be masters of riches!

186.s: ye sa̍mā̱nāḥ sama̍nasaḥ pi̱taro̍ yama̱rājye̍ teṣā̍ṃlo̱kaḥ sva̱dhā namo̍ ya̱jño de̱veṣu̍ kalpatām
186.d: ये स̍मा̱नाः सम̍नसः पि̱तरो̍ यम̱राज्ये̍ तेषा̍ंलो̱कः स्व̱धा नमो̍ य̱ज्ञो दे̱वेषु̍ कल्पताम्
186.m: The fathers who are of equal rank and of one mind in the realm of Yama— / For them may their world, svadhā, homage, and sacrifice be arranged among the gods!

186.s: ye sa̍mā̱nāḥ sama̍naso jī̱vā jī̱veṣu̍ māma̱kāḥ teṣā̱m̐ śrīrmayi̍ kalpatāma̱smim̐llo̱ke śa̱tam̐ samā̍ḥ
186.d: ये स̍मा̱नाः सम̍नसो जी̱वा जी̱वेषु̍ माम̱काः तेषा̱म्̐ श्रीर्मयि̍ कल्पताम̱स्मिम्̐ल्लो̱के श̱तम्̐ समा̍ः
186.m: Those who are of equal rank and of one mind, living among the living, of my own kin— / May their prosperity be established in me in this world for a hundred years!

186.s: dve sṛ̱tī a̍śṛṇavaṃ pitṝ̱ṇāma̱haṃ de̱vānā̍mu̱ta martyā̍nām tābhyā̍mi̱daṃ viśva̱meja̱tsame̍ti̱ yada̍nta̱rā pi̱tara̍ṃ mā̱tara̍ṃ ca
186.d: द्वे सृ̱ती अ̍शृणवं पितॄ̱णाम̱हं दे̱वाना̍मु̱त मर्त्या̍नाम् ताभ्या̍मि̱दं विश्व̱मेज̱त्समे̍ति̱ यद̍न्त̱रा पि̱तर̍ं मा̱तर̍ं च
186.m: I have heard of two paths for the fathers, and for the gods and mortals; / Along these travels all this stirring world, whatever is between the father and the mother.

186.s: i̱dam̐ ha̱viḥ praja̍na̱naṃ me astu daśa̍vīra̱m̐ sarva̍gaṇam̐ sva̱staye̍ ā̱tma̱sani̍ pra̱jāsani̍ pa̱śusani̍ lo̱kasa̱nya̍bhaya̱sani̍ a̱gniḥ pra̱jāṃ ba̍hu̱lāṃ me̍ karo̱tvanna̱ṃ payo̱ reto̍ a̱smāsu̍ dhatta
186.d: इ̱दम्̐ ह̱विः प्रज̍न̱नं मे अस्तु दश̍वीर̱म्̐ सर्व̍गणम्̐ स्व̱स्तये̍ आ̱त्म̱सनि̍ प्र̱जासनि̍ प̱शुसनि̍ लो̱कस̱न्य̍भय̱सनि̍ अ̱ग्निः प्र̱जां ब̍हु̱लां मे̍ करो̱त्वन्न̱ं पयो̱ रेतो̍ अ̱स्मासु̍ धत्त
186.m: May this oblation of mine be procreative, yielding ten heroes, a full company, for well-being; / Gaining life, gaining offspring, gaining cattle, gaining the world, gaining security; / May Agni make my offspring abundant; bestow food, milk, and seed upon us!

187.s: (3) udī̍ratā̱mava̍ra̱ utparā̍sa̱ unma̍dhya̱māḥ pi̱tara̍ḥ so̱myāsa̍ḥ asu̱ṃ ya ī̱yura̍vṛ̱kā ṛ̍ta̱jñāste no̍'vantu pi̱taro̱ have̍ṣu
187.d: (3) उदी̍रता̱मव̍र̱ उत्परा̍स̱ उन्म̍ध्य̱माः पि̱तर̍ः सो̱म्यास̍ः असु̱ं य ई̱युर̍वृ̱का ऋ̍त̱ज्ञास्ते नो̍ऽवन्तु पि̱तरो̱ हवे̍षु
187.m: May the lower ones arise, and the higher, and the middlemost Soma-loving fathers, / Who have entered into the life-spirit, harmless, knowing the truth; may those fathers assist us in our invocations!

187.s: tvam̐ so̍ma̱ praci̍kito manī̱ṣā tvam̐ raji̍ṣṭha̱manu̍ neṣi̱ panthā̍m tava̱ praṇī̍tī pi̱taro̍ na indo de̱veṣu̱ ratna̍mabhajanta̱ dhīrā̍ḥ
187.d: त्वम्̐ सो̍म̱ प्रचि̍कितो मनी̱षा त्वम्̐ रजि̍ष्ठ̱मनु̍ नेषि̱ पन्था̍म् तव̱ प्रणी̍ती पि̱तरो̍ न इन्दो दे̱वेषु̱ रत्न̍मभजन्त̱ धीरा̍ः
187.m: You, O Soma, are discerning through wisdom; you lead along the straightest path; / By your guidance our wise fathers partook of the treasure among the gods, O Indu!

187.s: tvayā̱ hi na̍ḥ pi̱tara̍ḥ soma̱ pūrve̱ karmā̍ṇi ca̱kruḥ pa̍vamāna̱ dhīrā̍ḥ va̱nvannavā̍taḥ pari̱dhīm̐rapo̍rṇu vī̱rebhi̱raśvai̍rma̱ghavā̍ bhavā naḥ
187.d: त्वया̱ हि न̍ः पि̱तर̍ः सोम̱ पूर्वे̱ कर्मा̍णि च̱क्रुः प̍वमान̱ धीरा̍ः व̱न्वन्नवा̍तः परि̱धीम्̐रपो̍र्णु वी̱रेभि̱रश्वै̍र्म̱घवा̍ भवा नः
187.m: Through you, O Soma, our wise fathers of old performed their rites, O Pavamāna; / Conquering, unassailed, open the enclosures; be generous to us with heroes and horses!

187.s: tvam̐ so̍mam̐ pi̱tṛbhi̍ḥ saṃvidā̱no'nu̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī ā ta̍tantha tasmai̍ ta indo ha̱viṣā̍ vidhema va̱yam̐ syā̍ma̱ pata̍yo rayī̱ṇām
187.d: त्वम्̐ सो̍मम्̐ पि̱तृभि̍ः संविदा̱नोऽनु̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी आ त̍तन्थ तस्मै̍ त इन्दो ह̱विषा̍ विधेम व̱यम्̐ स्या̍म̱ पत̍यो रयी̱णाम्
187.m: You, O Soma, in concord with the fathers, have extended heaven and earth; / To you as such, O Indu, we worship with an oblation; may we be masters of riches!

187.s: ba̱rhi̱ṣada̍ḥ pitara ū̱tyarvā̍gi̱mā vo̍ ha̱vyā ca̍kṛmā juṣadhva̍m ta ā ga̱tāva̍sā̱ śanta̍me̱nāthā̍ na̱ḥ śaṃ yora̍ra̱po da̍dhāta
187.d: ब̱र्हि̱षद̍ः पितर ऊ̱त्यर्वा̍गि̱मा वो̍ ह̱व्या च̍कृमा जुषध्व̍म् त आ ग̱ताव̍सा̱ शन्त̍मे̱नाथा̍ न̱ः शं योर̍र̱पो द̍धात
187.m: O fathers seated on the sacred grass, come near with aid! These oblations we have prepared for you; enjoy them! / Come with most peaceful aid, and then bestow upon us bliss, freedom from harm, and health!

187.s: upa̍hūtāḥ pi̱tara̍ḥ so̱myāsau̍ ba̱rhiṣye̍ṣu ni̱dhiṣu̍ pri̱yeṣu̍ ta ā ga̍mantu̱ ta i̱ha śru̍va̱ntvadhi̍ bruvantu̱ te̍'vantva̱smān
187.d: उप̍हूताः पि̱तर̍ः सो̱म्यासौ̍ ब̱र्हिष्ये̍षु नि̱धिषु̍ प्रि̱येषु̍ त आ ग̍मन्तु̱ त इ̱ह श्रु̍व̱न्त्वधि̍ ब्रुवन्तु̱ ते̍ऽवन्त्व̱स्मान्
187.m: Invited are the Soma-loving fathers to the dear treasures on the sacred grass; / Let them come; let them hear here; let them speak in our favor; let them protect us!

187.s: ā̱haṃ pi̱tṝntsu̍vi̱datrā̍m̐2 avi̍tsi̱ napā̍taṃ ca vi̱krama̍ṇaṃ ca̱ viṣṇo̍ḥ ba̱rhi̱ṣado̱ ye sva̱dhayā̍ su̱tasya̱ bhaja̍nta pi̱tvasta i̱hāga̍miṣṭhāḥ
187.d: आ̱हं पि̱तॄन्त्सु̍वि̱दत्रा̍म्̐2 अवि̍त्सि̱ नपा̍तं च वि̱क्रम̍णं च̱ विष्णो̍ः ब̱र्हि̱षदो̱ ये स्व̱धया̍ सु̱तस्य̱ भज̍न्त पि̱त्वस्त इ̱हाग̍मिष्ठाः
187.m: I have found the kindly fathers, and the grandson, and the stride of Viṣṇu; / They who, seated on the sacred grass, share the food of the pressed [drink] at svadhā, are the readiest to come here.

187.s: a̱gniṣvā̍ttāḥ pitara̱ eha ga̍cchata̱ sada̍ḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ a̱ttā ha̱vīm̐ṣi̱ praya̍tāni ba̱rhiṣyathā̍ ra̱yim̐ sarva̍vīraṃ dadhātana
187.d: अ̱ग्निष्वा̍त्ताः पितर̱ एह ग̍च्छत̱ सद̍ःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः अ̱त्ता ह̱वीम्̐षि̱ प्रय̍तानि ब̱र्हिष्यथा̍ र̱यिम्̐ सर्व̍वीरं दधातन
187.m: Fathers consumed by Agni, come here; sit each on his seat, well-guided ones! / Eat the oblations set out on the sacred grass; then bestow upon us wealth rich in heroes!

187.s: ā ya̍ntu naḥ pi̱tara̍ḥ so̱myāsau̍'gniṣvā̱ttāḥ pa̱thibhi̍rde̱vayā̍naiḥ a̱smin ya̱jñe sva̱dhayā̱ mada̍nto'dhi̍ bruvantu̱ te̍'vantva̱smān
187.d: आ य̍न्तु नः पि̱तर̍ः सो̱म्यासौ̍ऽग्निष्वा̱त्ताः प̱थिभि̍र्दे̱वया̍नैः अ̱स्मिन् य̱ज्ञे स्व̱धया̱ मद̍न्तोऽधि̍ ब्रुवन्तु̱ ते̍ऽवन्त्व̱स्मान्
187.m: May our Soma-loving fathers, consumed by Agni, come by the paths trodden by the gods; / Rejoicing at this sacrifice at svadhā, let them speak in our favor; let them protect us!

187.s: ye a̍gniṣvā̱ttā ye ana̍gniṣvāttā̱ madhye̍ di̱vaḥ sva̱dhayā̍ mā̱daya̍nte tebhya̍ḥ sva̱rāḷasu̍nītime̱tāṃ ya̍thāva̱śaṃ ta̱nva̍ṃ kalpayāti
187.d: ये अ̍ग्निष्वा̱त्ता ये अन̍ग्निष्वात्ता̱ मध्ये̍ दि̱वः स्व̱धया̍ मा̱दय̍न्ते तेभ्य̍ः स्व̱राऌअसु̍नीतिमे̱तां य̍थाव̱शं त̱न्व̍ं कल्पयाति
187.m: Those who are consumed by Agni and those who are not consumed by Agni, who rejoice in the midst of heaven at svadhā— / For them the self-ruling sovereign shall fashion this spirit-life, a body according to their desire.

187.s: a̱gniṣvā̱ttānvṛ̍tuma̱to̍ havāmahe nārāśa̱m̐se so̍mapī̱thaṃ ya ā̱śuḥ te no̱ viprā̍saḥ su̱havā̍ bhavantu va̱yam̐ syā̍ma̱ pata̍yo rayī̱ṇām
187.d: अ̱ग्निष्वा̱त्तान्वृ̍तुम̱तो̍ हवामहे नाराश̱म्̐से सो̍मपी̱थं य आ̱शुः ते नो̱ विप्रा̍सः सु̱हवा̍ भवन्तु व̱यम्̐ स्या̍म̱ पत̍यो रयी̱णाम्
187.m: We invoke the fathers consumed by Agni, who belong to the seasons, who have partaken of the drink of Soma at the Nārāśaṃsa [cups]; / May they, the wise poets, be easy for us to invoke; may we be masters of riches!

187.s: ācyā̱ jānu̍ dakṣi̱ṇato ni̱ṣadye̱maṃ ya̱jñama̱bhi gṛ̍ṇīta̱ viśve̍ mā hi̍ṃm̐siṣṭa pitara̱ḥ kena̍ ci̱nno̱ yadva ārgaḥ puru̱ṣatā̱ karā̍ma
187.d: आच्या̱ जानु̍ दक्षि̱णतो नि̱षद्ये̱मं य̱ज्ञम̱भि गृ̍णीत̱ विश्वे̍ मा हि̍ंम्̐सिष्ट पितर̱ः केन̍ चि̱न्नो̱ यद्व आर्गः पुरु̱षता̱ करा̍म
187.m: Bending the knee, sitting down to the south, welcome this sacrifice, all of you! / Do not harm us, Fathers, for any offense that we, in our human nature, commit against you.

187.s: āsī̍nāso aruṇīnā̍mu̱pasthe̍ ra̱yiṃ dha̍tta dā̱śuṣe̱ martyā̍ya pu̱trebhya̍ḥ pitara̱stasya̱ vasva̱ḥ pra ya̍cchata̱ ta i̱horja̍ṃ dadhāta
187.d: आसी̍नासो अरुणीना̍मु̱पस्थे̍ र̱यिं ध̍त्त दा̱शुषे̱ मर्त्या̍य पु̱त्रेभ्य̍ः पितर̱स्तस्य̱ वस्व̱ः प्र य̍च्छत̱ त इ̱होर्ज̍ं दधात
187.m: Seated in the lap of the ruddy [dawns], grant wealth to the mortal who offers. / Bestow of that treasure upon your sons, O Fathers; establish vital refreshment here.

187.s: yama̍gne kavyavāha̱na̱ tvaṃ ci̍nmanya̍se ra̱yim | tanno̍ gī̱rbhiḥ śra̱vāyya̍ṃ de̱vatrā pa̍nayā̱ yuja̍m
187.d: यम̍ग्ने कव्यवाह̱न̱ त्वं चि̍न्मन्य̍से र̱यिम् । तन्नो̍ गी̱र्भिः श्र̱वाय्य̍ं दे̱वत्रा प̍नया̱ युज̍म्
187.m: O Agni, bearer of offerings to the Fathers, whatever wealth you esteem, / that companion worthy of renown declare among the gods with our songs.

187.s: yo a̱gniḥ ka̍vyavāha̍naḥ pi̱tṝnyakṣa̍dṛtā̱vṛdha̍ḥ | predu̍ ha̱vyāni̍ vocati de̱vebhya̍śca pi̱tṛbhya̱ ā
187.d: यो अ̱ग्निः क̍व्यवाह̍नः पि̱तॄन्यक्ष̍दृता̱वृध̍ः । प्रेदु̍ ह̱व्यानि̍ वोचति दे̱वेभ्य̍श्च पि̱तृभ्य̱ आ
187.m: May Agni, the bearer of offerings to the Fathers, sacrifice to the Fathers who increase cosmic order. / May he announce the oblations to the gods and to the Fathers.

187.s: tvama̍gna̱ īḍi̱to jā̍tavedo̱ vāḍḍha̱vyāni̍ sura̱bhīṇi̍ kṛ̱tvī prādā̍ḥ pi̱tṛbhya̍ḥ sva̱dhayā̱ te a̍kṣanna̱ddhi tvaṃ de̍va̱ praya̍tā ha̱vīm̐ṣi̍
187.d: त्वम̍ग्न̱ ईडि̱तो जा̍तवेदो̱ वाड्ढ̱व्यानि̍ सुर̱भीणि̍ कृ̱त्वी प्रादा̍ः पि̱तृभ्य̍ः स्व̱धया̱ ते अ̍क्षन्न̱द्धि त्वं दे̍व̱ प्रय̍ता ह̱वीम्̐षि̍
187.m: Lauded, O Agni Jātavedas, having borne the oblations and made them fragrant, / you have given them to the Fathers; through svadhā they have eaten. Eat, O god, the proffered oblations.

187.s: i̱daṃ pi̱tṛbhyo̱ namo̍ astva̱dya ye pūrvā̍so̱ ya upa̍rāsa ī̱yuḥ ye pārthi̍ve̱ raja̱syā niṣa̍ttā̱ ye vā̍ nū̱nam̐ su̍vṛja̱nā̍su vi̱kṣu
187.d: इ̱दं पि̱तृभ्यो̱ नमो̍ अस्त्व̱द्य ये पूर्वा̍सो̱ य उप̍रास ई̱युः ये पार्थि̍वे̱ रज̱स्या निष̍त्ता̱ ये वा̍ नू̱नम्̐ सु̍वृज̱ना̍सु वि̱क्षु
187.m: Let homage be paid today to the Fathers, who have gone before and who have gone later, / who are seated in the earthly realm or now among the settlements of noble kin.

187.s: ye ce̱ha pi̱taro̱ ye ca̱ neha yām̐śca̍ vi̱dma yām̐2 u̍ ca̱ na pra̍vi̱dma tvaṃ ve̍ttha̱ yati̱ te jā̍tavedaḥ sva̱dhābhi̍rya̱jñam̐ sukṛ̍taṃ juṣasva
187.d: ये चे̱ह पि̱तरो̱ ये च̱ नेह याम्̐श्च̍ वि̱द्म याम्̐2 उ̍ च̱ न प्र̍वि̱द्म त्वं वे̍त्थ̱ यति̱ ते जा̍तवेदः स्व̱धाभि̍र्य̱ज्ञम्̐ सुकृ̍तं जुषस्व
187.m: Those Fathers who are here and those who are not here, those whom we know and those whom we know not: / you know how many they are, O Jātavedas; with svadhā enjoy the well-made sacrifice.

187.s: adhā̱ yathā̍ naḥ pi̱tara̍ḥ parā̍saḥ pra̱tnāso̍ agna ṛtamā̍śuṣā̱ṇāḥ śucī̍daya̱ndīdhi̍timuktha̱śāsa̱ḥ kṣāma̍ bhi̱ndanto̍ aru̱ṇīrapa̍ vran
187.d: अधा̱ यथा̍ नः पि̱तर̍ः परा̍सः प्र̱त्नासो̍ अग्न ऋतमा̍शुषा̱णाः शुची̍दय̱न्दीधि̍तिमुक्थ̱शास̱ः क्षाम̍ भि̱न्दन्तो̍ अरु̱णीरप̍ व्रन्
187.m: Then, just as our ancient Fathers of old, seeking cosmic order, O Agni, / attained pure insight, chanting praise-hymns, cleaving the earth, and laid bare the ruddy [cows];

187.s: uśanta̍stvā ni dhī̍mahyuśanta̱ḥ sami̍dhīmahi uśannu̍śa̱ta ā va̍ha pi̱tṝn ha̱viṣe atta̍ve
187.d: उशन्त̍स्त्वा नि धी̍मह्युशन्त̱ः समि̍धीमहि उशन्नु̍श̱त आ व̍ह पि̱तॄन् ह̱विषे अत्त̍वे
187.m: Desiring [you], we set you down; desiring [you], we kindle you. / Desiring, bring the desiring Fathers to eat the oblation.

187.s: a̱pāṃ phene̍na̱ namu̍ceḥ śira̍ indroda̍vartayaḥ | viśvā̱ yadaja̍ya̱ spṛdha̍ḥ
187.d: अ̱पां फेने̍न̱ नमु̍चेः शिर̍ इन्द्रोद̍वर्तयः । विश्वा̱ यदज̍य̱ स्पृध̍ः
187.m: With the foam of the waters you rolled off Namuci's head, O Indra, / when you conquered all rivals.

188.s: (4) somo̱ rājā̱mṛta̍m̐ su̱ta ṛjīṣeṇā̍jahānmṛ̱tyum ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍
188.d: (4) सोमो̱ राजा̱मृत̍म्̐ सु̱त ऋजीषेणा̍जहान्मृ̱त्युम् ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍
188.m: King Soma, pressed as the immortal drink, left death behind with the dregs. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power.

188.s: anna̍m̐ kṣī̱raṃ vya̍piba̱t kruṅṅā̍ṅgira̱so dhi̱yā ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍ soma̍ma̱śvo vya̍piba̱cchanda̍sā ha̱m̐saḥ śu̍ci̱ṣat ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍ annā̍tpari̱sruto̱ rasa̱ṃ brahma̍ṇā̱ vya̍pibat kṣa̱traṃ paya̍ḥ soma̍ṃ pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍
188.d: अन्न̍म्̐ क्षी̱रं व्य̍पिब̱त् क्रुङ्ङा̍ङ्गिर̱सो धि̱या ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍ सोम̍म̱श्वो व्य̍पिब̱च्छन्द̍सा ह̱म्̐सः शु̍चि̱षत् ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍ अन्ना̍त्परि̱स्रुतो̱ रस̱ं ब्रह्म̍णा̱ व्य̍पिबत् क्ष̱त्रं पय̍ः सोम̍ं प्र̱जाप̍तिः ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍
188.m: The curlew of the Aṅgirases with his insight drank apart the milk from the waters. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power. / The swan dwelling in the clear [space] drank apart the Soma from the waters by metre. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power. / From food Prajāpati drank apart the essence of Parisrut, princely power, milk, and Soma by means of the sacred formulation. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power.

188.s: reto̱ mūtra̱ṃ vi ja̍hāti̱ yoni̍ṃ praviśadi̍ndri̱yam garbho̱ jarāyuṇāvṛ̍ta̱ ulba̍ṃ jahāti̱ janma̍nā ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍
188.d: रेतो̱ मूत्र̱ं वि ज̍हाति̱ योनि̍ं प्रविशदि̍न्द्रि̱यम् गर्भो̱ जरायुणावृ̍त̱ उल्ब̍ं जहाति̱ जन्म̍ना ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍
188.m: The semen leaves the urine, the vital power entering the womb; / the embryo enclosed by the chorion leaves the afterbirth by birth. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power.

188.s: dṛ̱ṣṭvā rū̱pe vyāka̍rot sa̱tyānṛ̱te pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ aśra̍ddhāmanṛ̱te da̍dhācchra̱ddhām̐ sa̱tye pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍
188.d: दृ̱ष्ट्वा रू̱पे व्याक̍रोत् स̱त्यानृ̱ते प्र̱जाप̍तिः अश्र̍द्धामनृ̱ते द̍धाच्छ्र̱द्धाम्̐ स̱त्ये प्र̱जाप̍तिः ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍
188.m: Having seen the forms, Prajāpati separated truth and untruth. / Prajāpati placed distrust in untruth, and trust in truth. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power.

188.s: vede̍na rū̱pe vya̍pibat sutāsu̱tau pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍ dṛ̱ṣṭvā pari̍sruto̱ rasa̍m̐ śu̱kreṇa̍ śu̱kraṃ vya̍piba̱tpaya̍ḥ soma̍ṃ pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱tyami̍ndri̱yaṃ vipā̱nam̐ śu̱kramandha̍sa̱ indra̍syendvi̱yami̱daṃ payo̱'mṛta̱ṃ madhu̍
188.d: वेदे̍न रू̱पे व्य̍पिबत् सुतासु̱तौ प्र̱जाप̍तिः ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍ दृ̱ष्ट्वा परि̍स्रुतो̱ रस̍म्̐ शु̱क्रेण̍ शु̱क्रं व्य̍पिब̱त्पय̍ः सोम̍ं प्र̱जाप̍तिः ऋ̱तेन̍ स̱त्यमि̍न्द्रि̱यं विपा̱नम्̐ शु̱क्रमन्ध̍स̱ इन्द्र̍स्येन्द्वि̱यमि̱दं पयो̱ऽमृत̱ं मधु̍
188.m: With the Veda Prajāpati drank apart the two forms, the pressed and the unpressed. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power. / Having observed the essence of Parisrut, Prajāpati drank apart the bright milk and Soma with the bright [Soma]. / Through cosmic order, truth is the vital power, the separate drinking, the bright juice of the plant. This milk, the immortal honey, is Indra's vital power.

189.s: sīse̍na̱ tantra̱ṃ mana̍sā manī̱ṣiṇa̱ ūrṇāsūtreṇa̍ ka̱vayo̍ vayanti a̱śvinā̍ ya̱jñam̐ sa̍vi̱tā sara̍svatīndra̍sya rū̱paṃ varu̍ṇo bhiṣa̱jyan
189.d: सीसे̍न̱ तन्त्र̱ं मन̍सा मनी̱षिण̱ ऊर्णासूत्रेण̍ क̱वयो̍ वयन्ति अ̱श्विना̍ य̱ज्ञम्̐ स̍वि̱ता सर̍स्वतीन्द्र̍स्य रू̱पं वरु̍णो भिष̱ज्यन्
189.m: With lead the wise, with the mind, with woolen thread the poets weave the web: / the Aśvins, Savitṛ, Sarasvatī, and Varuṇa healing the form of Indra.

189.s: tada̍sya rū̱pama̱mṛta̍m̐ śacī̍bhisti̱sro da̍dhurde̱vatā̍ḥ sam̐rarā̱ṇāḥ lomā̍ni̱ śaṣpai̍rbahu̱dhā na tokma̍bhistvaga̍sya mām̐sarmabhava̱nna lājāḥ
189.d: तद̍स्य रू̱पम̱मृत̍म्̐ शची̍भिस्ति̱स्रो द̍धुर्दे̱वता̍ः सम्̐ररा̱णाः लोमा̍नि̱ शष्पै̍र्बहु̱धा न तोक्म̍भिस्त्वग̍स्य माम्̐सर्मभव̱न्न लाजाः
189.m: Then the three deities in union established his immortal form by their wondrous powers: / his body-hairs [were formed] abundantly with young grass as if with shoots; his skin and his flesh became parched grains.

189.s: tada̱śvinā̍ bhi̱ṣajā̍ ru̱drava̍rtanī̱ sara̍svatī vayati̱ peśo̱ anta̍ram asthi̍ ma̱jjāna̱ṃ māsa̍raiḥ kāro̱tare̍ṇa dadha̍to̱ gavā̱ṃ tvaci
189.d: तद̱श्विना̍ भि̱षजा̍ रु̱द्रव̍र्तनी̱ सर̍स्वती वयति̱ पेशो̱ अन्त̍रम् अस्थि̍ म̱ज्जान̱ं मास̍रैः कारो̱तरे̍ण दध̍तो̱ गवा̱ं त्वचि
189.m: Then the two Aśvins, the physicians whose track is fierce, and Sarasvatī weave the inner form, / placing bone and marrow with fermented liquors into the strainer upon the ox-hide.

189.s: sara̍svatī̱ mana̍sā̱ peśa̍la̱ṃ vasu̱ nāsa̍tyābhyāṃ vayati darśa̱taṃ vapu̍ḥ rasaiṃ pari̱srutā̱ na rohi̍taṃ na̱gnahurdhī̱rastasa̍ra̱ṃ na vema̍
189.d: सर̍स्वती̱ मन̍सा̱ पेश̍ल̱ं वसु̱ नास̍त्याभ्यां वयति दर्श̱तं वपु̍ः रसैं परि̱स्रुता̱ न रोहि̍तं न̱ग्नहुर्धी̱रस्तस̍र̱ं न वेम̍
189.m: Sarasvatī with the mind weaves the shapely treasure, the lovely form, with the two Nāsatyas, / as a wise weaver [weaves] the shuttle upon the loom, like essence from Parisrut, like the red yeast.

189.s: paya̍sā śu̱krama̱mṛta̍ṃ ja̱nitra̱m̐ sura̍yā mūtrā̍janayanta̱ reta̍ḥ apā̱marti̍ durma̱tiṃ bādha̍mānā ū̱vadhya̱ṃ vāta̍m̐ sa̱bvaṃ tadā̍rāt
189.d: पय̍सा शु̱क्रम̱मृत̍ं ज̱नित्र̱म्̐ सुर̍या मूत्रा̍जनयन्त̱ रेत̍ः अपा̱मर्ति̍ दुर्म̱तिं बाध̍माना ऊ̱वध्य̱ं वात̍म्̐ स̱ब्वं तदा̍रात्
189.m: With milk they generated bright immortal birth, with liquor they generated semen from urine, / driving off folly and malevolence, and cast far away the stomach-contents, the wind, and the filth.

189.s: indra̍ḥ su̱trāmā̱ hṛda̍yena sa̱tyaṃ pu̍roḍā̱śena̍ savi̱tā ja̍jāna yakṛ̍t klo̱māna̱ṃ varu̍ṇo bhi̱ṣajyan ma̱tasne̍ vā̱yavyai̱rna mi̍nāti pi̱ttam
189.d: इन्द्र̍ः सु̱त्रामा̱ हृद̍येन स̱त्यं पु̍रोडा̱शेन̍ सवि̱ता ज̍जान यकृ̍त् क्लो̱मान̱ं वरु̍णो भि̱षज्यन् म̱तस्ने̍ वा̱यव्यै̱र्न मि̍नाति पि̱त्तम्
189.m: Indra, the good protector, produced truth with his heart; Savitṛ [produced it] with the sacrificial cake. / Varuṇa, healing, does not harm the liver, the lungs, or the bile with the two kidneys [formed] by Vāyu's cups.

189.s: ā̱ntrāṇi̍ sthā̱līrmadhu̍ pinva̍mānā gu̱dāḥ pātrā̍ṇi su̱dughā̍ na dhe̱nuḥ śye̱nasya̍ pa̱traṃ na plī̱hā śacī̍bhirāsa̱ndī nābhi̍ru̱dara̍ṃ na mā̱tā
189.d: आ̱न्त्राणि̍ स्था̱लीर्मधु̍ पिन्व̍माना गु̱दाः पात्रा̍णि सु̱दुघा̍ न धे̱नुः श्ये̱नस्य̍ प̱त्रं न प्ली̱हा शची̍भिरास̱न्दी नाभि̍रु̱दर̍ं न मा̱ता
189.m: The entrails are cooking pots welling with honey; the bowels are vessels like an easily milked cow. / His spleen is like the wing of an eagle through their wondrous powers; the navel is a chair; the belly is like a mother.

189.s: ku̱mbho va̍ni̱ṣṭhurja̍ni̱tā śacī̍bhi̱ryasmi̱nnagre̱ yonyā̱ṃ garbho̍ a̱ntaḥ plā̱śirvya̍ktaḥ śa̱tadhā̍ra̱ utso̍ du̱he na ku̱mbhī sva̱dhāṃ pi̱tṛbhya̍ḥ
189.d: कु̱म्भो व̍नि̱ष्ठुर्ज̍नि̱ता शची̍भि̱र्यस्मि̱न्नग्रे̱ योन्या̱ं गर्भो̍ अ̱न्तः प्ला̱शिर्व्य̍क्तः श̱तधा̍र̱ उत्सो̍ दु̱हे न कु̱म्भी स्व̱धां पि̱तृभ्य̍ः
189.m: The rectum is a jar, the begetter by their wondrous powers, in which originally the embryo was within the womb. / The bladder is made manifest as a hundred-streamed fountain, like a pot milking svadhā for the Fathers.

189.s: mukha̱m̐ sada̍sya̱ śira̱ it sate̍na ji̱hvā pa̱vitra̍ma̱śvinā̱santa̱sara̍svatī ca̱ppaṃ na pā̱yurbhiṣa̱gasya̱ vālo̍ va̱stirna śepo̱ hara̍sā ta̱rasvī
189.d: मुख̱म्̐ सद̍स्य̱ शिर̱ इत् सते̍न जि̱ह्वा प̱वित्र̍म̱श्विना̱सन्त̱सर̍स्वती च̱प्पं न पा̱युर्भिष̱गस्य̱ वालो̍ व̱स्तिर्न शेपो̱ हर̍सा त̱रस्वी
189.m: His mouth is the assembly hall; his head indeed is the dish; the strainer is his tongue; the Aśvins and Sarasvatī [are] in his mouth. / His anus is like a ladle; his tail-hair is the physician; his swift penis is like the bladder in heat.

189.s: a̱śvibhyā̱ṃ cakṣu̍ra̱mṛta̱ṃ grahā̍bhyāṃ chā̱gena̱ tejo̍ ha̱viṣā̍ śṛ̱tena̍ pa̱kṣmāṇi̍ go̱dhūmai̍ḥ kuva̱lairū̱tāni̱ peśo̱ na śu̱kramasi̍taṃ vasāte
189.d: अ̱श्विभ्या̱ं चक्षु̍र̱मृत̱ं ग्रहा̍भ्यां छा̱गेन̱ तेजो̍ ह̱विषा̍ शृ̱तेन̍ प̱क्ष्माणि̍ गो̱धूमै̍ः कुव̱लैरू̱तानि̱ पेशो̱ न शु̱क्रमसि̍तं वसाते
189.m: Immortal sight is [formed] for the two Aśvins with the two libation cups, his radiance with the he-goat and the boiled oblation. / The eyelashes are woven with grains of wheat and jujube; like a garment, the white and the black [of the eye] clothe themselves.

189.s: avi̱rna me̱ṣo nasi̍ vī̱ryā̍ya prā̱ṇasya̱ panthā̍ a̱mṛto̱ grahā̍bhyām sara̍svatyupa̱vākai̱rvyā̱naṃ nasyā̍ni ba̱rhirbada̍rairjajāna
189.d: अवि̱र्न मे̱षो नसि̍ वी̱र्या̍य प्रा̱णस्य̱ पन्था̍ अ̱मृतो̱ ग्रहा̍भ्याम् सर̍स्वत्युप̱वाकै̱र्व्या̱नं नस्या̍नि ब̱र्हिर्बद̍रैर्जजान
189.m: The ram is like a sheep in the nose for manly vigor; the immortal path of in-breath [comes] from the two cups; / with upavāka seeds Sarasvatī generated diffused breath, the nasal hairs with the sacrificial grass, [and the nostrils] with jujube fruits.

189.s: indra̍sya rū̱pamṛ̍ṣa̱bho balā̍ya karṇā̍bhyām̐ śro̱trama̱mṛta̱ṃ grahā̍bhyām yavā̍ na ba̱rhirbhruvi̍ kesa̍rāṇi ka̱rkandhu̍ jajñe madhu̍ sā̱ragha̱ṃ mukhā̍t
189.d: इन्द्र̍स्य रू̱पमृ̍ष̱भो बला̍य कर्णा̍भ्याम्̐ श्रो̱त्रम̱मृत̱ं ग्रहा̍भ्याम् यवा̍ न ब̱र्हिर्भ्रुवि̍ केस̍राणि क̱र्कन्धु̍ जज्ञे मधु̍ सा̱रघ̱ं मुखा̍त्
189.m: The bull is Indra's form for strength; immortal hearing [comes] for the two ears through the two cups. / Like barley is the sacrificial grass upon his brow; the bristles [and] wild jujube [became the lashes]; bee-honey was born from his mouth.

189.s: ā̱tmannupa̱sthe na vṛka̍sya̱ loma̱ mukhe̱ śmaśrū̍ṇi̱ na vyā̍ghra̱loma̍ keśā̍ na śī̱rṣaṇyaśa̍se śri̱yai śi̱khā sim̐ha̱sya loma̍ tvi̱ṣi̍rindri̱yāṇi̍
189.d: आ̱त्मन्नुप̱स्थे न वृक̍स्य̱ लोम̱ मुखे̱ श्मश्रू̍णि̱ न व्या̍घ्र̱लोम̍ केशा̍ न शी̱र्षण्यश̍से श्रि̱यै शि̱खा सिम्̐ह̱स्य लोम̍ त्वि̱षि̍रिन्द्रि̱याणि̍
189.m: On the body and the lap [is] hair as of a wolf; on the face the beard as wolf-hair; / hair on the head for glory, for majesty, the crest [as] lion's hair, fiery vigor, faculties.

189.s: aṅgā̍nyā̱tman bhiṣa̱jā tada̱śvinā̱tmāna̱maṅgai̍ḥ sama̍dhāt sara̍svatī indra̍sya rū̱pam̐ śa̱tamā̍na̱māyu̍śca̱ndreṇa̱ jyoti̍ra̱mṛta̱ṃ dadhā̍nāḥ
189.d: अङ्गा̍न्या̱त्मन् भिष̱जा तद̱श्विना̱त्मान̱मङ्गै̍ः सम̍धात् सर̍स्वती इन्द्र̍स्य रू̱पम्̐ श̱तमा̍न̱मायु̍श्च̱न्द्रेण̱ ज्योति̍र̱मृत̱ं दधा̍नाः
189.m: The two Aśvins as physicians then assembled the limbs onto the body; Sarasvatī joined the body with its limbs, / bestowing Indra's form, a life of a hundred measures, and immortal light with the moon.

189.s: sara̍svatī̱ yonyā̱ṃ garbha̍ma̱ntara̱śvibhyā̱ṃ patnī̍ su̱kṛta̍ṃ bibharti a̱pām̐ rasai̍na̱ varu̍ṇo̱ na sāmnendra̍m̐ śri̱yai ja̍naya̱nnapsu rājā̍
189.d: सर̍स्वती̱ योन्या̱ं गर्भ̍म̱न्तर̱श्विभ्या̱ं पत्नी̍ सु̱कृत̍ं बिभर्ति अ̱पाम्̐ रसै̍न̱ वरु̍णो̱ न साम्नेन्द्र̍म्̐ श्रि̱यै ज̍नय̱न्नप्सु राजा̍
189.m: Sarasvatī, as wife [to Indra], bears the well-formed embryo in her womb for the two Aśvins, / as Varuṇa, king in the waters, generating Indra for majesty with the sap of the waters, with the chant.

189.s: teja̍ḥ paśū̱nām̐ ha̱virī̍ndri̱yāva̍t pari̱srutā̱ paya̍sā sā̱ragha̱ṃ madhu̍ a̱śvibhyā̍ṃ du̱gdhaṃ bhiṣa̱jā sara̍svatyā su̱tāsu̍tābhyā̍ma̱mṛta̍ḥ soma̱ indu̍ḥ
189.d: तेज̍ः पशू̱नाम्̐ ह̱विरी̍न्द्रि̱याव̍त् परि̱स्रुता̱ पय̍सा सा̱रघ̱ं मधु̍ अ̱श्विभ्या̍ं दु̱ग्धं भिष̱जा सर̍स्वत्या सु̱तासु̍ताभ्या̍म̱मृत̍ः सोम̱ इन्दु̍ः
189.m: The fiery energy of cattle, the oblation endowed with sensory power, the bee's honey with distilled liquor and milk, / milked by the two Aśvins, physicians, by Sarasvatī, from both pressed and unpressed [soma], the immortal Soma juice.

190.s: (6) kṣa̱trasya̱ nābhi̍rasi kṣa̱trasya̱ yoni̍rasi | mā tvā̍ him̐sīnmā māṃ him̐sīḥ niṣa̍sāda dhṛtavra̍to̱ varu̍ṇaḥ pa̱styā̱svā | sā̱mrājyā̍ya su̱kratu̍ḥ | mṛ̱tyoḥ pā̍hi vi̱dyotpā̍hi de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām
190.d: (6) क्ष̱त्रस्य̱ नाभि̍रसि क्ष̱त्रस्य̱ योनि̍रसि । मा त्वा̍ हिम्̐सीन्मा मां हिम्̐सीः निष̍साद धृतव्र̍तो̱ वरु̍णः प̱स्त्या̱स्वा । सा̱म्राज्या̍य सु̱क्रतु̍ः । मृ̱त्योः पा̍हि वि̱द्योत्पा̍हि दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम्
190.m: You are the navel of princely power; you are the womb of princely power. Let it not harm you; do not harm me. / Varuṇa of steadfast vows has sat down among the homesteads, he of true resolve, for sovereign rule. Protect [me] from death, protect from lightning. / At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan,

190.s: a̱śvino̍rbhe̱ṣa̱jyena̱ teja̍se brahmavarca̱sāyā̱bhi ṣi̍ñcāmi̱ sara̍svatyai bhaiṣa̱jyena̱ vī̱ryā̍yānnā̱dyā̍yā̱bhi ṣi̍ñcāmi indra̍syendi̱yeṇa̱ balā̍ya̱ śriyai̱ yaśa̍se̱'bhi ṣi̍ñcāmi
190.d: अ̱श्विनो̍र्भे̱ष̱ज्येन̱ तेज̍से ब्रह्मवर्च̱साया̱भि षि̍ञ्चामि̱ सर̍स्वत्यै भैष̱ज्येन̱ वी̱र्या̍यान्ना̱द्या̍या̱भि षि̍ञ्चामि इन्द्र̍स्येन्दि̱येण̱ बला̍य̱ श्रियै̱ यश̍से̱ऽभि षि̍ञ्चामि
190.m: with the healing of the Aśvins, I consecrate you for fiery energy, for sacred splendor; with the healing of Sarasvatī, I consecrate you for heroic vigor, for food-consumption; / with Indra's faculty, I consecrate you for strength, for majesty, for glory.

190.s: kau'si̱ kata̱mo'si̱ kasmai̍ tvā̱ kāya̍ tvā | su̱śloka̍ suma̱ṅgala̍ sa̱tyarā̍jan
190.d: कौऽसि̱ कत̱मोऽसि̱ कस्मै̍ त्वा̱ काय̍ त्वा । सु̱श्लोक̍ सुम̱ङ्गल̍ स̱त्यरा̍जन्
190.m: Who are you? Which of many are you? For whom [are you]? For Ka are you! / O you of fair fame, of good auspices, true king!

190.s: śiro̍ me̱ śrīryaśo̱ mukha̱ṃ tviṣi̍ḥ ke̱śā̍śca̱ śmaśrū̍ṇi rājā̍ me prā̱ṇo a̱mṛta̍ṃm̐ sa̱mrāṭ cakṣu̍rvi̱rāṭ śrotra̍m
190.d: शिरो̍ मे̱ श्रीर्यशो̱ मुख̱ं त्विषि̍ः के̱शा̍श्च̱ श्मश्रू̍णि राजा̍ मे प्रा̱णो अ̱मृत̍ंम्̐ स̱म्राट् चक्षु̍र्वि̱राट् श्रोत्र̍म्
190.m: My head is majesty, my face glory, fiery vigor my hair and beard; / my breath is the king, immortal; the emperor my sight, the sovereign ruler my hearing.

190.s: ji̱hvā me̍ bha̱draṃ vāṅ maho̱ mano̍ ma̱nyuḥ sva̱rāḍ bhāma̍ḥ modā̍ḥ pra̱modā̍ a̱ṅgulī̱raṅgā̍ni mi̱traṃ me̱ saha̍ḥ
190.d: जि̱ह्वा मे̍ भ̱द्रं वाङ् महो̱ मनो̍ म̱न्युः स्व̱राड् भाम̍ः मोदा̍ः प्र̱मोदा̍ अ̱ङ्गुली̱रङ्गा̍नि मि̱त्रं मे̱ सह̍ः
190.m: My tongue is auspiciousness, my speech greatness, my mind fury, my wrath autonomous ruler; / joys and delights are my fingers, limbs my companion, my conquering power.

190.s: bā̱hū me̱ bala̍mindri̱yam̐ hastau̍ me̱ karma̍ vī̱rya̍m | ā̱tmā kṣa̱tramu̱ro marma̍
190.d: बा̱हू मे̱ बल̍मिन्द्रि̱यम्̐ हस्तौ̍ मे̱ कर्म̍ वी̱र्य̍म् । आ̱त्मा क्ष̱त्रमु̱रो मर्म̍
190.m: My two arms are strength and sensory power, my two hands ritual act and heroic vigor; / my body is princely power, my chest [dominion].

190.s: pṛ̱ṣṭī̱rme rā̱ṣṭramuda̱ramam̐sau grī̱vāśca̱ śroṇī̍ | ū̱rū a̍ra̱tnī jānu̍nī̱ viśo̍ me̱'ṅgā̍ni sa̱rvata̍ḥ
190.d: पृ̱ष्टी̱र्मे रा̱ष्ट्रमुद̱रमम्̐सौ ग्री̱वाश्च̱ श्रोणी̍ । ऊ̱रू अ̍र̱त्नी जानु̍नी̱ विशो̍ मे̱ऽङ्गा̍नि स̱र्वत̍ः
190.m: My back is the realm, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips; / my thighs, forearms, knees, the clans, are my limbs on all sides.

190.s: nābhi̍rme ci̱ttaṃ vi̱jñāna̍ṃ pā̱yurme̍'paci̱tirbhasa̍t ā̱na̱nda̱na̱ndā ā̱ṇḍau me̱ bhaga̍ḥ saubhā̍gya̱ṃ pasa̍ḥ
190.d: नाभि̍र्मे चि̱त्तं वि̱ज्ञान̍ं पा̱युर्मे̍ऽपचि̱तिर्भस̍त् आ̱न̱न्द̱न̱न्दा आ̱ण्डौ मे̱ भग̍ः सौभा̍ग्य̱ं पस̍ः
190.m: My navel is consciousness and discernment, my anus reverence, the buttocks; / joys and rejoicings are my testicles, the phallus is fortune and prosperity.

190.s: jaṅghā̍bhyā̱ṃ padbhyā̱ṃ dharmo̍'smi̱ viśi̱ rājā̱ prati̍ṣṭhitaḥ prati̍ kṣa̱tre prati̍ tiṣṭhāmi rā̱ṣṭre pratyaśve̍ṣu̱ prati̍ tiṣṭhāmi̱ goṣu̍
190.d: जङ्घा̍भ्या̱ं पद्भ्या̱ं धर्मो̍ऽस्मि̱ विशि̱ राजा̱ प्रति̍ष्ठितः प्रति̍ क्ष̱त्रे प्रति̍ तिष्ठामि रा̱ष्ट्रे प्रत्यश्वे̍षु̱ प्रति̍ तिष्ठामि̱ गोषु̍
190.m: With shanks and feet I am the established cosmic law, king among the clan; / I stand firm in princely power, I stand firm in the realm, I stand firm among horses, I stand firm among cattle.

190.s: pra̱tyaṅge̍ṣu̱ prati̍ tiṣṭhāmyā̱tman prati̍ prā̱ṇeṣu̱ prati̍ tiṣṭhāmi pu̱ṣṭe prati̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vyoḥ prati̍ tiṣṭhāmi ya̱jñe
190.d: प्र̱त्यङ्गे̍षु̱ प्रति̍ तिष्ठाम्या̱त्मन् प्रति̍ प्रा̱णेषु̱ प्रति̍ तिष्ठामि पु̱ष्टे प्रति̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱व्योः प्रति̍ तिष्ठामि य̱ज्ञे
190.m: I stand firm in every limb, I stand firm in the body, I stand firm in the breaths, I stand firm in nourishment; / I stand firm in heaven and earth, I stand firm in the sacrifice.

190.s: trayā̍ de̱vā ekā̍daśa trayastrim̐śāḥ su̱rādha̍saḥ bṛha̱spati̍purohitā de̱vasya̍ savi̱tuḥ sa̱ve | de̱vā de̱vaira̍vantu mā
190.d: त्रया̍ दे̱वा एका̍दश त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शाः सु̱राध̍सः बृह̱स्पति̍पुरोहिता दे̱वस्य̍ सवि̱तुः स̱वे । दे̱वा दे̱वैर̍वन्तु मा
190.m: The three-and-thirty gods, three elevens, of abundant bounty, / having Bṛhaspati as purohita, at the impulse of the divine Savitṛ—may the gods protect me with the gods.

190.s: pra̱tha̱mā dvi̱tīyai̍rdvi̱tīyā̍stṛ̱tīyai̍stṛ̱tīyā̍ḥ sa̱tyena̍ sa̱tyaṃ ya̱jñena̍ ya̱jño yaju̍rbhi̱ryajū̍m̐ṣi̱ sāma̍bhiḥ
190.d: प्र̱थ̱मा द्वि̱तीयै̍र्द्वि̱तीया̍स्तृ̱तीयै̍स्तृ̱तीया̍ः स̱त्येन̍ स̱त्यं य̱ज्ञेन̍ य̱ज्ञो यजु̍र्भि̱र्यजू̍म्̐षि̱ साम̍भिः
190.m: The first with the second, the second with the third, the third with truth; / truth with sacrifice, sacrifice with the yajus formulas, the yajus formulas with the sāman chants,

190.s: sāmā̍nyṛ̱gbhirṛca̍ḥ pu̱ro'nu̍vā̱kyā̍bhiḥ pu̱ro'nu̍vā̱kyā̍ yā̱jyā̍bhiryā̱jyā̍ vaṣaṭkā̱raiḥ vaṣa̍ṭkā̱rā āhu̍tibhi̱rāhu̍tayo me̱ kāmā̍ntsama̍rdhayantu̱ bhūḥ svāhā̍
190.d: सामा̍न्यृ̱ग्भिरृच̍ः पु̱रोऽनु̍वा̱क्या̍भिः पु̱रोऽनु̍वा̱क्या̍ या̱ज्या̍भिर्या̱ज्या̍ वषट्का̱रैः वष̍ट्का̱रा आहु̍तिभि̱राहु̍तयो मे̱ कामा̍न्त्सम̍र्धयन्तु̱ भूः स्वाहा̍
190.m: the sāman chants with the ṛc verses, the ṛc verses with the invitatory formulas, the invitatory formulas with the offering verses, the offering verses with the vaṣaṭ-calls; / the vaṣaṭ-calls with oblations. May the oblations fulfill my desires: bhūḥ svāhā!

190.s:
lomā̍ni̱ praya̍ti̱rmama̱ tvaṅ ma̱ āna̍ti̱rāga̍tiḥ mām̐saṃ ma̱ upa̍nati̱rvasvasthi̍ ma̱jjā ma̱ āna̍tiḥ
svāṅgīṃ tvaikādaśa
190.d:
लोमा̍नि̱ प्रय̍ति̱र्मम̱ त्वङ् म̱ आन̍ति̱राग̍तिः माम्̐सं म̱ उप̍नति̱र्वस्वस्थि̍ म̱ज्जा म̱ आन̍तिः
स्वाङ्गीं त्वैकादश
190.m:
My hairs are forward effort, my skin compliance and incoming; / my flesh is submission, bone and marrow are my compliance.

"Svādvīṃ tvā" eleven; "devā yajñam" twenty; "surāvantam" nineteen; "udīratām" twenty-one; / "somo rājā" five; "sīsena tantram" sixteen; "kṣatrasya nābhiḥ" fourteen; / in the seven anuvākas are one hundred and six [verses]. / Thus ends the twenty-first adhyāya in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

191.s: yadde̱vā de̱vahe̍ḷana̱ndevā̍saścakṛ̱mā va̱yam | a̱gnirmā̱ tasmā̱dena̍so viśvā̍nmuñcatvam̐ha̍saḥ
191.d: यद्दे̱वा दे̱वहे̍ऌअन̱न्देवा̍सश्चकृ̱मा व̱यम् । अ̱ग्निर्मा̱ तस्मा̱देन̍सो विश्वा̍न्मुञ्चत्वम्̐ह̍सः
191.m: Whatever offense against the gods we have committed, O gods, / let Agni release me from that sin, from all distress.

191.s: yadi̱ divā̱ yadi̱ nakta̱menā̍ṃm̐si cakṛ̱mā va̱yam vā̱yurmā̱ tasmā̱dena̍so viśvā̍nmuñcatvam̐ha̍saḥ
191.d: यदि̱ दिवा̱ यदि̱ नक्त̱मेना̍ंम्̐सि चकृ̱मा व̱यम् वा̱युर्मा̱ तस्मा̱देन̍सो विश्वा̍न्मुञ्चत्वम्̐ह̍सः
191.m: If by day, if by night, we have committed sins, / let Vāyu release me from that sin, from all distress.

191.s: yadi̱ jāgra̱dyadi̱ svapna̱ enā̍ṃm̐si cakṛ̱mā va̱yam sūryo̍ mā̱ tasmā̱dena̍so viśvā̍nmuñcatvam̐ha̍saḥ
191.d: यदि̱ जाग्र̱द्यदि̱ स्वप्न̱ एना̍ंम्̐सि चकृ̱मा व̱यम् सूर्यो̍ मा̱ तस्मा̱देन̍सो विश्वा̍न्मुञ्चत्वम्̐ह̍सः
191.m: If awake, if sleeping, we have committed sins, / let Sūrya release me from that sin, from all distress.

191.s: yad grā̱me yadara̍ṇye̱ yatsa̱bhāyā̱ṃ yadi̍ndri̱ye | yacchū̱dre yada̱rye yadena̍ścakṛ̱mā va̱yam yadeka̍syādhi̱ dharme̍ṇi̱ tasyā̍vaya̱rjana̍masi yadāpo̍ a̱ghnyā iti̱ varu̍ṇeti̱ śapā̍mahe̱ tato̍ varuṇa no muñca ava̍bhṛtha nicumpuṇa nice̱rura̍si nicumpuṇaḥ ava̍de̱vairde̱vakṛ̍ta̱meno̍'yakṣya̱va̱ martyai̱rmartya̍kṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva ri̱ṣaspā̍hi sa̱mu̱dre te̱ hṛda̍yama̱psvanta: saṃ tvā̍ṃ viśantvoṣa̍dhīru̱tāpa̍: su̱mi̱triyā na̱ āpa̱ oṣa̍dhayaḥ santu durmi̱triyāstasmai̍ santu | yo'smāndveṣṭi̱ yaṃ ca̍ va̱yaṃ dvi̱ṣmaḥ
191.d: यद् ग्रा̱मे यदर̍ण्ये̱ यत्स̱भाया̱ं यदि̍न्द्रि̱ये । यच्छू̱द्रे यद̱र्ये यदेन̍श्चकृ̱मा व̱यम् यदेक̍स्याधि̱ धर्मे̍णि̱ तस्या̍वय̱र्जन̍मसि यदापो̍ अ̱घ्न्या इति̱ वरु̍णेति̱ शपा̍महे̱ ततो̍ वरुण नो मुञ्च अव̍भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे̱रुर̍सि निचुम्पुणः अव̍दे̱वैर्दे̱वकृ̍त̱मेनो̍ऽयक्ष्य̱व̱ मर्त्यै̱र्मर्त्य̍कृतं पुरुराव्णो देव रि̱षस्पा̍हि स̱मु̱द्रे ते̱ हृद̍यम̱प्स्वन्त: सं त्वा̍ं विशन्त्वोष̍धीरु̱ताप̍: सु̱मि̱त्रिया न̱ आप̱ ओष̍धयः सन्तु दुर्मि̱त्रियास्तस्मै̍ सन्तु । योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि̱ यं च̍ व̱यं द्वि̱ष्मः
191.m: Whatever sin we have committed in the village, in the forest, in the assembly, in sense-faculty, / whatever against a Śūdra, whatever against an Arya, / whatever against the duty of one another—you are the expiation thereof. / When we curse, saying, "The waters are not to be slain," "Varuṇa!"—release us from that, O Varuṇa. / O purifying bath, trickling softly, you move below, trickling softly. / The sin committed against gods by gods you have cast away, the sin committed by mortals against mortals; protect us, O god, from harm by the loud-shouting one. / In the ocean is your heart, within the waters; let the plants and waters enter you. / May the waters and plants be friendly to us; may they be unfriendly to him who hates us and whom we hate.

191.s: dru̱pa̱dādi̍va mumucā̱naḥ svi̱nnaḥ snā̱to malā̍diva | pū̱taṃ pa̱vitre̍ṇe̱vājya̱māpa̍: śundhantu̱ maina̍saḥ
191.d: द्रु̱प̱दादि̍व मुमुचा̱नः स्वि̱न्नः स्ना̱तो मला̍दिव । पू̱तं प̱वित्रे̍णे̱वाज्य̱माप̍: शुन्धन्तु̱ मैन̍सः
191.m: As one released from the wooden post, as one sweating and cleansed from dirt by bathing, / like clarified butter purified by the strainer, let the waters cleanse me of sin.

191.s: udva̱yaṃ tama̍sa̱spari̱ svaḥ paśya̍nta̱ utta̍ram | de̱vaṃ de̍va̱trā sūrya̱maga̍nma̱ jyoti̍rutta̱mam
191.d: उद्व̱यं तम̍स̱स्परि̱ स्वः पश्य̍न्त̱ उत्त̍रम् । दे̱वं दे̍व̱त्रा सूर्य̱मग̍न्म̱ ज्योति̍रुत्त̱मम्
191.m: Beholding the higher light beyond the darkness, / we have reached the sun, a god among gods, the highest light.

191.s: a̱po a̱dyānva̍cāriṣa̱m̐ rase̍na̱ sama̍sṛkṣmahi paya̍svānagna̱ āga̍ma̱ṃ taṃ mā̱ sam̐ sṛ̍ja̱ varca̍sā pra̱jayā̍ ca̱ dhane̍na ca edho̍'syedhiṣī̱mahi̍ sa̱mida̍si tejo̍'si̱ tejo̱ mayi̍ dhehi
191.d: अ̱पो अ̱द्यान्व̍चारिष̱म्̐ रसे̍न̱ सम̍सृक्ष्महि पय̍स्वानग्न̱ आग̍म̱ं तं मा̱ सम्̐ सृ̍ज̱ वर्च̍सा प्र̱जया̍ च̱ धने̍न च एधो̍ऽस्येधिषी̱महि̍ स̱मिद̍सि तेजो̍ऽसि̱ तेजो̱ मयि̍ धेहि
191.m: I have gone after the waters today, we have united with their essence; / rich in sap, O Agni, I have come; unite me with brilliance, with offspring, and with wealth. / You are kindling-wood: may we thrive! You are fuel; you are fiery energy: place fiery energy in me.

191.s:
sa̱māva̍varti pṛthi̱vī samu̱ṣāḥ samu̱ sūrya̍: | samu̱ viśva̍mi̱daṃ jaga̍t vai̱śvā̱na̱rajyo̍tirbhūyāsaṃ vibhūnkāmānvya̍śnavai̱ bhūḥ svāhā̍
(1)
191.d:
स̱माव̍वर्ति पृथि̱वी समु̱षाः समु̱ सूर्य̍: । समु̱ विश्व̍मि̱दं जग̍त् वै̱श्वा̱न̱रज्यो̍तिर्भूयासं विभून्कामान्व्य̍श्नवै̱ भूः स्वाहा̍
(1)
191.m: The earth rolls round, and the Dawn, and the Sun, and all this moving world; / may I become the light of Vaiśvānara, may I attain all desires: bhūḥ svāhā!

192.s: a̱gnyā da̍dhāmi sa̱midha̱magne̍ vratapate̱ tvayi̍ | vra̱taṃ ca̍ śra̱ddhāṃ co̱paimīndhe tvā̍ dīkṣi̱to a̱ham
192.d: अ̱ग्न्या द̍धामि स̱मिध̱मग्ने̍ व्रतपते̱ त्वयि̍ । व्र̱तं च̍ श्र̱द्धां चो̱पैमीन्धे त्वा̍ दीक्षि̱तो अ̱हम्
192.m: I place the fuel upon you, O Agni, lord of vows; / I take upon myself the vow and faith; consecrated, I kindle you.

192.s: yatra̱ brahma̍ ca kṣa̱traṃ ca̍ sa̱myañcau̱ cara̍taḥ sa̱ha | taṃ lo̱kaṃ pu̱ṇyaṃ pra̱jñeṣa̱ṃ yatra̍ de̱vāḥ sa̱hāgninā̍
192.d: यत्र̱ ब्रह्म̍ च क्ष̱त्रं च̍ स̱म्यञ्चौ̱ चर̍तः स̱ह । तं लो̱कं पु̱ण्यं प्र̱ज्ञेष̱ं यत्र̍ दे̱वाः स̱हाग्निना̍
192.m: Where both sacred formulation and princely power move together in harmony, / that auspicious world would I recognize, where the gods [dwell] together with Agni.

192.s: yatrendra̍śca vā̱yuśca̍ sa̱myañcau̱ cara̍taḥ sa̱ha | taṃ lo̱kaṃ pu̱ṇyaṃ pra̱jñeṣa̱ṃ yatra̍ sedi̱rna vi̱dyate̍
192.d: यत्रेन्द्र̍श्च वा̱युश्च̍ स̱म्यञ्चौ̱ चर̍तः स̱ह । तं लो̱कं पु̱ण्यं प्र̱ज्ञेष̱ं यत्र̍ सेदि̱र्न वि̱द्यते̍
192.m: Where Indra and Vāyu move together in harmony, / that auspicious world would I recognize, where distress is not found.

192.s: a̱m̐śunā̍ te a̱m̐śuḥ pṛ̍cyatā̱ṃ paru̍ṣā̱ paru̍: | ga̱ndhaste̱ soma̍mavatu madā̍ya̱ raso̱ acyu̍taḥ
192.d: अ̱म्̐शुना̍ ते अ̱म्̐शुः पृ̍च्यता̱ं परु̍षा̱ परु̍: । ग̱न्धस्ते̱ सोम̍मवतु मदा̍य̱ रसो̱ अच्यु̍तः
192.m:
Let shoot join with shoot of yours, joint with joint.
Let your fragrance favor Soma for intoxication, the unyielding sap.

192.s: siñca̍nti pari̍ṣiñcantyutsi̍ñcanti punanti̍ ca | su̱rāyai̍ ba̱bhravai̍ ma̱dai kintvo va̍dati̱ kintvaḥ
192.d: सिञ्च̍न्ति परि̍षिञ्चन्त्युत्सि̍ञ्चन्ति पुनन्ति̍ च । सु̱रायै̍ ब̱भ्रवै̍ म̱दै किन्त्वो व̍दति̱ किन्त्वः
192.m:
They pour in, they pour around, they ladle out, and they purify.
In the intoxication of tawny surā, what does one say? What does he speak?

With roasted grains, groats, barley cake, and recitation,
Indra, be pleased with ours at morning.

192.s: bṛ̱hadindrā̍ya gāyata̱ maru̍to vṛtra̱hanta̍mam yena̱ jyoti̍raja̍nayannṛ̱tāvṛdho̍ de̱vaṃ de̱vāya̱ jāgṛ̍vi
192.d: बृ̱हदिन्द्रा̍य गायत̱ मरु̍तो वृत्र̱हन्त̍मम् येन̱ ज्योति̍रज̍नयन्नृ̱तावृधो̍ दे̱वं दे̱वाय̱ जागृ̍वि
192.m:
Sing the bṛhat chant to Indra, O Maruts, the best slayer of Vṛtra,
By which the increasers of truth produced the light, the watchful god for the god.

192.s: adhva̍ryo adri̍bhiḥ su̱tam̐ so̱maṃ pa̱vitra̱ ā na̍ya | pu̱nī̱hīndrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve
192.d: अध्व̍र्यो अद्रि̍भिः सु̱तम्̐ सो̱मं प̱वित्र̱ आ न̍य । पु̱नी̱हीन्द्रा̍य̱ पात̍वे
192.m:
O Adhvaryu, bring to the strainer the Soma pressed with stones;
Purify [it] for Indra to drink.

193.s: (2) yo bhū̱tānā̱madhi̍pati̱ryasmi̍m̐llo̱kā adhi̍ śri̱tāḥ ya īśe̍ maha̱to ma̱hām̐stena̍ gṛhṇāmi tvāma̱haṃ mayi̍ gṛhṇāmi tvāma̱ham
193.d: (2) यो भू̱ताना̱मधि̍पति̱र्यस्मि̍म्̐ल्लो̱का अधि̍ श्रि̱ताः य ईशे̍ मह̱तो म̱हाम्̐स्तेन̍ गृह्णामि त्वाम̱हं मयि̍ गृह्णामि त्वाम̱हम्
193.m:
He who is the overlord of beings, in whom the worlds are fixed,
Who rules the great, himself great—by that I take you; in myself I take you.

193.s: u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sya̱śvibhyā̍ṃ tvā̱ sara̍svatyai tvendrā̍ya tvā sutrā̱mṇe e̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍ra̱śvibhyā̍ṃ tvā̱ sara̍svatyai tvendrā̍ya tvā sutrā̱mṇe
193.d: उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽस्य̱श्विभ्या̍ं त्वा̱ सर̍स्वत्यै त्वेन्द्रा̍य त्वा सुत्रा̱म्णे ए̱ष ते̱ योनि̍र̱श्विभ्या̍ं त्वा̱ सर̍स्वत्यै त्वेन्द्रा̍य त्वा सुत्रा̱म्णे
193.m:
You are taken with a support; for the two Aśvins [I take] you, for Sarasvatī you, for Indra the good protector you.
This is your womb; for the two Aśvins [I take] you, for Sarasvatī you, for Indra the good protector you.

193.s: prā̱ṇapā me̍ apā̱napāśca̍kṣuṣpāḥ śro̍tra̱pāśca̍ me | vā̱co me̍ vi̱śvabhai̍ṣajo mana̍so'si vilāya̍kaḥ
193.d: प्रा̱णपा मे̍ अपा̱नपाश्च̍क्षुष्पाः श्रो̍त्र̱पाश्च̍ मे । वा̱चो मे̍ वि̱श्वभै̍षजो मन̍सोऽसि विलाय̍कः
193.m:
You are the protector of my in-breath, the protector of my down-breath, the protector of my sight, and the protector of my hearing;
The all-healing of my speech, you are the liquefier of my mind.

193.s: a̱śvina̍kṛtasya te̱ sara̍svatikṛta̱syendre̍ṇa sutrā̱mṇā kṛ̱tasya̍ | upa̍hūta̱ upa̍hūtasya bhakṣayāmi
193.d: अ̱श्विन̍कृतस्य ते̱ सर̍स्वतिकृत̱स्येन्द्रे̍ण सुत्रा̱म्णा कृ̱तस्य̍ । उप̍हूत̱ उप̍हूतस्य भक्षयामि
193.m:
Of you, made by the Aśvins, made by Sarasvatī, made by Indra the good protector,
Being invited, of the invited I partake.

194.s: (3)20 sami̍ddha̱ indra̍ u̱ṣasā̱manī̍ke pu̱rorucā̍ pūrva̱kṛdvā̍vṛdhānaḥ tri̱bhirde̱vaistrim̐śatā vajra̍bāhurja̱ghāna̍ vṛ̱traṃ vi duro̍ vavāra
194.d: (3)20 समि̍द्ध̱ इन्द्र̍ उ̱षसा̱मनी̍के पु̱रोरुचा̍ पूर्व̱कृद्वा̍वृधानः त्रि̱भिर्दे̱वैस्त्रिम्̐शता वज्र̍बाहुर्ज̱घान̍ वृ̱त्रं वि दुरो̍ ववार
194.m:
Kindled Indra, with the troop of Dawns, before the beam of light, the ancient creator, having grown,
With thirty-three gods, thunderbolt in hand, struck Vṛtra, and opened the doors wide.

194.s: narāśam̐saḥ prati śūro mimā̍na̱stanū̱napā̱tprati̍ ya̱jñasya̱ dhāma̍ go̱bhirvapāvā̱nmadhu̍nā sama̱ñjan hira̍ṇyaiśca̱ndrī ya̍jati prace̍tāḥ
194.d: नराशम्̐सः प्रति शूरो मिमा̍न̱स्तनू̱नपा̱त्प्रति̍ य̱ज्ञस्य̱ धाम̍ गो̱भिर्वपावा̱न्मधु̍ना सम̱ञ्जन् हिर̍ण्यैश्च̱न्द्री य̍जति प्रचे̍ताः
194.m:
Narāśaṃsa, measuring against [each], the hero Tanūnapāt against the sacrificial abode,
Possessed of the omentum, anointing with milk [and] honey, shining with golden ornaments, the wise one sacrifices.

194.s: īḷi̱to de̱vairhari̍vām̐2 a̱bhiṣṭi̱rājuhvā̍no ha̱viṣā̱ śardha̍mānaḥ pura̍nda̱ro go̍tra̱bhidvajra̍bāhu̱rā yā̍tu ya̱jñamupa̍ no juṣā̱ṇaḥ
194.d: ईऌइ̱तो दे̱वैर्हरि̍वाम्̐2 अ̱भिष्टि̱राजुह्वा̍नो ह̱विषा̱ शर्ध̍मानः पुर̍न्द̱रो गो̍त्र̱भिद्वज्र̍बाहु̱रा या̍तु य̱ज्ञमुप̍ नो जुषा̱णः
194.m:
Praised by the gods, possessing bay horses, assisting, being invoked, strengthening himself with the oblation,
Sack of strongholds, splitter of cow-pens, thunderbolt in hand, let him come to our sacrifice, being pleased.

194.s: juṣā̱ṇo ba̱rhirhari̍vān indra̍ḥ prācī̱nam̐ sīdatpra̱diśā̍ pṛthi̱vyāḥ u̱ruprathāḥ pratha̍mānam̐ syo̱namā̍di̱tyairu̱ktaṃ vasu̍bhiḥ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ
194.d: जुषा̱णो ब̱र्हिर्हरि̍वान् इन्द्र̍ः प्राची̱नम्̐ सीदत्प्र̱दिशा̍ पृथि̱व्याः उ̱रुप्रथाः प्रथ̍मानम्̐ स्यो̱नमा̍दि̱त्यैरु̱क्तं वसु̍भिः स̱जोषा̍ः
194.m:
Indra, taking pleasure in the barhis, possessing bay horses, let him sit facing east according to the direction of the earth,
Extending far, wide-spreading, gentle, anointed by the Ādityas, harmonious with the Vasus.

194.s: indra̱ṃ dura̍ḥ ka̱vaṣyo̍ dhāva̍mānā̱ vṛṣā̍ṇaṃ yantu jana̍yaḥ supatnī̍ḥ dvāro̍ de̱vīra̱bhito̱ vi śra̍yantām̐ suvī̱rā vī̱raṃ pratha̍mānā ma̱hobhi̍ḥ
194.d: इन्द्र̱ं दुर̍ः क̱वष्यो̍ धाव̍माना̱ वृषा̍णं यन्तु जन̍यः सुपत्नी̍ः द्वारो̍ दे̱वीर̱भितो̱ वि श्र̍यन्ताम्̐ सुवी̱रा वी̱रं प्रथ̍माना म̱होभि̍ः
194.m:
Let the doors, opening wide, running, go to the bull Indra, like wives having good husbands;
Let the divine doors open apart on all sides, rich in heroes, for the hero, spreading out with greatness.

194.s: u̱ṣāsā̱naktā̍ bṛha̱tī bṛhanta̍ṃ paya̍svatī su̱dughe̱ śūra̱mindra̍m tantu̍ṃ ta̱taṃ peśa̍sā sa̱ṃvaya̍ntī de̱vānā̍ṃ de̱vaṃ ya̍jataḥ su̱rukme
194.d: उ̱षासा̱नक्ता̍ बृह̱ती बृहन्त̍ं पय̍स्वती सु̱दुघे̱ शूर̱मिन्द्र̍म् तन्तु̍ं त̱तं पेश̍सा स̱ंवय̍न्ती दे̱वाना̍ं दे̱वं य̍जतः सु̱रुक्मे
194.m:
Dawn and Night, the lofty ones, [nourishing] the lofty one, full of milk, easily milked, [cherishing] the hero Indra,
Weaving together the stretched thread with ornament, worshipping the god of gods, beautifully adorned.

194.s: daivyā̱ mimā̍nā manu̍ṣaḥ puru̱trā hotā̍rā̱ indra̍ṃ pratha̱mā suvācā̍ mūrdha̱nyajñasya̱ madhu̍nā dadhā̍nā prācī̱naṃ jyoti̍rha̱viṣā̍ vṛdhāta:
194.d: दैव्या̱ मिमा̍ना मनु̍षः पुरु̱त्रा होता̍रा̱ इन्द्र̍ं प्रथ̱मा सुवाचा̍ मूर्ध̱न्यज्ञस्य̱ मधु̍ना दधा̍ना प्राची̱नं ज्योति̍र्ह̱विषा̍ वृधात:
194.m:
The two divine Hotṛs, measuring among men in many places, first with sweet speech for Indra,
Placing [it] on the head of the sacrifice with honey, facing east, let the two strengthen the light with the oblation.

194.s: ti̱sro de̱vīrha̱viṣā̱ vardha̍mānā̱ indra̍ṃ juṣā̱ṇā jana̍yo na patnī̍ḥ acchi̍nna̱ṃ tantu̱ṃ paya̍sā̱ sara̍sva̱tīḷā̍ de̱vī bhāra̍tī vi̱śvatūrtiḥ
194.d: ति̱स्रो दे̱वीर्ह̱विषा̱ वर्ध̍माना̱ इन्द्र̍ं जुषा̱णा जन̍यो न पत्नी̍ः अच्छि̍न्न̱ं तन्तु̱ं पय̍सा̱ सर̍स्व̱तीऌआ̍ दे̱वी भार̍ती वि̱श्वतूर्तिः
194.m:
The three goddesses growing strong through the oblation, delighting in Indra like wives in their husbands,
[Hold] the unbroken thread with milk: Sarasvatī, the goddess Iḷā, and Bhāratī all-overcoming.

194.s: tvaṣṭā̱ dadha̍cchu̱ṣmamindrā̍ya̱ vṛṣṇe'pā̍koci̱ṣṭuryaśa̍se purū̱ṇi vṛṣā̱ yaja̍nvṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṃ bhūri̍retā mū̱rdhanya̱jñasya̱ sama̍naktu de̱vān
194.d: त्वष्टा̱ दध̍च्छु̱ष्ममिन्द्रा̍य̱ वृष्णेऽपा̍कोचि̱ष्टुर्यश̍से पुरू̱णि वृषा̱ यज̍न्वृष̍ण̱ं भूरि̍रेता मू̱र्धन्य̱ज्ञस्य̱ सम̍नक्तु दे̱वान्
194.m:
Tvaṣṭṛ, bestowing vigor upon the bull Indra—near, swift, for glory, many [things]—
The bull sacrificing to the bull, of abundant seed, let him anoint the gods on the head of the sacrifice.

194.s: vana̱spati̍ravasṛ̱ṣṭo na pāśai̱stamanyā̍ sama̱ñjanccha̍mitā na de̱vaḥ indra̍sya ha̱vyairja̱ṭhara̍ṃ pṛṇā̱naḥ svadā̍ti ya̱jñaṃ madhu̍nā ghṛ̱tena̍
194.d: वन̱स्पति̍रवसृ̱ष्टो न पाशै̱स्तमन्या̍ सम̱ञ्जन्च्छ̍मिता न दे̱वः इन्द्र̍स्य ह̱व्यैर्ज̱ठर̍ं पृणा̱नः स्वदा̍ति य̱ज्ञं मधु̍ना घृ̱तेन̍
194.m:
The lord of the forest, as if released from bonds, himself anointing like a divine quietener,
Filling the belly of Indra with offerings, will season the sacrifice with honey and ghee.

194.s: sto̱kānā̍mindu̱ṃ prati̱ śūra̱ indro̍ vṛṣā̱yamā̍ṇo vṛṣa̱bhastu̍rā̱ṣāṭ ghṛ̱tapruṣā̱ mana̍sā̱ moda̍mānāḥ svāhā̍ de̱vā a̱mṛtā̍ mādayantām
194.d: स्तो̱काना̍मिन्दु̱ं प्रति̱ शूर̱ इन्द्रो̍ वृषा̱यमा̍णो वृष̱भस्तु̍रा̱षाट् घृ̱तप्रुषा̱ मन̍सा̱ मोद̍मानाः स्वाहा̍ दे̱वा अ̱मृता̍ मादयन्ताम्
194.m:
Unto the drop of the tricklings, the heroic Indra, acting as a bull, the bull victorious in combat—
With minds dripping with ghee, rejoicing, svāhā! let the immortal gods exhilarate themselves.

195.s: (4) ā yā̍tvindro'va̍sa̱ upa̍ na i̱ha stu̱taḥ sa̍dha̱māda̍stu̱ śūra̍ḥ vāvṛ̱dhānastavi̍ṣī̱ryasya̍ pū̱rvīdyaurna kṣa̱trama̱bhibhū̍ti puṣyā̍t
195.d: (4) आ या̍त्विन्द्रोऽव̍स̱ उप̍ न इ̱ह स्तु̱तः स̍ध̱माद̍स्तु̱ शूर̍ः वावृ̱धानस्तवि̍षी̱र्यस्य̍ पू̱र्वीद्यौर्न क्ष̱त्रम̱भिभू̍ति पुष्या̍त्
195.m:
Let Indra come here to our aid, being praised; let the hero partake in our feast,
Having grown strong, he whose powers are ancient; like heaven, let him foster overpowering princely power.

195.s: ā na̱ indro̍ dū̱rādā na̍ ā̱sāda̱bhiṣṭi̍kṛ̱dava̍se yāsadu̱graḥ oji̍ṣṭhebhirnṛ̱pati̱rvajra̍bāhuḥ sa̱ṃge sa̱matsu̍ turva̱ṇiḥ pṛta̱nyūn
195.d: आ न̱ इन्द्रो̍ दू̱रादा न̍ आ̱साद̱भिष्टि̍कृ̱दव̍से यासदु̱ग्रः ओजि̍ष्ठेभिर्नृ̱पति̱र्वज्र̍बाहुः स̱ंगे स̱मत्सु̍ तुर्व̱णिः पृत̱न्यून्
195.m:
May Indra come to our aid from afar, may he come from near, he who brings help, the fierce one,
With the strongest [followers], the ruler of men, thunderbolt in hand, victorious in battle, in combats, overcoming the hostile armies.

195.s: ā na̱ indro̱ hari̍bhiryātvacchā̍rvācī̱no'va̍se̱ rādha̍se ca tiṣṭhā̍ti va̱jrī ma̱ghavā̍ vi̱rapśīmaṃ ya̱jñamanu̍ no vā̱jasā̍tau
195.d: आ न̱ इन्द्रो̱ हरि̍भिर्यात्वच्छा̍र्वाची̱नोऽव̍से̱ राध̍से च तिष्ठा̍ति व̱ज्री म̱घवा̍ वि̱रप्शीमं य̱ज्ञमनु̍ नो वा̱जसा̍तौ
195.m:
Let Indra come to us with his bay horses, turned toward us for aid and for wealth;
May the wielder of the thunderbolt, the bountiful, the exuberant one, stand by this sacrifice of ours in the winning of vigor.

195.s: trā̱tāra̱mindra̍mavi̱tāra̱mindra̱m̐ have̍have su̱hava̱m̐ śūra̱mindra̍m hvayā̍mi śa̱kraṃ pu̍ruhū̱tamindra̱m̐ sva̱sti no̍ ma̱ghavā̍ dhātvindra̍ḥ
195.d: त्रा̱तार̱मिन्द्र̍मवि̱तार̱मिन्द्र̱म्̐ हवे̍हवे सु̱हव̱म्̐ शूर̱मिन्द्र̍म् ह्वया̍मि श̱क्रं पु̍रुहू̱तमिन्द्र̱म्̐ स्व̱स्ति नो̍ म̱घवा̍ धात्विन्द्र̍ः
195.m:
Indra the protector, Indra the helper, Indra who is easily invoked at every call, the hero Indra,
I invoke Śakra, the much-invoked Indra; may bountiful Indra grant us welfare.

195.s: indra̍ḥ su̱trāmā̱ svavā̱m̐2 avo̍bhiḥ sumṛḍī̱ko bha̍vatu vi̱śvave̍dāḥ bādha̍tā̱ṃ dveṣo̱ abha̍yaṃ kṛṇotu suvī̱rya̍sya̱ pata̍yaḥ syāma
195.d: इन्द्र̍ः सु̱त्रामा̱ स्ववा̱म्̐2 अवो̍भिः सुमृडी̱को भ̍वतु वि̱श्ववे̍दाः बाध̍ता̱ं द्वेषो̱ अभ̍यं कृणोतु सुवी̱र्य̍स्य̱ पत̍यः स्याम
195.m:
May Indra, the good protector, possessed of his own power through aids, be most gracious, all-knowing;
May he ward off hatred, make safety; may we be masters of good heroes.

195.s: tasya̍ va̱yam̐ su̍ma̱tau ya̱jñiya̍syāpi̍ bha̱dre sau̍mana̱se syā̍ma sa su̱trāmā̱ svavā̱m̐2 indro̍ a̱sme ā̱rācci̱d dveṣa̍ḥ sanuta̱ryuyotu
195.d: तस्य̍ व̱यम्̐ सु̍म̱तौ य̱ज्ञिय̍स्यापि̍ भ̱द्रे सौ̍मन̱से स्या̍म स सु̱त्रामा̱ स्ववा̱म्̐2 इन्द्रो̍ अ̱स्मे आ̱राच्चि̱द् द्वेष̍ः सनुत̱र्युयोतु
195.m:
May we be in the favor of him who is worthy of sacrifice, and in his auspicious benevolence;
May that Indra, the good protector, possessed of his own power, keep enmity far away from us, out of sight.

195.s: ā ma̱ndrairi̍ndra̱ hari̍bhiryā̱hi ma̱yūra̍romabhiḥ mā tvā̱ ke ci̱nni ya̍ma̱nvi na pā̱śino'ti̱ dhanve̍va̱ tām̐2 i̍hi
195.d: आ म̱न्द्रैरि̍न्द्र̱ हरि̍भिर्या̱हि म̱यूर̍रोमभिः मा त्वा̱ के चि̱न्नि य̍म̱न्वि न पा̱शिनोऽति̱ धन्वे̍व̱ ताम्̐2 इ̍हि
195.m:
Come, O Indra, with your pleasant bay steeds that have peacock-plumes;
Let no people hold you back like bird-catchers with snares; pass beyond them as across a desert.

195.s: e̱vedindra̱ṃ vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṃ vajra̍bāhuṃ vasi̍ṣṭhāso a̱bhya̍rcantyu̱kthaiḥ sa na̍ stu̱to vī̱rava̍ddhā̱tu goma̍dyū̱yaṃ pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ
195.d: ए̱वेदिन्द्र̱ं वृष̍ण̱ं वज्र̍बाहुं वसि̍ष्ठासो अ̱भ्य̍र्चन्त्यु̱क्थैः स न̍ स्तु̱तो वी̱रव̍द्धा̱तु गोम̍द्यू̱यं पा̍त स्व̱स्तिभि̱ः सदा̍ नः
195.m:
Thus the Vasiṣṭhas praise Indra the bull, the thunderbolt-armed, with chants;
Praised, may he grant us heroic sons and cattle. Do you protect us ever with blessings.

196.s: (5) sami̍ddho a̱gnira̱śvinā̍ ta̱pto gha̱rmo vi̱rāṭ su̱taḥ du̱he dhe̱nuḥ sara̍svatī̱ soma̍m̐ śu̱krami̱hendri̱yam
196.d: (5) समि̍द्धो अ̱ग्निर̱श्विना̍ त̱प्तो घ̱र्मो वि̱राट् सु̱तः दु̱हे धे̱नुः सर̍स्वती̱ सोम̍म्̐ शु̱क्रमि̱हेन्द्रि̱यम्
196.m:
Agni is kindled, O Aśvins; the hot offering is heated; the radiant [Soma] is pressed;
The cow Sarasvatī yields Soma, the bright Indra-power here.

196.s: ta̱nū̱pā bhi̱ṣajā̍ su̱te'śvino̱bhā sara̍svatī | ma̱dhvā rajā̍ṃm̐sīndri̱yamindrā̍ya pa̱thibhi̍rvahān
196.d: त̱नू̱पा भि̱षजा̍ सु̱तेऽश्विनो̱भा सर̍स्वती । म̱ध्वा रजा̍ंम्̐सीन्द्रि̱यमिन्द्रा̍य प̱थिभि̍र्वहान्
196.m:
The two body-protecting healers at the pressing, both Aśvins and Sarasvatī,
Carry with honey through the spaces the Indra-power to Indra along the paths.

196.s: indrā̱yendu̱m̐ sara̍svatī narāśa̱ṃsena̍ na̱gnahu̍m adhā̍tāma̱śvinā̱ madhu̍ bhe̱ṣa̱jaṃ bhi̱ṣajā̍ su̱te
196.d: इन्द्रा̱येन्दु̱म्̐ सर̍स्वती नराश̱ंसेन̍ न̱ग्नहु̍म् अधा̍ताम̱श्विना̱ मधु̍ भे̱ष̱जं भि̱षजा̍ सु̱ते
196.m:
For Indra, Sarasvatī with Narāśaṃsa [brought] the drop, yeast [with the drink];
The two Aśvins, the two healers, placed honey as medicine at the pressing.

196.s: ā̱juhvā̍nā sara̍svatīndrāyendri̱yāṇi̍ vī̱rya̍m | iḷā̍bhira̱śvinā̱ iṣa̱m̐ samūrja̱m̐ sam̐ ra̱yiṃ da̍dhuḥ
196.d: आ̱जुह्वा̍ना सर̍स्वतीन्द्रायेन्द्रि̱याणि̍ वी̱र्य̍म् । इऌआ̍भिर̱श्विना̱ इष̱म्̐ समूर्ज̱म्̐ सम्̐ र̱यिं द̍धुः
196.m:
Being invoked, Sarasvatī [brought] Indra-powers and vigor for Indra;
With refreshments, the two Aśvins placed nourishment together, strength together, wealth together.

196.s: a̱śvinā̱ namu̍ceḥ su̱tam̐ soma̱m̐ śu̱kraṃ pari̍srutā̍ | sara̍svatī̱ tamā bha̍ra̱dvarhi̱pendrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve
196.d: अ̱श्विना̱ नमु̍चेः सु̱तम्̐ सोम̱म्̐ शु̱क्रं परि̍स्रुता̍ । सर̍स्वती̱ तमा भ̍र̱द्वर्हि̱पेन्द्रा̍य̱ पात̍वे
196.m:
O Aśvins, the pressed Soma, bright, with the surā of Namuci,
Sarasvatī brought it upon the barhis for Indra to drink.

196.s: kṛ̱va̱ṣyo na vya̍casvatīra̱śvibhyā̱ṃ na duro̱ diśa̍ḥ indro̱ na roda̍sī u̱bhe du̱he kāmā̍ntsara̍svatī
196.d: कृ̱व̱ष्यो न व्य̍चस्वतीर̱श्विभ्या̱ं न दुरो̱ दिश̍ः इन्द्रो̱ न रोद̍सी उ̱भे दु̱हे कामा̍न्त्सर̍स्वती
196.m:
Like wide-opening folding doors for the two Aśvins, like doors the quarters of space,
Like Indra both rodasi, Sarasvatī milks out wishes.

196.s: u̱pā̱sā̱nakta̍ma̱śvinā̱ divendre̱m̐ sā̱yami̍ndri̱yaiḥ | sa̱ṃjānā̍ne su̱peśa̍sā̱ sama̍ñjāte̱ sara̍svatyā
196.d: उ̱पा̱सा̱नक्त̍म̱श्विना̱ दिवेन्द्रे̱म्̐ सा̱यमि̍न्द्रि̱यैः । स̱ंजाना̍ने सु̱पेश̍सा̱ सम̍ञ्जाते̱ सर̍स्वत्या
196.m:
Dawn and Night, O Aśvins, Indra by day and in the evening with Indra-powers,
Harmonious, well-adorned, anoint [him] together with Sarasvatī.

196.s: pā̱taṃ nau̍ a̱śvinā̱ divā̍ pā̱hi nakta̱ṃm̐ sara̍svati daivyā̍ hotā̍rā bhi̱ṣajā̍ pā̱tamindra̱m̐ sacā̍ su̱te
196.d: पा̱तं नौ̍ अ̱श्विना̱ दिवा̍ पा̱हि नक्त̱ंम्̐ सर̍स्वति दैव्या̍ होता̍रा भि̱षजा̍ पा̱तमिन्द्र̱म्̐ सचा̍ सु̱ते
196.m:
Protect us by day, O Aśvins; protect [us] by night, O Sarasvatī!
O divine Hotṛ priests, physicians, protect Indra along with the pressed [Soma]!

196.s: ti̱srastre̱dhā sara̍svatya̱śvinā̱ bhāra̍tīḷā̍ | tī̱vraṃ pari̍srutā̱ soma̱mindrā̍ya suṣuvu̱rmada̍m
196.d: ति̱स्रस्त्रे̱धा सर̍स्वत्य̱श्विना̱ भार̍तीऌआ̍ । ती̱व्रं परि̍स्रुता̱ सोम̱मिन्द्रा̍य सुषुवु̱र्मद̍म्
196.m:
The three, threefold, Sarasvatī, the Aśvins, Bhāratī, and Iḷā,
pressed the sharp Soma, the intoxicating drink, from the liquor for Indra.

196.s: a̱śvinā̍ bhe̱ṣaja̱ṃ madhu̍ bhe̱ṣaja̱ṃ naḥ sara̍svatī | indre̱ tvaṣṭā̱ yaśa̱ḥ śriya̍m̐ rū̱pam̐rū̍pamadhuḥ su̱te
196.d: अ̱श्विना̍ भे̱षज̱ं मधु̍ भे̱षज̱ं नः सर̍स्वती । इन्द्रे̱ त्वष्टा̱ यश̱ः श्रिय̍म्̐ रू̱पम्̐रू̍पमधुः सु̱ते
196.m:
The Aśvins are medicine; Sarasvatī is medicine for us, honey.
Tvaṣṭṛ, in Indra, placed splendor, beauty, form upon form, in the pressed [Soma].

196.s: ṛ̱tuthendro̱ vana̱spati̍ḥ śaśamā̱naḥ pari̍srutā̍ | kī̱lā̱la̱ma̱śvibhyā̱ṃ madhu̍ du̱he dhe̱nuḥ sara̍svatī
196.d: ऋ̱तुथेन्द्रो̱ वन̱स्पति̍ः शशमा̱नः परि̍स्रुता̍ । की̱ला̱ल̱म̱श्विभ्या̱ं मधु̍ दु̱हे धे̱नुः सर̍स्वती
196.m:
Seasonably, Indra, the lord of the forest, laboring with liquor,
yields sweet food, honey, for the Aśvins—Sarasvatī the milch cow.

196.s: gobhi̱rna soma̍ma̱śvinā̱ māsa̍reṇa̱ pari̍srutā̍ | sama̍dhātm̐ sara̍svatyā̱ svāhendre̍ su̱taṃ madhu̍
196.d: गोभि̱र्न सोम̍म̱श्विना̱ मास̍रेण̱ परि̍स्रुता̍ । सम̍धात्म्̐ सर̍स्वत्या̱ स्वाहेन्द्रे̍ सु̱तं मधु̍
196.m:
As with cows, O Aśvins, [mix] the Soma with māsara, with liquor!
Along with Sarasvatī, svāhā, you placed the sweet pressed [drink] into Indra.

197.s: a̱śvinā̍ ha̱viri̍ndri̱yaṃ namu̍cerdhi̱yā sara̍svatī | ā śu̱kramā̍surā̱dvasu̍ ma̱ghamindrā̍ya jaghnire
197.d: अ̱श्विना̍ ह̱विरि̍न्द्रि̱यं नमु̍चेर्धि̱या सर̍स्वती । आ शु̱क्रमा̍सुरा̱द्वसु̍ म̱घमिन्द्रा̍य जघ्निरे
197.m:
The Aśvins [brought] the offering, Indra's power, through poetic vision Sarasvatī,
from Namuci the Asura they brought the bright wealth, the prize, for Indra.

197.s: yama̱śvinā̱ sara̍svatī ha̱viṣendre̱mava̍rdhayan | sa bi̍bheda va̱laṃ ma̱ghaṃ namu̍cā āsu̱re sacā̍
197.d: यम̱श्विना̱ सर̍स्वती ह̱विषेन्द्रे̱मव̍र्धयन् । स बि̍भेद व̱लं म̱घं नमु̍चा आसु̱रे सचा̍
197.m:
Whom the Aśvins and Sarasvatī magnified with the oblation, [namely] Indra,
he split Vala and the prize, along with Namuci the Asura.

197.s: tamindra̍ṃ pa̱śava̱ḥ sacā̱śvino̱bhā sara̍svatī | dadhā̍nā a̱bhya̍nūṣata ha̱viṣā̍ ya̱jña i̍ndri̱yaiḥ
197.d: तमिन्द्र̍ं प̱शव̱ः सचा̱श्विनो̱भा सर̍स्वती । दधा̍ना अ̱भ्य̍नूषत ह̱विषा̍ य̱ज्ञ इ̍न्द्रि̱यैः
197.m:
To that Indra, the cattle, together with both Aśvins and Sarasvatī,
placing [vital faculties], cried aloud with oblation in the sacrifice with sense-powers.

197.s: ya indra̍ indri̱yaṃ da̱dhuḥ sa̍vi̱tā varu̍ṇo̱ bhaga̍ḥ | sa su̱trāmā̍ ha̱viṣpa̍ti̱ryaja̍mānāya saścata
197.d: य इन्द्र̍ इन्द्रि̱यं द̱धुः स̍वि̱ता वरु̍णो̱ भग̍ः । स सु̱त्रामा̍ ह̱विष्प̍ति̱र्यज̍मानाय सश्चत
197.m:
They who placed sense-power in Indra—Savitṛ, Varuṇa, Bhaga—
he, Sutrāman, the lord of oblations, accompanied the sacrificer.

197.s: sa̱vi̱tā varu̍ṇo dadha̱dyaja̍mānāya dā̱śuṣe̍ | āda̍tta̱ namu̍ce̱rvasu̍ su̱trāmā̱ vala̍mindri̱yam
197.d: स̱वि̱ता वरु̍णो दध̱द्यज̍मानाय दा̱शुषे̍ । आद̍त्त̱ नमु̍चे̱र्वसु̍ सु̱त्रामा̱ वल̍मिन्द्रि̱यम्
197.m:
May Savitṛ and Varuṇa bestow upon the sacrificer, the worshiper;
Sutrāman took away the wealth of Namuci, [bestowing] strength and sense-power.

197.s: varu̍ṇaḥ kṣa̱trami̍ndri̱yaṃ bhage̍na savi̱tā śriya̍m | su̱trāmā̱ yaśa̍sā̱ bala̱ṃ dadhā̍nā ya̱jñamā̍śata
197.d: वरु̍णः क्ष̱त्रमि̍न्द्रि̱यं भगे̍न सवि̱ता श्रिय̍म् । सु̱त्रामा̱ यश̍सा̱ बल̱ं दधा̍ना य̱ज्ञमा̍शत
197.m:
Varuṇa [established] princely power and sense-power, Savitṛ [established] prosperity with Bhaga;
Sutrāman, establishing strength with splendor, attained the sacrifice.

197.s: a̱śvinā̱ gobhi̍rindri̱yamaśve̍bhirvī̱rya̍ bala̍ṃm | ha̱viṣendre̱m̐ sara̍svatī̱ yaja̍mānamavardhayan
197.d: अ̱श्विना̱ गोभि̍रिन्द्रि̱यमश्वे̍भिर्वी̱र्य̍ बल̍ंम् । ह̱विषेन्द्रे̱म्̐ सर̍स्वती̱ यज̍मानमवर्धयन्
197.m:
The Aśvins with cattle, with horses [brought] sense-power, heroic vigor, strength;
with oblation, they and Sarasvatī magnified Indra and the sacrificer.

197.s: tā nāsa̍tyā su̱peśa̍sā hira̍ṇyavartanī̱ narā̍ | sara̍svatī ha̱viṣma̍tīndra̱ karma̍su no'vata
197.d: ता नास̍त्या सु̱पेश̍सा हिर̍ण्यवर्तनी̱ नरा̍ । सर̍स्वती ह̱विष्म̍तीन्द्र̱ कर्म̍सु नोऽवत
197.m:
May those two Nāsatyas, well-formed, on golden paths, the heroes,
and Sarasvatī, rich in oblations, and Indra, favor us in our ritual acts.

197.s: tā bhi̱ṣajā̍ su̱karma̍ṇā̱ sā su̍du̱ghā sara̍svatī | sa vṛ̍tra̱hā śa̱takra̍tu̱rindrā̍ya dadhurindri̱yam
197.d: ता भि̱षजा̍ सु̱कर्म̍णा̱ सा सु̍दु̱घा सर̍स्वती । स वृ̍त्र̱हा श̱तक्र̍तु̱रिन्द्रा̍य दधुरिन्द्रि̱यम्
197.m:
Those two physicians of good deeds, she, the easily milked Sarasvatī,
and he, the slayer of Vṛtra, possessing a hundred purposes—they placed sense-power in Indra.

197.s: yu̱vam̐ surāmā̍ma̱śvinā̱ namu̍cā āsu̱re sacā̍ | vi̱pi̱pā̱nāḥ sara̍svatīndra̱ṃ karma̍svāvata
197.d: यु̱वम्̐ सुरामा̍म̱श्विना̱ नमु̍चा आसु̱रे सचा̍ । वि̱पि̱पा̱नाः सर̍स्वतीन्द्र̱ं कर्म̍स्वावत
197.m:
You two, O Aśvins, drank the surā together with Namuci the Asura;
drinking thoroughly, Sarasvatī and [the Aśvins] favored Indra in his ritual acts.

197.s: pu̱trami̍va pi̱tarā̍ a̱śvino̱bhendrā̍vathuḥ kāvyai̍rda̱m̐sanā̍bhiḥ yatsurā̱maṃ vyapi̍ba̱ḥ śacī̍bhi̱ḥ sara̍svatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak
197.d: पु̱त्रमि̍व पि̱तरा̍ अ̱श्विनो̱भेन्द्रा̍वथुः काव्यै̍र्द̱म्̐सना̍भिः यत्सुरा̱मं व्यपि̍ब̱ः शची̍भि̱ः सर̍स्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्
197.m:
Like parents for a son, both Aśvins helped Indra with poetic wisdom, with wondrous powers,
when you drank the surā through your deeds; Sarasvatī healed you, O Maghavan.

197.s: yasmi̱nnaśvā̍sa ṛṣa̱bhāsa̍ u̱kṣaṇo̍ va̱śā me̱ṣā a̍vasṛ̱ṣṭāsa̱ āhu̍tāḥ kī̱lā̱la̱pe soma̍pṛṣṭhāya ve̱dhase̍ hṛ̱dā ma̱tiṃ ja̍naya̱ cāru̍ma̱gnaye̍
197.d: यस्मि̱न्नश्वा̍स ऋष̱भास̍ उ̱क्षणो̍ व̱शा मे̱षा अ̍वसृ̱ष्टास̱ आहु̍ताः की̱ला̱ल̱पे सोम̍पृष्ठाय वे̱धसे̍ हृ̱दा म̱तिं ज̍नय̱ चारु̍म̱ग्नये̍
197.m:
In whom horses, bulls, oxen, barren cows, and rams are released and offered—
to that drinker of sweet drink, whose back is Soma, the dispenser, to Agni, generate a dear thought from the heart.

197.s: ahā̍vyagne ha̱virā̱sye̍ te sru̱cīva̍ ghṛ̱taṃ ca̱mvī̍va̱ soma̍ḥ vā̱ja̱sani̍ṃm̐ ra̱yima̱sme su̱vīra̍ṃ pra̱śasta̍ṃ dhehi ya̱śasa̍ṃ bṛ̱hanta̍m
197.d: अहा̍व्यग्ने ह̱विरा̱स्ये̍ ते स्रु̱चीव̍ घृ̱तं च̱म्वी̍व̱ सोम̍ः वा̱ज̱सनि̍ंम्̐ र̱यिम̱स्मे सु̱वीर̍ं प्र̱शस्त̍ं धेहि य̱शस̍ं बृ̱हन्त̍म्
197.m:
O Agni, the oblation has been poured into your mouth, like ghee into the two ladles, like Soma into the cups;
bestow on us wealth winning vital vigor, rich in good heroes, praised, glorious, and lofty.

198.s: a̱śvinā̱ teja̍sā̱ cakṣu̍: prā̱ṇena̱ sara̍svatī vī̱rya̍m | vā̱cendro̱ bale̱nendrā̍ya dadhurindri̱yam
198.d: अ̱श्विना̱ तेज̍सा̱ चक्षु̍: प्रा̱णेन̱ सर̍स्वती वी̱र्य̍म् । वा̱चेन्द्रो̱ बले̱नेन्द्रा̍य दधुरिन्द्रि̱यम्
198.m:
The Aśvins with splendor [bestowed] sight, Sarasvatī with breath [bestowed] heroic vigor;
Indra with speech and strength placed sense-power in Indra.

198.s: goma̍dū̱ ṣu ṇā̍sa̱tyāśvā̍vadyātamaśvinā | va̱rtī ru̱drā nṛ̱pāyya̍m
198.d: गोम̍दू̱ षु णा̍स̱त्याश्वा̍वद्यातमश्विना । व̱र्ती रु̱द्रा नृ̱पाय्य̍म्
198.m:
Rich in cows, rich in horses, O Nāsatyas, come well, O Aśvins,
on your journey, O fierce ones, to what is to be drunk by men.

198.s: na yatparo̱ nānta̍ra ā̱dadha̍rṣadvṛṣaṇavasū | duḥśa̍ṃso martyo̍ ri̱puḥ
198.d: न यत्परो̱ नान्त̍र आ̱दध̍र्षद्वृषणवसू । दुःश̍ंसो मर्त्यो̍ रि̱पुः
198.m:
Where neither an outsider nor an insider may assail [us], O you rich in bulls,
nor the ill-speaking mortal adversary.

198.s: tā na̱ ā vo̍ḷhamaśvinā ra̱yiṃ pi̱śaṅga̍ saṃdṛśam | dhiṣṇyā̍ varivo̱vida̍m
198.d: ता न̱ आ वो̍ऌहमश्विना र̱यिं पि̱शङ्ग̍ संदृशम् । धिष्ण्या̍ वरिवो̱विद̍म्
198.m:
Bring to us, O Aśvins, wealth of golden-tawny appearance,
O you seated on the mound, finding wide space.

198.s: pā̱va̱kā na̱ḥ sara̍svatī vāje̍bhirvā̱jinī̍vatī | ya̱jñaṃ va̍ṣṭu dhi̱yāva̍suḥ
198.d: पा̱व̱का न̱ः सर̍स्वती वाजे̍भिर्वा̱जिनी̍वती । य̱ज्ञं व̍ष्टु धि̱याव̍सुः
198.m:
Purifying, rich in prizes, possessing swift mares, may Sarasvatī,
rich in poetic vision, desire our sacrifice.

198.s: co̱da̱yi̱trī sū̱nṛtā̍nā̱ṃ ceta̍ntī sumatī̱nām | ya̱jñaṃ da̍dhe̱ sara̍svatī
198.d: चो̱द̱यि̱त्री सू̱नृता̍ना̱ं चेत̍न्ती सुमती̱नाम् । य̱ज्ञं द̍धे̱ सर̍स्वती
198.m:
Prompter of generous truths, perceptive of good thoughts,
Sarasvatī has taken up the sacrifice.

198.s: ma̱ho arṇa̱ḥ sara̍svatī̱ pra ce̍tayati ke̱tunā̍ | dhiyo̱ viśvā̱ vi rā̍jati
198.d: म̱हो अर्ण̱ः सर̍स्वती̱ प्र चे̍तयति के̱तुना̍ । धियो̱ विश्वा̱ वि रा̍जति
198.m:
A great flood, Sarasvatī makes known with her beacon;
she illuminates all visions.

198.s: indrā̍ yā̍hi citrabhāno su̱tā i̱me tvā̱yava̍: | aṇvī̍bhi̱stanā̍ pū̱tāsa̍:
198.d: इन्द्रा̍ या̍हि चित्रभानो सु̱ता इ̱मे त्वा̱यव̍: । अण्वी̍भि̱स्तना̍ पू̱तास̍:
198.m:
Come, Indra, of wonderful splendor! These pressed juices seek you,
purified with fine sieves.

198.s: indrā̍ yā̍hi dhi̱yeṣi̱to vipra̍jūtaḥ su̱tāva̍taḥ | upa̱ brahmā̍ṇi vā̱ghata̍:
198.d: इन्द्रा̍ या̍हि धि̱येषि̱तो विप्र̍जूतः सु̱ताव̍तः । उप̱ ब्रह्मा̍णि वा̱घत̍:
198.m:
Come, Indra, impelled by prayer, speeded by the sage,
to the pressed juices, to the sacred formulations of the singer.

198.s: indrā̍ yā̍hi tūtu̍jāna̱ upa̱ brahmā̍ṇi harivaḥ | su̱te da̍dhiṣva na̱ścana̍:
198.d: इन्द्रा̍ या̍हि तूतु̍जान̱ उप̱ ब्रह्मा̍णि हरिवः । सु̱ते द̍धिष्व न̱श्चन̍:
198.m:
Come, Indra, hastening toward the sacred formulations, O lord of bay steeds!
Take delight in our pressed [offering].

198.s: a̱śvinā̍ pibatā̱ṃ madhu̱ sara̍svatyā sa̱joṣa̍sā indra̍: sutrā̱mā̍ vṛtra̱hā ju̍ṣantā̱m̐ somya̱ṃ madhu̍
198.d: अ̱श्विना̍ पिबता̱ं मधु̱ सर̍स्वत्या स̱जोष̍सा इन्द्र̍: सुत्रा̱मा̍ वृत्र̱हा जु̍षन्ता̱म्̐ सोम्य̱ं मधु̍
198.m:
May the Aśvins drink the sweet drink, in union with Sarasvatī;
may Indra, Sutrāman, the slayer of Vṛtra, enjoy the sweet Soma-drink.

198.s:
(8)
yaddevā aṣṭa
abhyādadhāmītyaṣṭa
yo bhūtānāṃ catasraḥ
samiddha indra ekādaśa
ayātvaṣṭa
198.d:
(8)
यद्देवा अष्ट
अभ्यादधामीत्यष्ट
यो भूतानां चतस्रः
समिद्ध इन्द्र एकादश
अयात्वष्ट

198.s:
aśvinā havitrayodaśa
aśvinā tejasaikādaśa
aṣṭānuvākeṣu pañcasaptatiḥ
198.d:
अश्विना हवित्रयोदश
अश्विना तेजसैकादश
अष्टानुवाकेषु पञ्चसप्ततिः

199.s: i̱maṃ me̍ varuṇa śrudhī hava̍ma̱dyā ca̍ mṛḷaya | tvāma̍va̱syurā ca̍ke
199.d: इ̱मं मे̍ वरुण श्रुधी हव̍म̱द्या च̍ मृऌअय । त्वाम̍व̱स्युरा च̍के
199.m:
Hear this call of mine, O Varuṇa, and be gracious today;
seeking help, I yearn for you.

199.s: tattvā̍ yāmi̱ brahma̍ṇā̱ vanda̍māna̱stadā śā̍ste̱ yaja̍māno ha̱virbhi̍: ahe̍ḷamāno varuṇe̱ha bo̱dhyuru̍śam̐sa̱ mā na̱ āyu̱ḥ pra mo̍ṣīḥ
199.d: तत्त्वा̍ यामि̱ ब्रह्म̍णा̱ वन्द̍मान̱स्तदा शा̍स्ते̱ यज̍मानो ह̱विर्भि̍: अहे̍ऌअमानो वरुणे̱ह बो̱ध्युरु̍शम्̐स̱ मा न̱ आयु̱ः प्र मो̍षीः
199.m:
Praising you with sacred formulation, I ask for that; for that the sacrificer prays with oblations.
Being unangered, take note of us here, O Varuṇa, widely praised; do not steal away our lifetime.

199.s: tvaṃ no̍ agne̱ varu̍ṇasya vi̱dvān de̱vasya̱ heḷo̱ ava̍ yāsisīṣṭhāḥ yaji̍ṣṭho̱ vahni̍tamaḥ śośu̍cāno̱ viśvā̱ dveṣā̍ṃm̐si̱ pra mu̍mugdhya̱smat
199.d: त्वं नो̍ अग्ने̱ वरु̍णस्य वि̱द्वान् दे̱वस्य̱ हेऌओ̱ अव̍ यासिसीष्ठाः यजि̍ष्ठो̱ वह्नि̍तमः शोशु̍चानो̱ विश्वा̱ द्वेषा̍ंम्̐सि̱ प्र मु̍मुग्ध्य̱स्मत्
199.m:
Knowing [it], O Agni, do avert from us the anger of the god Varuṇa;
sacrificing best, being the greatest conveyor, gleaming forth, loosen all hatreds away from us.

199.s: sa tvaṃ no̍ agne'va̱mo bha̍votī nedi̍ṣṭho a̱syā u̱ṣaso̱ vyu̍ṣṭau ava̍ yakṣva no̱ varu̍ṇam̐ rarā̍ṇo vī̱hi mṛ̍ḷī̱kam̐ su̱havo̍ na edhi
199.d: स त्वं नो̍ अग्नेऽव̱मो भ̍वोती नेदि̍ष्ठो अ̱स्या उ̱षसो̱ व्यु̍ष्टौ अव̍ यक्ष्व नो̱ वरु̍णम्̐ ररा̍णो वी̱हि मृ̍ऌई̱कम्̐ सु̱हवो̍ न एधि
199.m:
So be you nearest to us with help, O Agni, at the dawning of this dawn;
appease Varuṇa for us, being generous; accept our kindness, and be easy for us to invoke.

199.s: ma̱hīmū̱ ṣu mā̱tara̍m̐ suvra̱tānā̍mṛ̱tasya̱ patnī̱mava̍se huvema tu̱vi̱kṣa̱trāma̱jara̍ntīmurūcīm̐ su̱śarmā̍ṇa̱madi̍tim̐ su̱praṇī̍tim
199.d: म̱हीमू̱ षु मा̱तर̍म्̐ सुव्र̱ताना̍मृ̱तस्य̱ पत्नी̱मव̍से हुवेम तु̱वि̱क्ष̱त्राम̱जर̍न्तीमुरूचीम्̐ सु̱शर्मा̍ण̱मदि̍तिम्̐ सु̱प्रणी̍तिम्
199.m:
The great mother of those of good vows, the wife of cosmic order, we invoke for help,
mighty in princely power, unaging, broad-reaching, providing good shelter, Aditi of good guidance.

199.s: su̱trāmā̍ṇaṃ pṛthi̱vīṃ dyāma̍ne̱hasa̍m̐ su̱śarmā̍ṇa̱madi̍tim̐ su̱praṇī̍tim daivī̍ṃ nā̱vam̐ sva̍ri̱trāmanā̍gasa̱masra̍vantī̱mā ru̍hemā sva̱staye̍
199.d: सु̱त्रामा̍णं पृथि̱वीं द्याम̍ने̱हस̍म्̐ सु̱शर्मा̍ण̱मदि̍तिम्̐ सु̱प्रणी̍तिम् दैवी̍ं ना̱वम्̐ स्व̍रि̱त्रामना̍गस̱मस्र̍वन्ती̱मा रु̍हेमा स्व̱स्तये̍
199.m:
Earth protecting well, sinless heaven, providing good shelter, Aditi of good guidance,
the divine ship, well-oared, blameless, leakless—let us board her for wellbeing.

May I board the good ship, leakless, blameless,
with a hundred oars, for wellbeing.

199.s: ā no̍ mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā ghṛ̱tairgavyū̍timukṣatam | madhvā̱ rajā̍ṃm̐si sukratū
199.d: आ नो̍ मि̱त्रावरु̍णा घृ̱तैर्गव्यू̍तिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा̱ रजा̍ंम्̐सि सुक्रतू
199.m:
Sprinkle our pasture with ghee, O Mitra and Varuṇa,
and the spaces of mid-air with honey, O you of good purpose.

199.s: pra bā̱havā̍ sisṛtaṃ jī̱vase̍ na̱ ā no̍ gavyū̍timukṣataṃ ghṛ̱tena̍ ā mā̱ jane̍ śravayataṃ yuvānā śru̱taṃ me̍ mitrāvaruṇā̱ have̱mā
199.d: प्र बा̱हवा̍ सिसृतं जी̱वसे̍ न̱ आ नो̍ गव्यू̍तिमुक्षतं घृ̱तेन̍ आ मा̱ जने̍ श्रवयतं युवाना श्रु̱तं मे̍ मित्रावरुणा̱ हवे̱मा
199.m:
Stretch forth your arms for our living; sprinkle our pasture with ghee;
make me famous among people, O youthful ones! Hear this call of mine, O Mitra and Varuṇa.

199.s: śaṃ no̍ bhavantu vā̱jino̱ have̍ṣu de̱vatā̍tā mi̱tadra̍vaḥ sva̱rkāḥ ja̱mbhaya̍nto'hi̱ṃ vṛka̍m̐ rakṣā̍ṃm̐si̱ sane̍mya̱smadyu̍yavannamī̍vāḥ
199.d: शं नो̍ भवन्तु वा̱जिनो̱ हवे̍षु दे̱वता̍ता मि̱तद्र̍वः स्व̱र्काः ज̱म्भय̍न्तोऽहि̱ं वृक̍म्̐ रक्षा̍ंम्̐सि̱ सने̍म्य̱स्मद्यु̍यवन्नमी̍वाः
199.m:
May the swift coursers be auspicious to us at invocations, in the divine service, well-praised, of measured run;
crushing the serpent, the wolf, and the demons, may they entirely drive away illness from us.

199.s: te no̱ arva̍nto̱ hava̍na̱śruto̱ hava̱ṃ viśve̍ śṛṇvantu vā̱jino̍ mi̱tadra̍vaḥ sa̱hasra̱sā me̱dhasā̍tā iva̱ tmanā̍ ma̱ho ye dhana̍ṃm̐ sa̱mithe̍ṣu ja̱ghnire̍
199.d: ते नो̱ अर्व̍न्तो̱ हव̍न̱श्रुतो̱ हव̱ं विश्वे̍ शृण्वन्तु वा̱जिनो̍ मि̱तद्र̍वः स̱हस्र̱सा मे̱धसा̍ता इव̱ त्मना̍ म̱हो ये धन̍ंम्̐ स̱मिथे̍षु ज̱घ्निरे̍
199.m:
May they, the steeds who hear our calling, all the swift coursers of measured run, hear our call,
who, winning thousands, like winners of wisdom, by themselves carried off the great prize in conflicts.

199.s: vāje̍vāje'vata vājino no̱ dhane̍ṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ a̱sya madhva̍ḥ pibata mā̱daya̍dhvaṃ tṛ̱ptā yā̍ta pa̱thibhi̍rde̱vayā̍naiḥ
199.d: वाजे̍वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो̱ धने̍षु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः अ̱स्य मध्व̍ः पिबत मा̱दय̍ध्वं तृ̱प्ता या̍त प̱थिभि̍र्दे̱वया̍नैः
199.m:
In every contest, protect us in prizes, O swift coursers, wise, immortal, knowers of cosmic order;
drink of this honey, exhilarate yourselves; satisfied, go along the paths traversed by the gods.

200.s: (1) sami̍ddho a̱gniḥ sa̱midhā̍ su̱sami̍ddho vare̍ṇyaḥ | gā̱ya̱trī chanda̱ indri̱yaṃ trya̱virgaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: (1) समि̍द्धो अ̱ग्निः स̱मिधा̍ सु̱समि̍द्धो वरे̍ण्यः । गा̱य̱त्री छन्द̱ इन्द्रि̱यं त्र्य̱विर्गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: Agni, kindled with fuel, well-kindled, worthy of choice; / the gāyatrī metre, manly power, and a three-year-old steer have established life-energy.

200.s: ta̱nū̱napā̱cchuci̍vratasta̱nūpāśca̱ sara̍svatī | u̱ṣṇihā̱ chanda̱ indri̱yaṃ di̍tya̱vāḍ gaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: त̱नू̱नपा̱च्छुचि̍व्रतस्त̱नूपाश्च̱ सर̍स्वती । उ̱ष्णिहा̱ छन्द̱ इन्द्रि̱यं दि̍त्य̱वाड् गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: Tanūnapāt of pure vows, and Tanūpā, and Sarasvatī; / the uṣṇih metre, manly power, and a two-year-old steer have established life-energy.

200.s: iḷā̍bhira̱gnirīḍya̱ḥ somo̍ de̱vo ama̍rtyaḥ | a̱nu̱ṣṭup chanda̱ indri̱yaṃ pañcā̱virgaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: इऌआ̍भिर̱ग्निरीड्य̱ः सोमो̍ दे̱वो अम̍र्त्यः । अ̱नु̱ष्टुप् छन्द̱ इन्द्रि̱यं पञ्चा̱विर्गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: Agni, to be praised with refreshings, and the immortal god Soma; / the anuṣṭubh metre, manly power, and a two-and-a-half-year-old steer have established life-energy.

200.s: suba̱rhira̱gniḥ pū̱ṣaṇvā̱ntastī̱rṇaba̍rhi̱rama̍rtyaḥ | bṛ̱ha̱tī chanda̱ indri̱yaṃ tri̍va̱tso gaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: सुब̱र्हिर̱ग्निः पू̱षण्वा̱न्तस्ती̱र्णब̍र्हि̱रम̍र्त्यः । बृ̱ह̱ती छन्द̱ इन्द्रि̱यं त्रि̍व̱त्सो गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: Agni, rich in sacred grass, accompanied by Pūṣan, whose sacred grass is strewn, the immortal; / the bṛhatī metre, manly power, and a three-year-old bull have established life-energy.

200.s:
duro̍ de̱vīrdi̱śo ma̱hīrbrahmā̍ de̱vo bṛha̱spati̍ḥ pa̱ṅktiśchanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ tu̍rya̱vāḍ gaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
u̱ṣe ya̱hvī su̱peśa̍sā̱ viśve̍ de̱vā ama̍rtyāḥ | tri̱ṣṭup chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ pa̍ṣṭha̱vāḍ gaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d:
दुरो̍ दे̱वीर्दि̱शो म̱हीर्ब्रह्मा̍ दे̱वो बृह̱स्पति̍ः प̱ङ्क्तिश्छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं तु̍र्य̱वाड् गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
उ̱षे य̱ह्वी सु̱पेश̍सा̱ विश्वे̍ दे̱वा अम̍र्त्याः । त्रि̱ष्टुप् छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं प̍ष्ठ̱वाड् गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m:
The divine doors, the great quarters, and the god Bṛhaspati, the Brahman; / the paṅkti metre, manly power here, and a four-year-old steer have established life-energy.

The youthful dawns, fair-adorned, and all the immortal gods; / the triṣṭubh metre, manly power here, and a five-year-old steer have established life-energy.

200.s: daivyā̱ hotā̍rā bhi̱ṣajendre̍ṃṇa sa̱yujā̍ yu̱jā | jaga̍tī̱ chanda̱ indri̱yama̍na̱ḍvān gaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: दैव्या̱ होता̍रा भि̱षजेन्द्रे̍ंण स̱युजा̍ यु̱जा । जग̍ती̱ छन्द̱ इन्द्रि̱यम̍न̱ड्वान् गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: The two divine Hotṛs, the physicians, together with Indra their close ally; / the jagatī metre, manly power, and a draft-ox have established life-energy.

200.s: ti̱sra iḷā̱ sara̍svatī bhā̱ratī̍ ma̱ruto̱ viśa̍ḥ | vi̱rāṭ chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ dhe̱nurgaurna vayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: ति̱स्र इऌआ̱ सर̍स्वती भा̱रती̍ म̱रुतो̱ विश̍ः । वि̱राट् छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं धे̱नुर्गौर्न वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: The three: Iḷā, Sarasvatī, and Bhāratī, and the Maruts, the clans; / the virāj metre, manly power here, and a milch-cow have established life-energy.

200.s: tvaṣṭā̍ tu̱rīpo̱ adbhu̍ta indrā̱gnī pu̍ṣṭi̱vardha̍nā | dvi̱padā̱ chanda̱ indri̱yamu̱kṣā gaurna vayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: त्वष्टा̍ तु̱रीपो̱ अद्भु̍त इन्द्रा̱ग्नी पु̍ष्टि̱वर्ध̍ना । द्वि̱पदा̱ छन्द̱ इन्द्रि̱यमु̱क्षा गौर्न वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: Tvaṣṭṛ, the wondrous seed-bearer, and Indrāgnī, who swell prosperity; / the dvipadā metre, manly power, and a breeding bull have established life-energy.

200.s: śa̱mitā no̱ vana̱spati̍ḥ savi̱tā pra̍su̱van bhaga̍m ka̱kup chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ va̱śā ve̱hadgau̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: श̱मिता नो̱ वन̱स्पति̍ः सवि̱ता प्र̍सु̱वन् भग̍म् क̱कुप् छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं व̱शा वे̱हद्गौ̍ दधुः
200.m: The tree, our slaughterer, and Savitṛ, who impels good fortune; / the kakubh metre, manly power here, and a barren cow that miscarries have established life-energy.

200.s: svāhā̍ ya̱jñaṃ varu̍ṇaḥ sukṣa̱tro bhaiṣa̱jaṃ ka̍rat ati̍cchandā indri̱yaṃ bṛ̱hadṛ̍ṣa̱bho gaurvayo̍ dadhuḥ
200.d: स्वाहा̍ य̱ज्ञं वरु̍णः सुक्ष̱त्रो भैष̱जं क̍रत् अति̍च्छन्दा इन्द्रि̱यं बृ̱हदृ̍ष̱भो गौर्वयो̍ दधुः
200.m: Svāhā! May Varuṇa of good dominion provide medicine for the sacrifice; / the aticchandas metre, great manly power, and a bull have established life-energy.

201.s: (2) va̱sa̱ntena̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ de̱vā vasa̍vastri̱vṛtā̍ stu̱tāḥ | ra̱thanta̱reṇa̱ teja̍sā ha̱virindre̱ vayo̍ dadhuḥ
201.d: (2) व̱स̱न्तेन̍ ऋ̱तुना̍ दे̱वा वस̍वस्त्रि̱वृता̍ स्तु̱ताः । र̱थन्त̱रेण̱ तेज̍सा ह̱विरिन्द्रे̱ वयो̍ दधुः
201.m: With the season of spring, the gods, the Vasus, praised in the trivṛt [stoma], / with the rathantara [sāman] and fiery energy, placed the oblation and life-energy in Indra.

201.s: grī̱ṣmeṇa̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ de̱vā ru̱drāḥ pa̍ñcada̱śe stu̱tāḥ | bṛ̱hatā yaśa̍sā bala̍m̐ ha̱virindre̱ vayo̍ dadhuḥ
201.d: ग्री̱ष्मेण̍ ऋ̱तुना̍ दे̱वा रु̱द्राः प̍ञ्चद̱शे स्तु̱ताः । बृ̱हता यश̍सा बल̍म्̐ ह̱विरिन्द्रे̱ वयो̍ दधुः
201.m: With the season of summer, the gods, the Rudras, praised in the fifteenfold [stoma], / with the bṛhat [sāman] and fame, placed strength, the oblation, and life-energy in Indra.
