201.s: va̱rṣābhi̍rṛ̱tunā̍di̱tyā stome̍ saptada̱śe stu̱tāḥ vai̱rū̱peṇa̱ viśau̍ja̍sā ha̱virindre̱ vayo̍ dadhuḥ
201.d: व̱र्षाभि̍रृ̱तुना̍दि̱त्या स्तोमे̍ सप्तद̱शे स्तु̱ताः वै̱रू̱पेण̱ विशौ̍ज̍सा ह̱विरिन्द्रे̱ वयो̍ दधुः
201.m: With the season of the rains, the Ādityas, praised in the seventeenfold stoma, / with the vairūpa [sāman] and clan-might, placed the oblation and life-energy in Indra.

201.s: śā̱ra̱dena̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ de̱vā eka̍vim̐śa ṛ̱bhava̍ stu̱tāḥ vai̱rā̱jena̍ śri̱yā śriya̍m̐ ha̱virindre̱ vayo̍ dadhuḥ
201.d: शा̱र̱देन̍ ऋ̱तुना̍ दे̱वा एक̍विम्̐श ऋ̱भव̍ स्तु̱ताः वै̱रा̱जेन̍ श्रि̱या श्रिय̍म्̐ ह̱विरिन्द्रे̱ वयो̍ दधुः
201.m: With the season of autumn, the gods, the Ṛbhus, praised in the twenty-onefold [stoma], / with the vairāja [sāman] and fortune, placed fortune, the oblation, and life-energy in Indra.

201.s: he̱ma̱ntena̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ de̱vāstri̍ṇa̱ve ma̱ruta̍ stu̱tāḥ | balai̍na̱ śakva̍rīḥ sahau̍ ha̱virindre̱ vayo̍ dadhuḥ
201.d: हे̱म̱न्तेन̍ ऋ̱तुना̍ दे̱वास्त्रि̍ण̱वे म̱रुत̍ स्तु̱ताः । बलै̍न̱ शक्व̍रीः सहौ̍ ह̱विरिन्द्रे̱ वयो̍ दधुः
201.m: With the season of winter, the gods, the Maruts, praised in the twenty-sevenfold [stoma], / with strength and the śakvarī verses, placed overwhelming might, the oblation, and life-energy in Indra.

201.s: śaiśi̱reṇa̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ de̱vāstra̍yastrim̐śe'mṛtā̍ stu̱tāḥ sa̱tyena̍ reva̱tīḥ kṣa̱tram̐ ha̱virindre̱ vayo̍ dadhuḥ
201.d: शैशि̱रेण̍ ऋ̱तुना̍ दे̱वास्त्र̍यस्त्रिम्̐शेऽमृता̍ स्तु̱ताः स̱त्येन̍ रेव̱तीः क्ष̱त्रम्̐ ह̱विरिन्द्रे̱ वयो̍ दधुः
201.m: With the season of cool dew, the gods, the immortals, praised in the thirty-threefold [stoma], / with truth and the revatī verses, placed princely power, the oblation, and life-energy in Indra.

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣatsa̱midhā̱gnimiḷa̍spa̱de'śvinendram̐ sara̍svatī̱majo dhū̱mro na go̱dhūmai̍: ku̱valai̍rbhe̱ṣa̱jaṃ madhu̍ śa̱ṣpairna teja̍ indri̱yaṃ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्षत्स̱मिधा̱ग्निमिऌअ̍स्प̱देऽश्विनेन्द्रम्̐ सर̍स्वती̱मजो धू̱म्रो न गो̱धूमै̍: कु̱वलै̍र्भे̱ष̱जं मधु̍ श̱ष्पैर्न तेज̍ इन्द्रि̱यं पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Agni on the footprint of Iḷā with fuel, to the Aśvins, Indra, and Sarasvatī, a dark goat like a healing remedy with wheat and jujubes, sweet honey, / as if young grass for fiery brilliance, manly power, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱ttanūnapātsa̍rasvatīmavi̍rme̱ṣo na bhaiṣa̱jaṃ pa̱thā madhu̍ma̱tā bhara̍nna̱śvinendrā̍ya vī̱rya̍m ba̱darai̍rupavā̱kābhi̍rbhe̱ṣa̱jaṃ tokma̍bhiḥ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱त्तनूनपात्स̍रस्वतीमवि̍र्मे̱षो न भैष̱जं प̱था मधु̍म̱ता भर̍न्न̱श्विनेन्द्रा̍य वी̱र्य̍म् ब̱दरै̍रुपवा̱काभि̍र्भे̱ष̱जं तोक्म̍भिः पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Tanūnapāt and Sarasvatī, a sheep like a ram for healing, bearing virile strength along the honey-sweet path for the Aśvins and Indra, / with jujubes and upavākā-grain as medicine, with sprouted grains, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱nnarāśam̐sa̱ṃ na na̱gnahu̱ṃ patim̐ sū̱rayā̍ bhe̱ṣa̱jaṃ me̱ṣaḥ sara̍svatī bhi̱ṣagratho̱ na ca̱ndrya̍śvinau̍rū̱pā indra̍sya vī̱rya̍m | bada̍rairupavā̱kābhi̍rbhe̱ṣa̱jaṃ tokma̍bhiḥ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱न्नराशम्̐स̱ं न न̱ग्नहु̱ं पतिम्̐ सू̱रया̍ भे̱ष̱जं मे̱षः सर̍स्वती भि̱षग्रथो̱ न च̱न्द्र्य̍श्विनौ̍रू̱पा इन्द्र̍स्य वी̱र्य̍म् । बद̍रैरुपवा̱काभि̍र्भे̱ष̱जं तोक्म̍भिः पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Narāśaṁsa like yeast, the lord with surā for healing, a ram, Sarasvatī the physician, like a moonlit chariot of the Aśvins, the omentum as Indra's virile strength, / with jujubes and upavākā-grain as medicine, with sprouted grains, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱diḷeḷi̍ta ā̱juhvā̍naḥ sara̍svatī̱mindra̱ṃ balai̍na va̱rdhaya̍nnṛṣa̱bheṇa̱ gave̍ndri̱yama̱śvinendrā̍ya bhe̱ṣa̱jam yavai̍: karkandhu̍bhi̱rmadhu̱ lājai̍rna mā̱sara̱ṃ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱दिऌएऌइ̍त आ̱जुह्वा̍नः सर̍स्वती̱मिन्द्र̱ं बलै̍न व̱र्धय̍न्नृष̱भेण̱ गवे̍न्द्रि̱यम̱श्विनेन्द्रा̍य भे̱ष̱जम् यवै̍: कर्कन्धु̍भि̱र्मधु̱ लाजै̍र्न मा̱सर̱ं पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Iḷā, celebrated, invoked, to Sarasvatī, strengthening Indra with power, with a bull as manly power for the cow, healing for the Aśvins and Indra, / with barley and wild jujubes, sweet honey, as if parched grain with māsara, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱dvarhi̱rūrṇa̍mradā bhi̱ṣaṅ nāsa̍tyā bhiṣa̱jāśvināśvā̍ śi̱śu̍matī bhiṣa̱gdhenuḥ sara̍svatī bhi̱ṣak du̱ha indrā̍ya bhe̱ṣa̱jaṃ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱द्वर्हि̱रूर्ण̍म्रदा भि̱षङ् नास̍त्या भिष̱जाश्विनाश्वा̍ शि̱शु̍मती भिष̱ग्धेनुः सर̍स्वती भि̱षक् दु̱ह इन्द्रा̍य भे̱ष̱जं पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the sacred grass, soft as wool, the physician, the truthful Aśvins, the physicians, a mare with foal, the physician, a milch-cow, Sarasvatī, the physician, / yielding medicine for Indra, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱ddurī̱ diśa̍: ka̱vaṣyo̱ na vyaca̍svatīra̱śvibhyā̱ṃ na duro̱ diśa̱ indro̱ na roda̍sī du̱ghe du̱he dhe̱nuḥ sara̍svatya̱śvinendrā̍ya bhe̱ṣa̱jam śu̱kraṃ na jyotī̍rindri̱yaṃ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱द्दुरी̱ दिश̍: क̱वष्यो̱ न व्यच̍स्वतीर̱श्विभ्या̱ं न दुरो̱ दिश̱ इन्द्रो̱ न रोद̍सी दु̱घे दु̱हे धे̱नुः सर̍स्वत्य̱श्विनेन्द्रा̍य भे̱ष̱जम् शु̱क्रं न ज्योती̍रिन्द्रि̱यं पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the doors, the quarters, opening wide like portals, as if doors for the Aśvins, the quarters, as Indra milks the two worlds, the milch-cow Sarasvatī milks medicine for the Aśvins and Indra, / brilliant light, manly power, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣatsu̱peśa̍so̱ṣe nakta̱ṃ divā̱śvinā̍ sama̍ñjāte̱ sara̍svatyā̱ tviṣi̱mindre̱ na bhaiṣa̱jam śye̱no na raja̍sā hu̱dā śri̱yā na mā̱sara̱ṃ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्षत्सु̱पेश̍सो̱षे नक्त̱ं दिवा̱श्विना̍ सम̍ञ्जाते̱ सर̍स्वत्या̱ त्विषि̱मिन्द्रे̱ न भैष̱जम् श्ये̱नो न रज̍सा हु̱दा श्रि̱या न मा̱सर̱ं पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Dawn and Night, beautifully adorned, the two Aśvins by day anoint together with Sarasvatī radiance, as if medicine in Indra, / like a falcon across the realm of space with heart, with fortune like māsara, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱ddaivyā̱ hotā̍rā bhiṣa̱jāśvinendra̱ṃ na jāgṛ̍vi̱ divā̱ nakta̱ṃ na bhaiṣa̱jaiḥ śū̱ṣam̐ sara̍svatī bhi̱ṣak sīse̍na duha indri̱yaṃ paya̍: soma̍: pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱द्दैव्या̱ होता̍रा भिष̱जाश्विनेन्द्र̱ं न जागृ̍वि̱ दिवा̱ नक्त̱ं न भैष̱जैः शू̱षम्̐ सर̍स्वती भि̱षक् सीसे̍न दुह इन्द्रि̱यं पय̍: सोम̍: परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the two divine Hotṛs, the physicians, the Aśvins, as if watchful over Indra by day and by night with medicines, / Sarasvatī the physician milks vital energy, with lead manly power, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣatti̱sro de̱vīrna bhe̍ṣa̱jaṃ traya̍stridhāta̍vo'pa̱so̍ rū̱pamindra̍ hira̱ṇyaya̍ma̱śvineḷā na bhā̍ratī vā̱cā sara̍svatī ma̱ha indrā̍ya duha indri̱yaṃ paya̱ḥ soma̍ḥ pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्षत्ति̱स्रो दे̱वीर्न भे̍ष̱जं त्रय̍स्त्रिधात̍वोऽप̱सो̍ रू̱पमिन्द्र̍ हिर̱ण्यय̍म̱श्विनेऌआ न भा̍रती वा̱चा सर̍स्वती म̱ह इन्द्रा̍य दुह इन्द्रि̱यं पय̱ः सोम̍ः परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the three goddesses, as medicine, the three threefold working gods, golden form in Indra, to the Aśvins, Iḷā, and Bhāratī; / Sarasvatī with her voice milks for great Indra manly power, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣat sure̱ta̍samṛṣa̱bhaṃ naryā̍pasa̱ṃ tvaṣṭā̍ra̱mindra̍ma̱śvinā̍ bhiṣa̱jaṃ na sara̍svatī̱mojo̱ na jū̱tiri̍ndri̱yaṃ vṛko̱ na ra̍bha̱so bhi̱ṣak yaśa̱ḥ sura̍yā bheṣa̱jam̐ śri̱yā na mā̍sa̱raṃ paya̱ḥ soma̍ḥ pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्षत् सुरे̱त̍समृष̱भं नर्या̍पस̱ं त्वष्टा̍र̱मिन्द्र̍म̱श्विना̍ भिष̱जं न सर̍स्वती̱मोजो̱ न जू̱तिरि̍न्द्रि̱यं वृको̱ न र̍भ̱सो भि̱षक् यश̱ः सुर̍या भेष̱जम्̐ श्रि̱या न मा̍स̱रं पय̱ः सोम̍ः परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Tvaṣṭṛ, the rich in seed, the bull of manly deeds, to Indra and the Aśvins, like a physician, and to Sarasvatī, might, impulse, manly power, like a swift wolf, the physician, / fame, with surā medicine, with fortune like māsara, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱dvana̱spati̱ṃ śami̍tāram̐ śa̱takra̍tuṃ bhī̱maṃ na ma̱nyum̐ rājā̍naṃ vyā̱ghraṃ nama̍sā̱śvinā̍ bhāma̱ḥ sara̍svatī bhi̱ṣagindrā̍ya duha indri̱yaṃ paya̱ḥ soma̍ḥ pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱द्वन̱स्पति̱ं शमि̍तारम्̐ श̱तक्र̍तुं भी̱मं न म̱न्युम्̐ राजा̍नं व्या̱घ्रं नम̍सा̱श्विना̍ भाम̱ः सर̍स्वती भि̱षगिन्द्रा̍य दुह इन्द्रि̱यं पय̱ः सोम̍ः परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the tree, the slaughterer, him of a hundred resolves, like a dreadful wrath, the king, the tiger, with reverence to the Aśvins; / Sarasvatī the physician milks fury, manly power for Indra, milk, Soma with parisrut, ghee, and honey. May they enjoy the melted butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

202.s: hotā̍ yakṣada̱gnim̐ svāhājya̍sya sto̱kānā̱m̐ svāhā̱ meda̍sāṃ pṛ̱thak svāhā̱ chāga̍ma̱śvibhyā̱m̐ svāhā̍ me̱ṣam̐ sara̍svatyai svāhā̍ ṛṣa̱bhamindrā̍ya si̱m̐hāya̱ saha̍sa indri̱yam̐ svāhā̱gniṃ na bhai̍ṣa̱jam̐ svāhā̱ soma̍mindri̱yam svāhendram̐̍ sutrā̱māṇam̐̍ savi̱tāra̱ṃ varu̍ṇaṃ bhiṣa̱jāṃ pati̱m̐ svāhā̱ vana̱spati̍ pri̱yaṃ pātho̱ na bhai̍ṣa̱jam svāhā̍ de̱vā ā̍jya̱pā ju̍ṣā̱ṇo a̱gnirbhai̍ṣa̱jaṃ paya̱ḥ soma̍ḥ pari̱srutā̍ ghṛ̱taṃ madhu̱ vyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
202.d: होता̍ यक्षद̱ग्निम्̐ स्वाहाज्य̍स्य स्तो̱काना̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ मेद̍सां पृ̱थक् स्वाहा̱ छाग̍म̱श्विभ्या̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ मे̱षम्̐ सर̍स्वत्यै स्वाहा̍ ऋष̱भमिन्द्रा̍य सि̱म्̐हाय̱ सह̍स इन्द्रि̱यम्̐ स्वाहा̱ग्निं न भै̍ष̱जम्̐ स्वाहा̱ सोम̍मिन्द्रि̱यम् स्वाहेन्द्रम्̐̍ सुत्रा̱माणम्̐̍ सवि̱तार̱ं वरु̍णं भिष̱जां पति̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ वन̱स्पति̍ प्रि̱यं पाथो̱ न भै̍ष̱जम् स्वाहा̍ दे̱वा आ̍ज्य̱पा जु̍षा̱णो अ̱ग्निर्भै̍ष̱जं पय̱ः सोम̍ः परि̱स्रुता̍ घृ̱तं मधु̱ व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
202.m: May the Hotṛ worship Agni; svāhā to the drops of ghee, svāhā to the portions of fat severally, svāhā to the he-goat for the two Aśvins, svāhā to the ram for Sarasvatī / svāhā to the bull for Indra the lion, power to his might, svāhā as medicine to Agni, svāhā to Soma, Indra's strength / svāhā to Indra the good protector, to Savitṛ, to Varuṇa the lord of physicians, svāhā to the tree, like a dear domain, a healing medicine / svāhā to the ghee-drinking gods! Agni taking pleasure [in them], the medicine, the milk, the Soma, the flowing liquor, the ghee, the honey—may they enjoy the ghee; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

203.s: (4) hotā̍ yakṣada̱śvinau̱ chāga̍sya va̱pāyā̱ meda̍so juṣetā̱m̐ ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍ hotā̍ yakṣa̱tsara̍svatīṃ me̱ṣasya̍ va̱pāyā̱ meda̍so juṣatā̱m̐ ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍ hotā̍ yakṣa̱dindra̍mṛṣa̱bhasya̍ va̱pāyā̱ meda̍so juṣatā̱m̐ ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍
203.d: (4) होता̍ यक्षद̱श्विनौ̱ छाग̍स्य व̱पाया̱ मेद̍सो जुषेता̱म्̐ ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍ होता̍ यक्ष̱त्सर̍स्वतीं मे̱षस्य̍ व̱पाया̱ मेद̍सो जुषता̱म्̐ ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍ होता̍ यक्ष̱दिन्द्र̍मृष̱भस्य̍ व̱पाया̱ मेद̍सो जुषता̱म्̐ ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍
203.m: May the Hotṛ worship the two Aśvins; may they enjoy the omentum, the fat of the he-goat, the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ worship Sarasvatī; may she enjoy the omentum, the fat of the ram, the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ worship Indra; may he enjoy the omentum, the fat of the bull, the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

203.s: hotā̍ yakṣada̱śvinau̱ sara̍svatī̱mindram̐̍ sutrā̱māṇa̍mi̱me somā̍ḥ sura̍māṇu̱śchāgai̱rna me̱ṣairṛ̍ṣa̱bhaiḥ su̱tāḥ śaṣpai̱rna tokma̍bhirlā̱jairmaha̍svanto̱ madā̍ māsa̱reṇa̱ pari̍ṣkṛtāḥ śu̱krāḥ paya̍svanto'mṛ̱tāḥ prasthi̍tā vo madhuścyuta̱stāna̱śvinā̱ sara̍svatīndra̍ḥ sutrā̱mā̍ vṛtra̱hā ju̍ṣantā̱m̐ somyaṃ madhu̍ piba̍ntu mada̍ntu̱ vyantu̱ hota̱ryaja̍
203.d: होता̍ यक्षद̱श्विनौ̱ सर̍स्वती̱मिन्द्रम्̐̍ सुत्रा̱माण̍मि̱मे सोमा̍ः सुर̍माणु̱श्छागै̱र्न मे̱षैरृ̍ष̱भैः सु̱ताः शष्पै̱र्न तोक्म̍भिर्ला̱जैर्मह̍स्वन्तो̱ मदा̍ मास̱रेण̱ परि̍ष्कृताः शु̱क्राः पय̍स्वन्तोऽमृ̱ताः प्रस्थि̍ता वो मधुश्च्युत̱स्तान̱श्विना̱ सर̍स्वतीन्द्र̍ः सुत्रा̱मा̍ वृत्र̱हा जु̍षन्ता̱म्̐ सोम्यं मधु̍ पिब̍न्तु मद̍न्तु̱ व्यन्तु̱ होत̱र्यज̍
203.m: May the Hotṛ worship the two Aśvins, Sarasvatī, Indra the good protector. These Somas, possessing wine, have been pressed with goats, rams, and bulls, / with young sprouts, shoot-germs, and roasted grain, mighty, exhilarating, prepared with malt, bright, full of milk, immortal, set forth, dripping with sweetness for you. May the two Aśvins, Sarasvatī, and Indra the good protector, slayer of Vṛtra, enjoy the Soma-honey! / Let them drink, let them exult, let them enjoy; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

203.s: hotā̍ yakṣada̱śvinau̱ chāga̍sya ha̱viṣa̱ āttā̍ma̱dya ma̍dhya̱to meda̱ udbhṛ̍taṃ pu̱rā dveṣo̍bhyaḥ pu̱rā pauru̍ṣeyyā gṛ̱bhaḥ | ghastā̍ṃ nū̱naṃ ghāse a̍jrāṇāṃ yava̍saprathamānām̐ sumatkṣa̍rāṇām̐ śataru̱driyā̍ṇāmagniṣvā̱ttānā̍ṃ pīvo̍pavasanānā̱m | pā̱rśvataḥ śro̱ṇitaḥ śi̍tā̱muta u̍tsā̱dato̍'ṅgā̍daṅgā̱dava̍ttānā̱ṃ kara̍ta e̱vāśvinā̍ juṣetā̱m̐2 havirhota̱ryaja̍ | hotā̍ yakṣa̱tsara̍svatīṃ me̱ṣasya̍ ha̱viṣa̱ āva̍yadya̱dya ma̍dhya̱to meda̱ uddhṛ̍taṃ pu̱rā dveṣo̍bhyaḥ pu̱rā pauru̍ṣeyyā gṛ̱bhaḥ | ghasa̍nnū̱naṃ ghā̱se a̍jrāṇā̱ṃ yava̍saprathamānām̐2 sumatkṣa̍rāṇām̐2 śataru̱driyā̍ṇāmagni̱ṣvāttā̍nāṃ pīvo̍pavasanānā̱m | pā̱rśvataḥ śro̱ṇitaḥ śi̍tā̱muta u̍tsā̱dato̱'ṅgā̍da̱ṅgādava̍ttānā̱ṃ kara̍de̱va2 sara̍svatī juṣatām̐2 ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍ | hotā̍ yakṣa̱dindra̍mṛṣa̱bhasya̍ ha̱viṣa̱ āva̍yadya̱dya ma̍dhya̱to meda̱ uddhṛ̍taṃ pu̱rā dveṣo̍bhyaḥ pu̱rā pauru̍ṣeyyā gṛ̱bhaḥ | ghasa̍nnū̱naṃ ghā̱se a̍jrāṇā̱ṃ yava̍saprathamānām̐2 sumatkṣa̍rāṇām̐2 śataru̱driyā̍ṇāmagni̱ṣvāttā̍nāṃ pīvo̍pavasanānā̱m pā̱rśvataḥ śro̱ṇitaḥ śi̍tā̱muta u̍tsā̱dato̍'ṅgā̍da̱ṅgādava̍ttānā̱ṃ kara̍de̱vamindro̍ juṣatām̐2 ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍
203.d: होता̍ यक्षद̱श्विनौ̱ छाग̍स्य ह̱विष̱ आत्ता̍म̱द्य म̍ध्य̱तो मेद̱ उद्भृ̍तं पु̱रा द्वेषो̍भ्यः पु̱रा पौरु̍षेय्या गृ̱भः । घस्ता̍ं नू̱नं घासे अ̍ज्राणां यव̍सप्रथमानाम्̐ सुमत्क्ष̍राणाम्̐ शतरु̱द्रिया̍णामग्निष्वा̱त्ताना̍ं पीवो̍पवसनाना̱म् । पा̱र्श्वतः श्रो̱णितः शि̍ता̱मुत उ̍त्सा̱दतो̍ऽङ्गा̍दङ्गा̱दव̍त्ताना̱ं कर̍त ए̱वाश्विना̍ जुषेता̱म्̐2 हविर्होत̱र्यज̍ । होता̍ यक्ष̱त्सर̍स्वतीं मे̱षस्य̍ ह̱विष̱ आव̍यद्य̱द्य म̍ध्य̱तो मेद̱ उद्धृ̍तं पु̱रा द्वेषो̍भ्यः पु̱रा पौरु̍षेय्या गृ̱भः । घस̍न्नू̱नं घा̱से अ̍ज्राणा̱ं यव̍सप्रथमानाम्̐2 सुमत्क्ष̍राणाम्̐2 शतरु̱द्रिया̍णामग्नि̱ष्वात्ता̍नां पीवो̍पवसनाना̱म् । पा̱र्श्वतः श्रो̱णितः शि̍ता̱मुत उ̍त्सा̱दतो̱ऽङ्गा̍द̱ङ्गादव̍त्ताना̱ं कर̍दे̱व2 सर̍स्वती जुषताम्̐2 ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍ । होता̍ यक्ष̱दिन्द्र̍मृष̱भस्य̍ ह̱विष̱ आव̍यद्य̱द्य म̍ध्य̱तो मेद̱ उद्धृ̍तं पु̱रा द्वेषो̍भ्यः पु̱रा पौरु̍षेय्या गृ̱भः । घस̍न्नू̱नं घा̱से अ̍ज्राणा̱ं यव̍सप्रथमानाम्̐2 सुमत्क्ष̍राणाम्̐2 शतरु̱द्रिया̍णामग्नि̱ष्वात्ता̍नां पीवो̍पवसनाना̱म् पा̱र्श्वतः श्रो̱णितः शि̍ता̱मुत उ̍त्सा̱दतो̍ऽङ्गा̍द̱ङ्गादव̍त्ताना̱ं कर̍दे̱वमिन्द्रो̍ जुषताम्̐2 ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍
203.m: May the Hotṛ worship the two Aśvins. May they today partake of the oblation of the he-goat, the fat drawn from the middle before the enmities, before human seizure. May the two eat now in the fodder of the fields, spreading with barley, well-dripping, belonging to the hundred Rudras, savored by Agni, clad in fat; may the two Aśvins do so from the flanks, from the hips, from the liver, from the rump, from the limbs carved part by part; may they enjoy the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice! May the Hotṛ worship Sarasvatī. May she today partake of the oblation of the ram, the fat drawn from the middle before the enmities, before human seizure. May she eat now in the fodder of the fields, spreading with barley, well-dripping, belonging to the hundred Rudras, savored by Agni, clad in fat; may Sarasvatī do so from the flanks, from the hips, from the liver, from the rump, from the limbs carved part by part; may she enjoy the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice! May the Hotṛ worship Indra. May he today partake of the oblation of the bull, the fat drawn from the middle before the enmities, before human seizure. May he eat now in the fodder of the fields, spreading with barley, well-dripping, belonging to the hundred Rudras, savored by Agni, clad in fat; / may Indra do so from the flanks, from the hips, from the liver, from the rump, from the limbs carved part by part; may he enjoy the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

203.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱dvana̱spati̍ma̱bhi hi pi̱ṣṭata̍mayā rabhi̍ṣṭhayā raśa̱nayādhi̍ta yatrāśvinośchāga̍sya ha̱viṣa̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatra̱ sara̍svatyā me̱ṣasya̍ ha̱viṣa̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatrendra̍sya ṛṣa̱bhasya̍ ha̱viṣa̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni yatrāgneḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatra̱ soma̍sya pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatrendra̍sya sutrā̱mṇaḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni yatra̍ savi̱tuḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatra̱ varu̍ṇasya pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatra̱ vana̱spate̍ḥ pri̱yā pāthā̍m̐2si yatra̍ de̱vānā̍mājya̱pānā̍ṃ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yatrā̱gnerhotu̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni tatrai̍tānpra̱stutyai̍vopa̱stutyai̍vopāva̍srakṣa̱drabhī̍yasa iva kṛ̱tvī kara̍de̱vaṃ de̱vo vana̱spati̍rjuṣatām̐2 ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍
203.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱द्वन̱स्पति̍म̱भि हि पि̱ष्टत̍मया रभि̍ष्ठया रश̱नयाधि̍त यत्राश्विनोश्छाग̍स्य ह̱विष̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्र̱ सर̍स्वत्या मे̱षस्य̍ ह̱विष̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्रेन्द्र̍स्य ऋष̱भस्य̍ ह̱विष̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि यत्राग्नेः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्र̱ सोम̍स्य प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्रेन्द्र̍स्य सुत्रा̱म्णः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि यत्र̍ सवि̱तुः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्र̱ वरु̍णस्य प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्र̱ वन̱स्पते̍ः प्रि̱या पाथा̍म्̐2सि यत्र̍ दे̱वाना̍माज्य̱पाना̍ं प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यत्रा̱ग्नेर्होतु̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि तत्रै̍तान्प्र̱स्तुत्यै̍वोप̱स्तुत्यै̍वोपाव̍स्रक्ष̱द्रभी̍यस इव कृ̱त्वी कर̍दे̱वं दे̱वो वन̱स्पति̍र्जुषताम्̐2 ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍
203.m: May the Hotṛ worship the tree; for with the best-formed, the swiftest halter he bound [it], / where the dear domains of the two Aśvins' goat-oblation are, where the dear domains of Sarasvatī's ram-oblation are, where the dear domains of Indra's bull-oblation are, / where the dear domains of Agni are, where the dear domains of Soma are, where the dear domains of Indra the good protector are, / where the dear domains of Savitṛ are, where the dear domains of Varuṇa are, where the dear abodes of the tree are, / where the dear domains of the ghee-drinking gods are, where the dear domains of Agni the Hotṛ are. / There, having as it were praised, as it were lauded, he let these loose, having made them as it were stronger. So may the divine tree act; may he enjoy the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

203.s: hotā̍ yakṣada̱gni2 sviṣṭa̱kṛta̍mayā̍ḍa̱gniraśvinośchāga̍sya ha̱viṣa̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍nyayā̱ṭ sara̍svatyā me̱ṣasya̍ ha̱viṣa̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍nyayā̱ḍindra̍sya ṛṣa̱bhasya̍ ha̱viṣa̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni ayā̍ḍa̱gneḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍nyayā̱ṭ soma̍sya pri̱yā dhāmā̍nyayā̱ḍindra̍sya sutrā̱mṇaḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni ayā̍ṭ savi̱tuḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍nyayā̱ḍ varu̍ṇasya pri̱yā dhāmā̍nyayā̱ḍ vana̱spate̍ḥ pri̱yā pāthā̍m̐2si ayā̍ḍ de̱vānā̍mājya̱pānā̍ṃ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni̱ yakṣa̍da̱gnerhotu̍ḥ pri̱yā dhāmā̍ni | yakṣa̱tsvaṃ ma̍hi̱māna̍māya̍jatāme̱jyā iṣa̍ḥ kṛṇotu̱ so a̍dhva̱rā jā̱tave̍dā juṣatām̐2 ha̱virhota̱ryaja̍
203.d: होता̍ यक्षद̱ग्नि2 स्विष्ट̱कृत̍मया̍ड̱ग्निरश्विनोश्छाग̍स्य ह̱विष̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍न्यया̱ट् सर̍स्वत्या मे̱षस्य̍ ह̱विष̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍न्यया̱डिन्द्र̍स्य ऋष̱भस्य̍ ह̱विष̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि अया̍ड̱ग्नेः प्रि̱या धामा̍न्यया̱ट् सोम̍स्य प्रि̱या धामा̍न्यया̱डिन्द्र̍स्य सुत्रा̱म्णः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि अया̍ट् सवि̱तुः प्रि̱या धामा̍न्यया̱ड् वरु̍णस्य प्रि̱या धामा̍न्यया̱ड् वन̱स्पते̍ः प्रि̱या पाथा̍म्̐2सि अया̍ड् दे̱वाना̍माज्य̱पाना̍ं प्रि̱या धामा̍नि̱ यक्ष̍द̱ग्नेर्होतु̍ः प्रि̱या धामा̍नि । यक्ष̱त्स्वं म̍हि̱मान̍माय̍जतामे̱ज्या इष̍ः कृणोतु̱ सो अ̍ध्व̱रा जा̱तवे̍दा जुषताम्̐2 ह̱विर्होत̱र्यज̍
203.m: May the Hotṛ worship Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. Agni has worshipped the dear domains of the two Aśvins' goat-oblation, he has worshipped the dear domains of Sarasvatī's ram-oblation, he has worshipped the dear domains of Indra's bull-oblation, / he has worshipped the dear domains of Agni, he has worshipped the dear domains of Soma, he has worshipped the dear domains of Indra the good protector, / he has worshipped the dear domains of Savitṛ, he has worshipped the dear domains of Varuṇa, he has worshipped the dear abodes of the tree, / he has worshipped the dear domains of the ghee-drinking gods; may he worship the dear domains of Agni the Hotṛ; may he worship his own greatness; may he bring near offerings to be sacrificed; may he make the rites effective, Jātavedas; may he enjoy the oblation; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vaṃ ba̱rhiḥ sara̍svatī sude̱vamindra̍ma̱śvinā̍ tejo̱ na cakṣu̍ra̱kṣyo̍rba̱rhiṣā̍ dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वं ब̱र्हिः सर̍स्वती सुदे̱वमिन्द्र̍म̱श्विना̍ तेजो̱ न चक्षु̍र̱क्ष्यो̍र्ब̱र्हिषा̍ दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine barhis, Sarasvatī, the good deity, and the two Aśvins in Indra / placed through the barhis Indra's virility, as light in the two eyes, his sight; may they enjoy the bestowal of wealth, for the winning of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vīrdvā̍ro̍ a̱śvinā̍ bhi̱ṣajendra̍ sara̍svatī prā̱ṇaṃ na vī̱rya̍ na̱si dvā̱ro̍ dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वीर्द्वा̍रो̍ अ̱श्विना̍ भि̱षजेन्द्र̍ सर̍स्वती प्रा̱णं न वी̱र्य̍ न̱सि द्वा̱रो̍ दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine doors, the two Aśvins the physicians, and Sarasvatī in Indra / placed through the doors Indra's virility, as the in-breath and vigor in the nose; may they enjoy the bestowal of wealth, for the winning of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vī u̱ṣāsā̍ a̱śvinā̍ sutrā̱mendre̱ sara̍svatī bala̱ṃ na vāca̍mā̱sya̍ u̱ṣābhyā̍ṃ dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वी उ̱षासा̍ अ̱श्विना̍ सुत्रा̱मेन्द्रे̱ सर̍स्वती बल̱ं न वाच̍मा̱स्य̍ उ̱षाभ्या̍ं दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine Dawns, the two Aśvins, and Sarasvatī, the good protector, in Indra / placed through the two dawns Indra's virility, as strength and speech in the mouth; may they enjoy the bestowal of wealth, for the winning of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vī joṣṭrī sara̍svatya̱śvinendra̍mavardhayan śrotra̱ṃ na karṇa̍yo̱ryaśo̱ joṣṭrī̍bhyāṃ dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वी जोष्ट्री सर̍स्वत्य̱श्विनेन्द्र̍मवर्धयन् श्रोत्र̱ं न कर्ण̍यो̱र्यशो̱ जोष्ट्री̍भ्यां दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The two divine Fosterers, Sarasvatī, and the two Aśvins strengthened Indra; / through the two Fosterers they placed Indra's virility, as hearing and renown in the two ears; may they enjoy the bestowal of wealth, for the winning of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vī ū̱rjāhu̍tī du̱ghe su̍du̱ghendre̱ sara̍svatya̱śvinā̍ bhi̱ṣajā̍vataḥ śu̱kraṃ na jyoti̱ stana̍yo̱rāhu̍tī dhatta indri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वी ऊ̱र्जाहु̍ती दु̱घे सु̍दु̱घेन्द्रे̱ सर̍स्वत्य̱श्विना̍ भि̱षजा̍वतः शु̱क्रं न ज्योति̱ स्तन̍यो̱राहु̍ती धत्त इन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The two divine milkers of refreshment-oblations, yielding abundantly, in Indra, Sarasvatī, and the two Aśvins, the physicians, protect [him]; / the two oblations bestow Indra's virility, as bright radiance in the two breasts; may they enjoy the bestowal of wealth, for the winning of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vā de̱vānā̍ṃ bhi̱ṣajā̱ hotā̍rā̱ indra̍ma̱śvinā̍ vaṣaṭkā̱raiḥ sara̍svatī̱ tviṣi̱ṃ na hṛda̍ye ma̱tim hotu̍bhyāṃ dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वा दे̱वाना̍ं भि̱षजा̱ होता̍रा̱ इन्द्र̍म̱श्विना̍ वषट्का̱रैः सर̍स्वती̱ त्विषि̱ं न हृद̍ये म̱तिम् होतु̍भ्यां दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine two Hotṛs of the gods, the physicians, the two Aśvins in Indra, [and] Sarasvatī with vaṣaṭ-calls, / placed through the two Hotṛs Indra's virility, as splendor and thought in the heart; may they enjoy the bestowal of wealth, for the winning of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vīsti̱srasti̱sro de̱vīra̱śvineḷā sara̍svatī śūṣa̱ṃ na madhyai̱ nābhyā̱mindrā̍ya dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वीस्ति̱स्रस्ति̱स्रो दे̱वीर̱श्विनेऌआ सर̍स्वती शूष̱ं न मध्यै̱ नाभ्या̱मिन्द्रा̍य दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The three goddesses, the three goddesses, with the Aśvins, Iḷā, Sarasvatī, / placed vital power into Indra, like strength in the middle of the navel. Let them enjoy the acquisition of wealth in the gain of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱va indro̱ narāśa̍m̐sastrivarū̱thaḥ sara̍svatyā̱śvibhyā̍mīyate̱ ratha̍ḥ reto̱ na rū̱pama̱mṛta̍ṃ ja̱nitra̱mindrā̍ya̱ tvaṣṭā̍ dadha̍dindri̱yāṇi̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱व इन्द्रो̱ नराश̍म्̐सस्त्रिवरू̱थः सर̍स्वत्या̱श्विभ्या̍मीयते̱ रथ̍ः रेतो̱ न रू̱पम̱मृत̍ं ज̱नित्र̱मिन्द्रा̍य̱ त्वष्टा̍ दध̍दिन्द्रि̱याणि̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine Indra Narāśaṃsa, three-sheltered, with Sarasvatī and the two Aśvins, drives his chariot. / Tvaṣṭṛ, establishing immortal seed, form, and procreative power for Indra, placed his faculties. Let them enjoy the acquisition of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vo de̱vairva̍na̱spati̱rhira̍ṇyaparṇo a̱śvibhyā̱m̐ sara̍svatyā supippa̱la indrā̍ya pacyate̱ madhu̍ ojo̱ na jūti̍rṛṣa̱bho na bhāma̱ṃ vana̱spati̍rno dadha̍dindri̱yāṇi̍ vasuvane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वो दे̱वैर्व̍न̱स्पति̱र्हिर̍ण्यपर्णो अ̱श्विभ्या̱म्̐ सर̍स्वत्या सुपिप्प̱ल इन्द्रा̍य पच्यते̱ मधु̍ ओजो̱ न जूति̍रृष̱भो न भाम̱ं वन̱स्पति̍र्नो दध̍दिन्द्रि̱याणि̍ वसुवने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine tree with the gods, golden-leaved, rich in fine fruit, with the Aśvins and Sarasvatī, ripens sweetness for Indra. / Like vigor, speed, like a bull, fury—may the tree place faculties in us. Let them enjoy the acquisition of wealth in the gain of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vaṃ ba̱rhirvā̍ri̍tīnāmadhva̱re stī̱rṇama̱śvibhyā̱mūrṇa̍mradāḥ sara̍svatyā syo̱namindra̱ te sada̍ḥ īśā̍yai ma̱nyum̐ rājā̍naṃ ba̱rhiṣā̍ dadhurindri̱yaṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वं ब̱र्हिर्वा̍रि̍तीनामध्व̱रे स्ती̱र्णम̱श्विभ्या̱मूर्ण̍म्रदाः सर̍स्वत्या स्यो̱नमिन्द्र̱ ते सद̍ः ईशा̍यै म̱न्युम्̐ राजा̍नं ब̱र्हिषा̍ दधुरिन्द्रि̱यं वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: The divine barhis, strewn at the sacrifice of the flowing waters, soft as wool, with the Aśvins and Sarasvatī, is your pleasant seat, O Indra. / By the barhis they placed royal fury for the ruler, [and] vital power. Let them enjoy the acquisition of wealth in the gain of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: de̱vo a̱gniḥ sviṣṭa̱kṛdde̱vānya̍kṣadyathāya̱tham̐ hotā̍rā̱ indra̍ma̱śvinā̍ vā̱cā vā̱cam̐ sara̍svatīma̱gnim̐ somam̐̍ sviṣṭa̱kṛt sviṣṭa̱ indra̍ḥ sutrā̱mā savi̱tā varu̍ṇo bhi̱ṣagiṣṭo̍ de̱vo vana̱spati̍ḥ sviṣṭo̍ de̱vā ājya̱pāḥ sviṣṭo̍ a̱gnira̱gninā̱ hotā̍ hotre sviṣṭa̱kṛdyaśo̱ na dadha̍dindri̱yamūrja̱mapa̍citi̱m̐ sva̱dhāṃ vasu̍vane̍ vasu̱dheya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
204.d: दे̱वो अ̱ग्निः स्विष्ट̱कृद्दे̱वान्य̍क्षद्यथाय̱थम्̐ होता̍रा̱ इन्द्र̍म̱श्विना̍ वा̱चा वा̱चम्̐ सर̍स्वतीम̱ग्निम्̐ सोमम्̐̍ स्विष्ट̱कृत् स्विष्ट̱ इन्द्र̍ः सुत्रा̱मा सवि̱ता वरु̍णो भि̱षगिष्टो̍ दे̱वो वन̱स्पति̍ः स्विष्टो̍ दे̱वा आज्य̱पाः स्विष्टो̍ अ̱ग्निर̱ग्निना̱ होता̍ होत्रे स्विष्ट̱कृद्यशो̱ न दध̍दिन्द्रि̱यमूर्ज̱मप̍चिति̱म्̐ स्व̱धां वसु̍वने̍ वसु̱धेय̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
204.m: May the divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt sacrifice to the gods each in proper order, the two Hotṛs to Indra and the two Aśvins, with speech to speech, to Sarasvatī, to Agni, to Soma, Sviṣṭakṛt! / Well-sacrificed is Indra the good protector, Savitṛ, Varuṇa the physician; sacrificed is the divine tree; well-sacrificed are the ghee-drinking gods! / Well-sacrificed is Agni by Agni, the Hotṛ for the Hotṛ, Sviṣṭakṛt, bestowing glory, vital power, refreshment, honor, svadhā! Let them enjoy the acquisition of wealth in the gain of wealth; sacrifice!

204.s: a̱gnima̱dya hotā̍ramavṛṇītā̱yaṃ yaja̍māna̱ḥ paca̱n paktīḥ paca̍n puroḷā̱śān ba̱dhnanna̱śvibhyā̍ṃ chā̱gam̐ sara̍svatyai me̱ṣamindrā̍ya ṛṣa̱bham sunvanna̱śvibhyā̱m̐ sara̍svatyā̱ indrā̍ya sutrā̱mṇe surāso̱mān
204.d: अ̱ग्निम̱द्य होता̍रमवृणीता̱यं यज̍मान̱ः पच̱न् पक्तीः पच̍न् पुरोऌआ̱शान् ब̱ध्नन्न̱श्विभ्या̍ं छा̱गम्̐ सर̍स्वत्यै मे̱षमिन्द्रा̍य ऋष̱भम् सुन्वन्न̱श्विभ्या̱म्̐ सर̍स्वत्या̱ इन्द्रा̍य सुत्रा̱म्णे सुरासो̱मान्
204.m: Today this sacrificer has chosen Agni as Hotṛ, cooking cooked offerings, cooking puroḍāśas, binding a he-goat for the Aśvins, a ram for Sarasvatī, a bull for Indra, / pressing surā-somas for the Aśvins, for Sarasvatī, and for Indra the good protector.

204.s: sūpa̱sthā a̱dya de̱vo vana̱spati̍rabhavada̱śvibhyā̍ṃ chā̱gena̱ sara̍svatyai me̱ṣeṇendrā̍ya ṛṣa̱bheṇa̍ akṣa̱nstān meda̍sta̱ḥ prati̍ paca̱tāgṛ̍bhīṣatāvī̍vṛdhanta puroḷā̱śairapu̍raśvi̱nā sara̍svatīndra̍ḥ sutrā̱mā surāso̱mān
204.d: सूप̱स्था अ̱द्य दे̱वो वन̱स्पति̍रभवद̱श्विभ्या̍ं छा̱गेन̱ सर̍स्वत्यै मे̱षेणेन्द्रा̍य ऋष̱भेण̍ अक्ष̱न्स्तान् मेद̍स्त̱ः प्रति̍ पच̱तागृ̍भीषतावी̍वृधन्त पुरोऌआ̱शैरपु̍रश्वि̱ना सर̍स्वतीन्द्र̍ः सुत्रा̱मा सुरासो̱मान्
204.m: Today the divine tree has provided a good lap for the Aśvins with the he-goat, for Sarasvatī with the ram, for Indra with the bull. / They have eaten the fat; they have accepted the cooked portions; they have prospered with the puroḍāśas; the Aśvins, Sarasvatī, and Indra the good protector have drunk the surā-somas.

204.s:
tvāma̱dya ṛ̍ṣa ārṣeya ṛṣīṇāṃ napādavṛṇītā̱yaṃ yaja̍māno ba̱hubhya̱ ā saṃga̍tebhya e̱ṣa me̍ de̱veṣu̱ vasu̱ vāryā̍yakṣyata̱ iti̍ tā yā de̱vā de̱va dānā̍nyadustāntya̍smā ā ca̍ śāsvā ca̍ gurasveṣi̱taśca̍ hotarasi̍ bha̱dravācyā̍ya̱ preṣi̍to̱ mānu̍ṣaḥ sūktavā̱kāya̍ sūktā brū̍hi
(6) imaṃ me varuṇa dvādaśa
samiddho agnirekādaśa
vasantena ṣaṭ
hotā yakṣad dvādaśa
hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya pañca
devaṃ barhiścaturdaśa
204.d:
त्वाम̱द्य ऋ̍ष आर्षेय ऋषीणां नपादवृणीता̱यं यज̍मानो ब̱हुभ्य̱ आ संग̍तेभ्य ए̱ष मे̍ दे̱वेषु̱ वसु̱ वार्या̍यक्ष्यत̱ इति̍ ता या दे̱वा दे̱व दाना̍न्यदुस्तान्त्य̍स्मा आ च̍ शास्वा च̍ गुरस्वेषि̱तश्च̍ होतरसि̍ भ̱द्रवाच्या̍य̱ प्रेषि̍तो̱ मानु̍षः सूक्तवा̱काय̍ सूक्ता ब्रू̍हि
(6) इमं मे वरुण द्वादश
समिद्धो अग्निरेकादश
वसन्तेन षट्
होता यक्षद् द्वादश
होता यक्षदश्विनौ छागस्य पञ्च
देवं बर्हिश्चतुर्दश
204.m:
Today, O sage descended from sages, descendant of the sages, this sacrificer has chosen you from among many assembled, saying: 'May he sacrifice to the gods for my valuable wealth.' / The divine gifts that the gods have given, announce them to him and accept them with approval. And you, O Hotṛ, are urged; directed for auspicious speech, speak the sūktas for the sūktavāka!

'This of mine, O Varuṇa', twelve. 'Enkindled is Agni', eleven. 'With spring', six. 'May the Hotṛ sacrifice', twelve. 'May the Hotṛ sacrifice, of the goat of the two Aśvins', five. 'The divine barhis', fourteen. / In the six anuvākas, sixty. / Thus ends the twenty-third adhyāya in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

205.s: tejo̍'si śu̱krama̱mṛta̍māyuṣpā āyu̍rme pāhi de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyāmā da̍de
205.d: तेजो̍ऽसि शु̱क्रम̱मृत̍मायुष्पा आयु̍र्मे पाहि दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्यामा द̍दे
205.m: You are brilliance, bright, immortal, guarding lifetime; protect my lifetime. / At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take you.

205.s: i̱māma̍gṛbhṇan raśa̱nāmṛ̱tasya̱ pūrva̱ āyu̍ṣi vi̱dathai̍ṣu ka̱vyā sā nau̍ a̱smintsuta ā ba̍bhūva ṛ̱tasya̱ sāma̍ntsara̱mārapa̍ntī
205.d: इ̱माम̍गृभ्णन् रश̱नामृ̱तस्य̱ पूर्व̱ आयु̍षि वि̱दथै̍षु क̱व्या सा नौ̍ अ̱स्मिन्त्सुत आ ब̍भूव ऋ̱तस्य̱ साम̍न्त्सर̱मारप̍न्ती
205.m: They seized this halter of truth, the sage-poets in their earlier lifetime, in the gatherings. / May it be present for us at this pressing, barking at the border of truth like Saramā.

205.s: a̱bhidhā a̍si̱ bhuva̍namasi ya̱ntāsi̍ dha̱rtā sa tvama̱gniṃ vai̍śvāna̱ram̐ sapra̍thasaṃ gaccha̱ svāhā̍kṛtaḥ sva̱gā tvā̍ de̱vebhya̍ḥ
205.d: अ̱भिधा अ̍सि̱ भुव̍नमसि य̱न्तासि̍ ध̱र्ता स त्वम̱ग्निं वै̍श्वान̱रम्̐ सप्र̍थसं गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍कृतः स्व̱गा त्वा̍ दे̱वेभ्य̍ः
205.m: You are the halter; you are the world; you are the guide; you are the maintainer. / Go, made into svāhā, to Agni Vaiśvānara of wide expanse; svagā to you from the gods!

205.s: pra̱jāpa̍taye̱ brahma̱katha̍ṃ bhuntsyāmi̍ de̱vebhya̍ḥ pra̱jāpa̍taye̱ tena̍ rādhyāsam taṃ ba̍dhāna de̱vebhya̍ḥ pra̱jāpa̍taye̱ tena̍ rādhnuhi pra̱jāpa̍taye tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ prokṣā̱mīndrā̱gnibhyā̍ṃ tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ prokṣā̍mi vā̱yave̍ tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ prokṣā̍mi viśve̍bhyastvā de̱vebhyo̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ prokṣā̍mi sarve̍bhyastvā de̱vebhyo̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ prokṣā̍mi
205.d: प्र̱जाप̍तये̱ ब्रह्म̱कथ̍ं भुन्त्स्यामि̍ दे̱वेभ्य̍ः प्र̱जाप̍तये̱ तेन̍ राध्यासम् तं ब̍धान दे̱वेभ्य̍ः प्र̱जाप̍तये̱ तेन̍ राध्नुहि प्र̱जाप̍तये त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं प्रोक्षा̱मीन्द्रा̱ग्निभ्या̍ं त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं प्रोक्षा̍मि वा̱यवे̍ त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं प्रोक्षा̍मि विश्वे̍भ्यस्त्वा दे̱वेभ्यो̱ जुष्ट̍ं प्रोक्षा̍मि सर्वे̍भ्यस्त्वा दे̱वेभ्यो̱ जुष्ट̍ं प्रोक्षा̍मि
205.m: O Brahman, I will bind the horse for Prajāpati, for the gods. Through it may I succeed for Prajāpati. / Bind it for the gods, for Prajāpati; through it succeed! / I sprinkle you agreeable to Prajāpati; I sprinkle you agreeable to Indrāgnī; I sprinkle you agreeable to Vāyu; I sprinkle you agreeable to the Viśve Devāḥ; I sprinkle you agreeable to all the gods.

205.s: yo arva̍ntaṃ jighāṃm̐sati tama̱bhya̍mīti varu̍ṇaḥ | pa̱ro marta̍ḥ pa̱raḥ śvā
205.d: यो अर्व̍न्तं जिघांम्̐सति तम̱भ्य̍मीति वरु̍णः । प̱रो मर्त̍ः प̱रः श्वा
205.m: Whoever seeks to harm the courser, Varuṇa attacks him. Away be the mortal! Away be the hound!

206.s:
(1) a̱gnaye̱ svāhā̱ somā̍ya̱ svāhā̱pāṃ modā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ savi̱tre svāhā̍ vā̱yave̱ svāhā̱ viṣṇa̍ve̱ svāhā̍ indrā̍ya̱ svāhā̱ bṛha̱spata̍ye̱ svāhā̍ mi̱trāya̱ svāhā̱ varu̍ṇāya̱ svāhā̍
(2) hiṅkā̱rāya̱ svāhā̱ hiṅkṛ̍tāya̱ svāhā̱ kranda̍te̱ svāhā̍vakra̱ndāya̱ svāhā̍ protha̍te̱ svāhā̍ prapro̱thāya̱ svāhā̍ ga̱ndhāya̱ svāhā̍ ghrā̱tāya̱ svāhā̍
206.d:
(1) अ̱ग्नये̱ स्वाहा̱ सोमा̍य̱ स्वाहा̱पां मोदा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ सवि̱त्रे स्वाहा̍ वा̱यवे̱ स्वाहा̱ विष्ण̍वे̱ स्वाहा̍ इन्द्रा̍य̱ स्वाहा̱ बृह̱स्पत̍ये̱ स्वाहा̍ मि̱त्राय̱ स्वाहा̱ वरु̍णाय̱ स्वाहा̍
(2) हिङ्का̱राय̱ स्वाहा̱ हिङ्कृ̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̱ क्रन्द̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍वक्र̱न्दाय̱ स्वाहा̍ प्रोथ̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍ प्रप्रो̱थाय̱ स्वाहा̍ ग̱न्धाय̱ स्वाहा̍ घ्रा̱ताय̱ स्वाहा̍
206.m:
To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā! To the joy of the waters svāhā! To Savitṛ svāhā! To Vāyu svāhā! To Viṣṇu svāhā! / To Indra svāhā! To Bṛhaspati svāhā! To Mitra svāhā! To Varuṇa svāhā!

To the sound 'hiṅ' svāhā! To the one making the sound 'hiṅ' svāhā! To the neighing one svāhā! To the one who has neighed svāhā! / To the snorting one svāhā! To the one who has snorted repeatedly svāhā! To smell svāhā! To what is smelled svāhā!

206.s: nivi̍ṣṭāya̱ svāhopa̍viṣṭāya̱ svāhā̱ saṃdi̍tāya̱ svāhā̱ valga̍te̱ svāhā̍ āsī̍nāya̱ svāhā̱ śayā̍nāya̱ svāhā̱ svapa̍te̱ svāhā̱ jāgra̍te̱ svāhā̍
206.d: निवि̍ष्टाय̱ स्वाहोप̍विष्टाय̱ स्वाहा̱ संदि̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̱ वल्ग̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍ आसी̍नाय̱ स्वाहा̱ शया̍नाय̱ स्वाहा̱ स्वप̍ते̱ स्वाहा̱ जाग्र̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍
206.m: To the entered one svāhā! To the seated one svāhā! To the bound one svāhā! To the galloping one svāhā! / To the sitting one svāhā! To the lying one svāhā! To the sleeping one svāhā! To the waking one svāhā!

206.s: kūja̍te̱ svāhā̱ prabu̍ddhāya̱ svāhā̍ vi̱jṛmbha̍māṇāya̱ svāhā̱ vivṛ̍ttāya̱ svāhā̍ sam̐hā̍nāya̱ svāhopa̍sthitāya̱ svāhāya̍nāya̱ svāhā̱ prāya̍ṇāya̱ svāhā̍
206.d: कूज̍ते̱ स्वाहा̱ प्रबु̍द्धाय̱ स्वाहा̍ वि̱जृम्भ̍माणाय̱ स्वाहा̱ विवृ̍त्ताय̱ स्वाहा̍ सम्̐हा̍नाय̱ स्वाहोप̍स्थिताय̱ स्वाहाय̍नाय̱ स्वाहा̱ प्राय̍णाय̱ स्वाहा̍
206.m: To the whinnying one svāhā! To the awakened one svāhā! To the yawning one svāhā! To the untied one svāhā! / To the crouching one svāhā! To the stood-up one svāhā! To going svāhā! To setting out svāhā!

206.s: ya̱te svāhā̱ dhāva̍te̱ svāho̍ddā̱vāya̱ svāhoddru̍tāya̱ svāhā̍ śūkā̍rāya̱ svāhā̱ śūkṛ̍tāya̱ svāhā̱ niṣa̍ṇṇāya̱ svāhotthi̍tāya̱ svāhā̍
206.d: य̱ते स्वाहा̱ धाव̍ते̱ स्वाहो̍द्दा̱वाय̱ स्वाहोद्द्रु̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̍ शूका̍राय̱ स्वाहा̱ शूकृ̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̱ निष̍ण्णाय̱ स्वाहोत्थि̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̍
206.m: To the moving one svāhā! To the running one svāhā! To running upward svāhā! To the one who has run upward svāhā! / To the sound 'śū' svāhā! To the one who has made the sound 'śū' svāhā! To the settled one svāhā! To the risen one svāhā!

206.s: ja̱vāya̱ svāhā̱ balā̍ya̱ svāhā̱ viva̍rtamānāya̱ svāhā̱ vivṛ̍ttāya̱ svāhā̍ vidhū̍nvānāya̱ svāhā̱ vidhū̍tāya̱ svāhā̱ śuśrū̍ṣamāṇāya̱ svāhā̍ śṛ̱ṇva̱te svāhā̍
206.d: ज̱वाय̱ स्वाहा̱ बला̍य̱ स्वाहा̱ विव̍र्तमानाय̱ स्वाहा̱ विवृ̍त्ताय̱ स्वाहा̍ विधू̍न्वानाय̱ स्वाहा̱ विधू̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̱ शुश्रू̍षमाणाय̱ स्वाहा̍ शृ̱ण्व̱ते स्वाहा̍
206.m: To speed svāhā! To strength svāhā! To the rolling one svāhā! To the one who has rolled over svāhā! / To the shaking one svāhā! To the shaken one svāhā! To the attentive one svāhā! To the listening one svāhā!

206.s: īkṣa̍māṇāya̱ svāhekṣi̍tāya̱ svāhā̱ vīkṣi̍tāya̱ svāhā̍ ni̱meṣā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ yadatti̱ tasmai̱ svāhā̱ yatpiba̍ti̱ tasmai̱ svāhā̱ yanmūtra̍ṃ ka̱roti̱ tasmai̱ svāhā̍ kurva̱te svāhā̍ kṛ̱tāya̱ svāhā̍
206.d: ईक्ष̍माणाय̱ स्वाहेक्षि̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̱ वीक्षि̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̍ नि̱मेषा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ यदत्ति̱ तस्मै̱ स्वाहा̱ यत्पिब̍ति̱ तस्मै̱ स्वाहा̱ यन्मूत्र̍ं क̱रोति̱ तस्मै̱ स्वाहा̍ कुर्व̱ते स्वाहा̍ कृ̱ताय̱ स्वाहा̍
206.m: To the looking one svāhā! To the looked-at one svāhā! To the closely looked-at one svāhā! To the blinking one svāhā! / What he eats, to that svāhā! What he drinks, to that svāhā! What urine he passes, to that svāhā! To the one doing svāhā! To what has been done svāhā!

207.s: (3) tatsa̍vi̱turvare̍ṇya̱ṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̍t
207.d: (3) तत्स̍वि̱तुर्वरे̍ण्य̱ं भर्गो̍ दे̱वस्य̍ धीमहि । धियो̱ यो न̍ः प्रचो̱दया̍त्
207.m: We meditate upon that excellent splendor of the god Savitṛ, / who shall inspire our visions.

207.s: hira̍ṇyapāṇimū̱taye̍ savi̱tāra̱mupa̍ hvaye | sa cettā̍ de̱vatā̍ pa̱dam
207.d: हिर̍ण्यपाणिमू̱तये̍ सवि̱तार̱मुप̍ ह्वये । स चेत्ता̍ दे̱वता̍ प̱दम्
207.m: I invoke here the golden-handed Savitṛ for aid; / he, the conscious one, [determines] the realm among the deities.

207.s: de̱vasya̍ ce̱tato̍ ma̱hīṃ pra sa̍vi̱turha̍vāmahe | su̱ma̱tim̐ sa̱tyarā̍dhasam
207.d: दे̱वस्य̍ चे̱ततो̍ म̱हीं प्र स̍वि̱तुर्ह̍वामहे । सु̱म̱तिम्̐ स̱त्यरा̍धसम्
207.m: We invoke the great favor of the conscious god Savitṛ, / rich in true gifts.

207.s: su̱ṣṭutim̐ su̍matī̱vṛdho̱ rātim̐ sa̍vitu̱rīma̍he | pra de̱vāya̍ matī̱vide̍
207.d: सु̱ष्टुतिम्̐ सु̍मती̱वृधो̱ रातिम्̐ स̍वितु̱रीम̍हे । प्र दे̱वाय̍ मती̱विदे̍
207.m: For good praise, increasing goodwill, we seek the gift of Savitṛ, / forth for the god who knows our devotion.

207.s: rātim̐ sa̍tpa̍tiṃ ma̱he sa̍vi̱tāra̱mupa̍ hvaye | ā̱sava̍ṃ de̱vavī̍taye
207.d: रातिम्̐ स̍त्प̍तिं म̱हे स̍वि̱तार̱मुप̍ ह्वये । आ̱सव̍ं दे̱ववी̍तये
207.m: I invoke for aid the bountiful lord of the worthy, Savitṛ the great, / the stimulator, for the feast of the gods.

207.s: de̱vasya̍ savi̱turma̱timā̍sa̱vaṃ vi̱śvade̍vyam | dhi̱yā bhaga̍ṃ manāmahe
207.d: दे̱वस्य̍ सवि̱तुर्म̱तिमा̍स̱वं वि̱श्वदे̍व्यम् । धि̱या भग̍ं मनामहे
207.m: We meditate with insight upon the thought of god Savitṛ, / his incitement relating to all the gods, [and upon] Bhaga.

207.s: a̱gnim̐ stome̍na bodhaya samidhā̱no ama̍rtyam | ha̱vyā de̱veṣu̍ no dadhat
207.d: अ̱ग्निम्̐ स्तोमे̍न बोधय समिधा̱नो अम̍र्त्यम् । ह̱व्या दे̱वेषु̍ नो दधत्
207.m: Awaken Agni with praise, being kindled, the immortal, / that he may place our oblations among the gods.
He, the bearer of oblations, the immortal, eager, the messenger, loved by all, / Agni, is united with our insight.

207.s: taṃ tvā̍ ghṛ̱tasna̍ īmahe ci̱trabhā̍no sva̱rvida̍m | de̱vām̐2 ā vī̱taye̍ vaha
207.d: तं त्वा̍ घृ̱तस्न̍ ईमहे चि̱त्रभा̍नो स्व̱र्विद̍म् । दे̱वाम्̐2 आ वी̱तये̍ वह
207.m: To you as such, dripping with ghee, of wondrous brilliance, finding heaven, we pray: / bring the gods here to the feast!

207.s: a̱gniṃ dū̱taṃ pu̱ro da̍dhe havya̱vāha̱mupa̍ bruve | de̱vām̐2 ā sā̍dayādi̱ha
207.d: अ̱ग्निं दू̱तं पु̱रो द̍धे हव्य̱वाह̱मुप̍ ब्रुवे । दे̱वाम्̐2 आ सा̍दयादि̱ह
207.m: I place Agni in front as messenger; I invoke the bearer of oblations; / let him seat the gods here.

208.s: (4) ajī̍jano̱ hi pa̍vamāna̱ sūrya̍ vi̱dhāre̍ śa̱kmanā̱ paya̍ḥ | gojī̍rayā ram̐ha̍māṇaḥ pu̱raṃdhyā̍
208.d: (4) अजी̍जनो̱ हि प̍वमान̱ सूर्य̍ वि̱धारे̍ श̱क्मना̱ पय̍ः । गोजी̍रया रम्̐ह̍माणः पु̱रंध्या̍
208.m: For you, Pavamāna, have engendered the sun and the milk in the firmament by your power, / speeding along with bountiful vision, quick as cattle.

209.s: vi̱bhūrmātrā̍ pra̱bhūḥ pi̱trāśvo̍'si̱ hayo̍'syatyo̍'si̱ mayo̍'syarvā̍si̱ sapti̍rasi vā̱jya̍si̱ vṛṣā̍si nṛ̱maṇā̍ asi ya̱yurnāmā̍si̱ śiśu̱rnāmā̍syādi̱tyānā̱ṃ patvā̍nvi̱hi
209.d: वि̱भूर्मात्रा̍ प्र̱भूः पि̱त्राश्वो̍ऽसि̱ हयो̍ऽस्यत्यो̍ऽसि̱ मयो̍ऽस्यर्वा̍सि̱ सप्ति̍रसि वा̱ज्य̍सि̱ वृषा̍सि नृ̱मणा̍ असि य̱युर्नामा̍सि̱ शिशु̱र्नामा̍स्यादि̱त्याना̱ं पत्वा̍न्वि̱हि
209.m: You are pervading through your mother, pre-eminent through your father; you are a horse, you are a courser, you are a racer, you are a source of joy, you are a steed, you are a runner, you are a prize-winner, you are a stallion, you are heroic-minded. / You are named Yayur; you are named Śiśu; follow the course of the Ādityas!

209.s: de̱vā̍ āśāpālā e̱taṃ de̱vebhyo'śva̍ṃ me̱dhāya̱ prokṣi̍tam̐ rakṣata i̱ha ranti̍ri̱ha rama̍tāmi̱ha dhṛti̍ri̱ha svadhṛti̱ḥ svāhā̍
209.d: दे̱वा̍ आशापाला ए̱तं दे̱वेभ्योऽश्व̍ं मे̱धाय̱ प्रोक्षि̍तम्̐ रक्षत इ̱ह रन्ति̍रि̱ह रम̍तामि̱ह धृति̍रि̱ह स्वधृति̱ः स्वाहा̍
209.m: O gods, guardians of the quarters, protect this horse sprinkled for sacrifice to the gods! / Here be delight, here let him take delight, here be steadfastness, here be self-steadfastness! Svāhā!

210.s: (6) kā̱ya svāhā̱ kasmai̱ svāhā̍ kata̱masmai̱ svāhā̍ svāhā̍dhimādhī̍tāya̱ svāhā̱ mana̍: pra̱jāpa̍taye̱ svāhā̍ ci̱ttaṃ vijñā̍tāya
210.d: (6) का̱य स्वाहा̱ कस्मै̱ स्वाहा̍ कत̱मस्मै̱ स्वाहा̍ स्वाहा̍धिमाधी̍ताय̱ स्वाहा̱ मन̍: प्र̱जाप̍तये̱ स्वाहा̍ चि̱त्तं विज्ञा̍ताय
210.m: To Ka, svāhā! To Kasmai, svāhā! To Katamasmai, svāhā! / Svāhā to purpose! To what has been pondered, svāhā! Mind to Prajāpati, svāhā! Thought to what has been discerned!

210.s: adi̍tyai̱ svāhādi̍tyai ma̱hyai svāhādi̍tyai sumṛḍī̱kāyai̱ svāhā̍ sara̍svatyai̱ svāhā̱ sara̍svatyai pāva̱kāyai̱ svāhā̱ sara̍svatyai bṛ̱hatyai̱ svāhā̍
210.d: अदि̍त्यै̱ स्वाहादि̍त्यै म̱ह्यै स्वाहादि̍त्यै सुमृडी̱कायै̱ स्वाहा̍ सर̍स्वत्यै̱ स्वाहा̱ सर̍स्वत्यै पाव̱कायै̱ स्वाहा̱ सर̍स्वत्यै बृ̱हत्यै̱ स्वाहा̍
210.m: To Aditi, svāhā! To great Aditi, svāhā! To Aditi, most gracious, svāhā! / To Sarasvatī, svāhā! To Sarasvatī the purifier, svāhā! To Sarasvatī the exalted, svāhā!

210.s: pū̱ṣṇe svāhā̍ pū̱ṣṇe pra̍pa̱thyā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ pū̱ṣṇe na̍randhi̱ṣāya̱ svāhā̍ tvaṣṭre̱ svāhā̱ tvaṣṭre̍ turī̱pā̍ya̱ svāhā̱ tvaṣṭre̍ pururū̱pā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ viṣṇa̍ve̱ svāhā̱ viṣṇa̍ve nibhūya̱pāya̱ svāhā̱ viṣṇa̍ve śipivi̱ṣṭāya̱ svāhā̍
210.d: पू̱ष्णे स्वाहा̍ पू̱ष्णे प्र̍प̱थ्या̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ पू̱ष्णे न̍रन्धि̱षाय̱ स्वाहा̍ त्वष्ट्रे̱ स्वाहा̱ त्वष्ट्रे̍ तुरी̱पा̍य̱ स्वाहा̱ त्वष्ट्रे̍ पुरुरू̱पा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ विष्ण̍वे̱ स्वाहा̱ विष्ण̍वे निभूय̱पाय̱ स्वाहा̱ विष्ण̍वे शिपिवि̱ष्टाय̱ स्वाहा̍
210.m: To Pūṣan, svāhā! To Pūṣan of the distant pathways, svāhā! To Pūṣan who destroys men['s foes], svāhā! / To Tvaṣṭṛ, svāhā! To Tvaṣṭṛ the swift-drinking, svāhā! To Tvaṣṭṛ of manifold forms, svāhā! / To Viṣṇu, svāhā! To Viṣṇu the protector of growth, svāhā! To Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa, svāhā!

210.s: viśvo̍ de̱vasya̍ ne̱turmarto̍ vṛṇīta sa̱khyam viśvo̍ rā̱ya i̍ṣudhyati dyu̱mnaṃ vṛ̍ṇīta puṣya̱se svāhā̍
210.d: विश्वो̍ दे̱वस्य̍ ने̱तुर्मर्तो̍ वृणीत स̱ख्यम् विश्वो̍ रा̱य इ̍षुध्यति द्यु̱म्नं वृ̍णीत पुष्य̱से स्वाहा̍
210.m: Every mortal would choose the friendship of the divine leader; / everyone seeks wealth; one would choose glory for prosperity. Svāhā!

211.s: (7) ā bra̍hman brāhma̱ṇo bra̍hmavarca̱sī jā̍yatā̱mā rā̱ṣṭre rā̍ja̱nya̍ḥ śū̱ra i̍ṣa̱vyo̍'tivyā̱dhī ma̍hāra̱tho jā̍yatām
211.d: (7) आ ब्र̍ह्मन् ब्राह्म̱णो ब्र̍ह्मवर्च̱सी जा̍यता̱मा रा̱ष्ट्रे रा̍ज̱न्य̍ः शू̱र इ̍ष̱व्यो̍ऽतिव्या̱धी म̍हार̱थो जा̍यताम्
211.m: May a Brahmin be born in the sacred formulation, radiant with sacred luster! In the realm may a nobleman be born, / a heroic warrior, a skilled archer, piercing through [the foe], a great charioteer!

211.s: dogdhrī̍ dhe̱nurvoḍhā̍na̱ḍvanā̱śuḥ sapti̱ḥ pura̍ṃdhi̱ryoṣā̍ ji̱ṣṇū ra̍the̱ṣṭhāḥ sa̱bheyo̱ yuvā̍sya yaja̍mānasya vī̱ro jā̍yatām
211.d: दोग्ध्री̍ धे̱नुर्वोढा̍न̱ड्वना̱शुः सप्ति̱ः पुर̍ंधि̱र्योषा̍ जि̱ष्णू र̍थे̱ष्ठाः स̱भेयो̱ युवा̍स्य यज̍मानस्य वी̱रो जा̍यताम्
211.m: May a milch-yielding cow [be born], a draft ox, a swift courser, an abundant woman, / a victorious warrior on a chariot, a youth fit for the assembly! May a hero be born to this sacrificer!

211.s: ni̱kā̱meni̍kāme naḥ pa̱rjanyo̍ varṣatu pha̱lava̍tyo na̱ oṣa̍dhayaḥ pacyantām yo̱ga̱kṣe̱mo na̍ḥ kalpatām
211.d: नि̱का̱मेनि̍कामे नः प̱र्जन्यो̍ वर्षतु फ̱लव̍त्यो न̱ ओष̍धयः पच्यन्ताम् यो̱ग̱क्षे̱मो न̍ः कल्पताम्
211.m: May Parjanya rain for us according to our wish! May our plants ripen with fruit! / May our acquisition and preservation prosper!

212.s:
(8) prā̱ṇāya̱ svāhā̍pā̱nāya̱ svāhā̍ vyā̱nāya̱ svāhā̍ cakṣu̍ṣe̱ svāhā̱ śrotrā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ vā̱ce svāhā̱ mana̍se̱ svāhā̍
(9) prācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̱ dakṣi̍ṇāyai di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̍ pratī̍cyai di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhodī̍cyai di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̍ ū̱rdhvāyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̍
(10)34 a̱dbhyaḥ svāhā̍ vā̱rmyaḥ svāho̍da̱kāya̱ svāhā̱ tiṣṭha̍ntībhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ srava̍ntībhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ syanda̍mānābhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ kūpyā̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ sūdyā̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ dhāryā̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̍rṇa̱vāya̱ svāhā̍ samu̱drāya̱ svāhā̍ sa̱rirā̍ya̱ svāhā̍
212.d:
(8) प्रा̱णाय̱ स्वाहा̍पा̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̍ व्या̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̍ चक्षु̍षे̱ स्वाहा̱ श्रोत्रा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ वा̱चे स्वाहा̱ मन̍से̱ स्वाहा̍
(9) प्राच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̱ दक्षि̍णायै दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̍ प्रती̍च्यै दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहोदी̍च्यै दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̍ ऊ̱र्ध्वायै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̍
(10)34 अ̱द्भ्यः स्वाहा̍ वा̱र्म्यः स्वाहो̍द̱काय̱ स्वाहा̱ तिष्ठ̍न्तीभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ स्रव̍न्तीभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ स्यन्द̍मानाभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ कूप्या̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ सूद्या̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ धार्या̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍र्ण̱वाय̱ स्वाहा̍ समु̱द्राय̱ स्वाहा̍ स̱रिरा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍
212.m:
To in-breath, svāhā! To out-breath, svāhā! To diffused breath, svāhā! / To sight, svāhā! To hearing, svāhā! To speech, svāhā! To mind, svāhā!

To the eastern direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā! To the southern direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā! / To the western direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā! To the northern direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā! / To the upward direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā!

To the waters, svāhā! To the streams, svāhā! To the water, svāhā! To standing [waters], svāhā! To flowing [waters], svāhā! To surging [waters], svāhā! / To [waters] of wells, svāhā! To [waters] of pools, svāhā! To torrential [waters], svāhā! To the surge of the flood, svāhā! To the ocean, svāhā! To the restless sea, svāhā!

212.s:
(11) vātā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ dhū̱māya̱ svāhā̱bhrāya̱ svāhā̍ me̱ghāya̱ svāhā̍ vi̱dyota̍mānāya̱ svāhā̍ sta̱naya̍te̱ svāhā̍ avasphūrja̍te̱ svāhā̱ varṣa̍te̱ svāhā̍va̱varṣa̍te̱ svāho̱graṃ varṣa̍te̱ svāhā̍ śī̱ghraṃ varṣa̍te̱ svāho̍dgṛhva̱te svāho̍dgṛhītāya̱ svāhā̍ pra̱śnate̱ svāhā̍ śīkā̱yate̱ svāhā̱ pṛṣvā̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ hrādunī̍bhya̱ḥ svāho̍ nīhā̱rāya̱ svāhā̍
(12) a̱gnaye̱ svāhā̱ somā̍ya̱ svāhendrā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ pṛthi̱vyai svāhā̱ntari̍kṣāya̱ svāhā̍ di̱ve svāhā̍ di̱gbhyaḥ svāhāśā̍bhyaḥ svāho̱rdhvai di̱śe svāhā̱rvācyai̍ di̱śe svāhā̍
(13) nakṣa̍trebhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ nakṣa̍triyebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍horā̱trebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍rdhamā̱sebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ māse̍bhya̱ḥ svāha̍ ṛ̱tubhya̱ḥ svāhā̍rta̱vebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ saṃvatsa̱rāya̱ svāhā̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vībhyā̱m̐ svāhā̍
212.d:
(11) वाता̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ धू̱माय̱ स्वाहा̱भ्राय̱ स्वाहा̍ मे̱घाय̱ स्वाहा̍ वि̱द्योत̍मानाय̱ स्वाहा̍ स्त̱नय̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍ अवस्फूर्ज̍ते̱ स्वाहा̱ वर्ष̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍व̱वर्ष̍ते̱ स्वाहो̱ग्रं वर्ष̍ते̱ स्वाहा̍ शी̱घ्रं वर्ष̍ते̱ स्वाहो̍द्गृह्व̱ते स्वाहो̍द्गृहीताय̱ स्वाहा̍ प्र̱श्नते̱ स्वाहा̍ शीका̱यते̱ स्वाहा̱ पृष्वा̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ ह्रादुनी̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहो̍ नीहा̱राय̱ स्वाहा̍
(12) अ̱ग्नये̱ स्वाहा̱ सोमा̍य̱ स्वाहेन्द्रा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ पृथि̱व्यै स्वाहा̱न्तरि̍क्षाय̱ स्वाहा̍ दि̱वे स्वाहा̍ दि̱ग्भ्यः स्वाहाशा̍भ्यः स्वाहो̱र्ध्वै दि̱शे स्वाहा̱र्वाच्यै̍ दि̱शे स्वाहा̍
(13) नक्ष̍त्रेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ नक्ष̍त्रियेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍होरा̱त्रेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍र्धमा̱सेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ मासे̍भ्य̱ः स्वाह̍ ऋ̱तुभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍र्त̱वेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ संवत्स̱राय̱ स्वाहा̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वीभ्या̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍
212.m:
To the wind, svāhā! To the smoke, svāhā! To the cloud, svāhā! To the rain-cloud, svāhā! To the lightning, svāhā! To the thundering one, svāhā! / To the crash of thunder, svāhā! To raining, svāhā! To pouring rain, svāhā! To violent raining, svāhā! To swift raining, svāhā! To holding up [rain], svāhā! To what has held up [rain], svāhā! / To gentle drizzling, svāhā! To misting rain, svāhā! To frost, svāhā! To hailstorms, svāhā! To snow and fog, svāhā!

To Agni, svāhā! To Soma, svāhā! To Indra, svāhā! To earth, svāhā! To mid-air, svāhā! / To heaven, svāhā! To the quarters, svāhā! To the intermediate regions, svāhā! To the broad direction, svāhā! To the intermediate direction, svāhā!

To the constellations, svāhā! To those belonging to the constellations, svāhā! To days and nights, svāhā! To the half-months, svāhā! / To the months, svāhā! To the seasons, svāhā! To those belonging to the seasons, svāhā! To the year, svāhā! To heaven and earth, svāhā!

212.s: ca̱ndrāya̱ svāhā̱ sūryā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ ra̱śmibhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ vasu̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ ru̱drebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍di̱tyebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ ma̱rudbhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ viśve̍bhyo de̱vebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍
212.d: च̱न्द्राय̱ स्वाहा̱ सूर्या̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ र̱श्मिभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ वसु̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ रु̱द्रेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍दि̱त्येभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ म̱रुद्भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ विश्वे̍भ्यो दे̱वेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍
212.m: To the moon, svāhā! To the sun, svāhā! To the rays, svāhā! To the Vasus, svāhā! / To the Rudras, svāhā! To the Ādityas, svāhā! To the Maruts, svāhā! To the All-Gods, svāhā!

213.s:
(14)39 mūle̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ śākhā̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ vana̱spati̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ puṣpe̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̱ phale̍bhya̱ḥ svāhauṣa̍dhībhya̱ḥ svāhā̍
(15) pṛthi̱vyai svāhā̱ntari̍kṣāya̱ svāhā̍ di̱ve svāhā̱ sūryā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ ca̱ndrāya̱ svāhā̱ nakṣa̍trebhya̱ḥ svāhā̱dbhyaḥ svāhauṣa̍dhībhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ vana̱spati̍bhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ paripla̱vebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ carāca̱rebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ sarīsṛ̱pebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍
(16)41 asa̍ve̱ svāhā̱ vasa̍ve̱ svāhā̍ vi̱bhuve̱ svāhā̍ viva̍svate̱ svāhā̍ ga̱ṇa̱śriye̱ svāhā̍ ga̱ṇapa̍taye̱ svāhā̍bhi̱bhuve̱ svāhādhi̍pataye̱ svāhā̍
213.d:
(14)39 मूले̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ शाखा̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ वन̱स्पति̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ पुष्पे̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱ फले̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहौष̍धीभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍
(15) पृथि̱व्यै स्वाहा̱न्तरि̍क्षाय̱ स्वाहा̍ दि̱वे स्वाहा̱ सूर्या̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ च̱न्द्राय̱ स्वाहा̱ नक्ष̍त्रेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̱द्भ्यः स्वाहौष̍धीभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ वन̱स्पति̍भ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ परिप्ल̱वेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ चराच̱रेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ सरीसृ̱पेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍
(16)41 अस̍वे̱ स्वाहा̱ वस̍वे̱ स्वाहा̍ वि̱भुवे̱ स्वाहा̍ विव̍स्वते̱ स्वाहा̍ ग̱ण̱श्रिये̱ स्वाहा̍ ग̱णप̍तये̱ स्वाहा̍भि̱भुवे̱ स्वाहाधि̍पतये̱ स्वाहा̍
213.m:
To the roots, svāhā! To the branches, svāhā! To the trees, svāhā! / To the flowers, svāhā! To the fruits, svāhā! To the plants, svāhā!

To earth, svāhā! To mid-air, svāhā! To heaven, svāhā! To the sun, svāhā! / To the moon, svāhā! To the constellations, svāhā! To the waters, svāhā! To the plants, svāhā! / To the trees, svāhā! To floating creatures, svāhā! To moving and unmoving creatures, svāhā! To creeping things, svāhā!

To breath, svāhā! To the dwelling one, svāhā! To the all-pervading, svāhā! To Vivasvat, svāhā! / To the glory of the host, svāhā! To the lord of the host, svāhā! To the overpowering one, svāhā! To the sovereign lord, svāhā!

213.s: śū̱ṣāya̱ svāhā̍ sam̐sa̱rpāya̱ svāhā̍ ca̱ndrāya̱ svāhā̱ jyoti̍ṣe̱ svāhā̍ ma̱li̱mlucāya̱ svāhā̱ divā̍ pata̱yate̱ svāhā̍
213.d: शू̱षाय̱ स्वाहा̍ सम्̐स̱र्पाय̱ स्वाहा̍ च̱न्द्राय̱ स्वाहा̱ ज्योति̍षे̱ स्वाहा̍ म̱लि̱म्लुचाय̱ स्वाहा̱ दिवा̍ पत̱यते̱ स्वाहा̍
213.m: To Śūṣa, svāhā! To Saṃsarpa, svāhā! To the moon, svāhā! To light, svāhā! / To Malimluca, svāhā! To the one flying by day, svāhā!

214.s: (17) madha̍ve̱ svāhā̱ mādha̍vāya̱ svāhā̍ śu̱krāya̱ svāhā̱ śuca̍ye̱ svāhā̍ nabha̍se̱ svāhā̍ nabha̱syā̍ya̱ svāheṣā̍ya̱ svāhorjā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ saha̍se̱ svāhā̍ saha̱syā̍ya̱ svāhā̱ tapa̍se̱ svāhā̍ tapa̱syā̍ya̱ svāhā̍m̐hasaspa̱taye̱ svāhā̍
214.d: (17) मध̍वे̱ स्वाहा̱ माध̍वाय̱ स्वाहा̍ शु̱क्राय̱ स्वाहा̱ शुच̍ये̱ स्वाहा̍ नभ̍से̱ स्वाहा̍ नभ̱स्या̍य̱ स्वाहेषा̍य̱ स्वाहोर्जा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ सह̍से̱ स्वाहा̍ सह̱स्या̍य̱ स्वाहा̱ तप̍से̱ स्वाहा̍ तप̱स्या̍य̱ स्वाहा̍म्̐हसस्प̱तये̱ स्वाहा̍
214.m: To Madhu, svāhā! To Mādhava, svāhā! To Śukra, svāhā! To Śuci, svāhā! / To Nabhas, svāhā! To Nabhasya, svāhā! To Iṣa, svāhā! To Ūrja, svāhā! / To Sahas, svāhā! To Sahasya, svāhā! To Tapas, svāhā! To Tapasya, svāhā! To Aṃhasaspati, svāhā!

215.s: vājā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ prasu̱vāya̱ svāhā̍pi̱jāya̱ svāhā̱ krata̍ve̱ svāhā̍ sva̱ḥ svāhā̍ mū̱rdhre svāhā̍ vyaśnuvi̱ne svāhā̍ antyā̍ya̱ svāhāntyā̍yanāya̱ svāhā̍ bhauva̱nāya̱ svāhā̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ pata̍ye̱ svāhādhi̍pataye̱ svāhā̍ pra̱jāpa̍taye̱ svāhā̍
215.d: वाजा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ प्रसु̱वाय̱ स्वाहा̍पि̱जाय̱ स्वाहा̱ क्रत̍वे̱ स्वाहा̍ स्व̱ः स्वाहा̍ मू̱र्ध्रे स्वाहा̍ व्यश्नुवि̱ने स्वाहा̍ अन्त्या̍य̱ स्वाहान्त्या̍यनाय̱ स्वाहा̍ भौव̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̱ भुव̍नस्य̱ पत̍ये̱ स्वाहाधि̍पतये̱ स्वाहा̍ प्र̱जाप̍तये̱ स्वाहा̍
215.m: To vital vigor, svāhā! To incitement, svāhā! To rebirth, svāhā! To purpose, svāhā! / To heaven, svāhā! To the summit, svāhā! To the all-pervading, svāhā! / To the last, svāhā! To the son of the last, svāhā! To the child of the world, svāhā! To the lord of the world, svāhā! To the sovereign lord, svāhā! To Prajāpati, svāhā!

216.s: āyu̍rya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ prā̱ṇo ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍pā̱no ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ vyā̱no ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ u̱dā̱no ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ sa̱mā̱no ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̱ cakṣu̍rya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̱ śrotra̍ṃ ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ vāgya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̱ mano̍ ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̱tmā ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ pṛ̱ṣṭhaṃ ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ brahma̍ ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍ ya̱jño ya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̱ jyoti̍rya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̱ sva̍rya̱jñena̍ kalpatā̱m̐ svāhā̍
216.d: आयु̍र्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ प्रा̱णो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍पा̱नो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ व्या̱नो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ उ̱दा̱नो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ स̱मा̱नो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ चक्षु̍र्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ श्रोत्र̍ं य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ वाग्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ मनो̍ य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱त्मा य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ पृ̱ष्ठं य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ ब्रह्म̍ य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ य̱ज्ञो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ ज्योति̍र्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̱ स्व̍र्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍
216.m:
May lifespan be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May in-breath be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May out-breath be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May diffused breath be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā!
May up-breath be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May mid-breath be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May sight be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May hearing be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā!
May speech be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May mind be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May the self be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May the back be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā!
May sacred formulation be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May the sacrifice be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May light be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā! May heaven be made fit through sacrifice, svāhā!

217.s: eka̍smai̱ svāhā̱ dvābhyā̱m̐ svāhā̍ śa̱tāya̱ svāhai̍ka̍śatāya̱ svāhā̍ vyu̍ṣṭyai̱ svāhā̍ sva̱rgāya̱ svāhā̍
217.d: एक̍स्मै̱ स्वाहा̱ द्वाभ्या̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍ श̱ताय̱ स्वाहै̍क̍शताय̱ स्वाहा̍ व्यु̍ष्ट्यै̱ स्वाहा̍ स्व̱र्गाय̱ स्वाहा̍
217.m:
To one, svāhā! To two, svāhā! To a hundred, svāhā! To one hundred and one, svāhā!
To daybreak, svāhā! To heaven, svāhā!

220.s:
prāṇāyaikā
prācyāyaikā
adbhya ekā
vātāyaikā
agnaya ityekā
220.d:
प्राणायैका
प्राच्यायैका
अद्भ्य एका
वातायैका
अग्नय इत्येका

222.s:
maghava ekā
vājāyaikā
āyuryajñenaikā
ekasmā ityekā
222.d:
मघव एका
वाजायैका
आयुर्यज्ञेनैका
एकस्मा इत्येका

223.s: hira̍ṇyaga̱rbhaḥ sama̍varta̱tāgre̍ bhū̱tasya̍ jā̱taḥ pati̱reka̍ āsīt sa dā̍dhāra pṛthi̱vīṃ dyāmu̱temāṃ kasmai̍ de̱vāya̍ ha̱viṣā̍ vidhema
223.d: हिर̍ण्यग̱र्भः सम̍वर्त̱ताग्रे̍ भू̱तस्य̍ जा̱तः पति̱रेक̍ आसीत् स दा̍धार पृथि̱वीं द्यामु̱तेमां कस्मै̍ दे̱वाय̍ ह̱विषा̍ विधेम
223.m:
The Golden Germ arose in the beginning; born, he was the sole lord of what has come to be.
He held fast this earth and heaven. To what god should we offer worship with oblation?

223.s:
u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si pra̱jāpa̍taye tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱ḥ sūrya̍ste mahi̱mā yaste'ha̍ntsaṃvatsa̱re ma̍hi̱mā saṃba̱bhūva̱ yaste̱ vāyā a̱ntari̍kṣe mahi̱mā saṃba̱bhūva̍ yaste̍ di̱vi sūryai̍ mahi̱mā saṃba̱bhūva̱ tasmai̍ te mahi̱mne pra̱jāpa̍taye̱ svāhā̍ de̱vebhya̍ḥ
(1)
223.d:
उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि प्र̱जाप̍तये त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̱ः सूर्य̍स्ते महि̱मा यस्तेऽह̍न्त्संवत्स̱रे म̍हि̱मा संब̱भूव̱ यस्ते̱ वाया अ̱न्तरि̍क्षे महि̱मा संब̱भूव̍ यस्ते̍ दि̱वि सूर्यै̍ महि̱मा संब̱भूव̱ तस्मै̍ ते महि̱म्ने प्र̱जाप̍तये̱ स्वाहा̍ दे̱वेभ्य̍ः
(1)

224.s: yaḥ prā̍ṇa̱to ni̍miṣa̱to ma̍hi̱tvaika̱ idrājā̱ jaga̍to ba̱bhūva̍ ya īśe̍ a̱sya dvi̱pada̱ścatu̍ṣpada̱ḥ kasmai̍ de̱vāya̍ ha̱viṣā̍ vidhema
224.d: यः प्रा̍ण̱तो नि̍मिष̱तो म̍हि̱त्वैक̱ इद्राजा̱ जग̍तो ब̱भूव̍ य ईशे̍ अ̱स्य द्वि̱पद̱श्चतु̍ष्पद̱ः कस्मै̍ दे̱वाय̍ ह̱विषा̍ विधेम
224.m:
He who through his greatness became the sole king of all the moving, blinking world;
who rules over this two-footed and four-footed [creation]—to what god should we offer worship with oblation?

224.s: u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si pra̱jāpa̍taye tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍śca̱ndrama̍ste mahi̱mā yaste̱ rātrau̍ saṃvatsa̱re ma̍hi̱mā sa̍ṃba̱bhūva̱ yaste̍ pṛthi̱vyāma̱gnau ma̍hi̱mā sa̍ṃba̱bhūva̍ yaste̱ nakṣa̍treṣu ca̱ndrama̍si mahi̱mā sa̍ṃba̱bhūva̱ tasmai̍ te mahi̱mne pra̱jāpa̍taye de̱vebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍
224.d: उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि प्र̱जाप̍तये त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̍श्च̱न्द्रम̍स्ते महि̱मा यस्ते̱ रात्रौ̍ संवत्स̱रे म̍हि̱मा स̍ंब̱भूव̱ यस्ते̍ पृथि̱व्याम̱ग्नौ म̍हि̱मा स̍ंब̱भूव̍ यस्ते̱ नक्ष̍त्रेषु च̱न्द्रम̍सि महि̱मा स̍ंब̱भूव̱ तस्मै̍ ते महि̱म्ने प्र̱जाप̍तये दे̱वेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍

225.s: yu̱ñjanti̍ bra̱dhnamaru̍ṣa̱ṃ cara̍nta̱ṃ pari̍ ta̱sthuṣa̍ḥ | roca̍nte roca̱nā di̱vi
225.d: यु̱ञ्जन्ति̍ ब्र̱ध्नमरु̍ष̱ं चर̍न्त̱ं परि̍ त̱स्थुष̍ः । रोच̍न्ते रोच̱ना दि̱वि
225.m: They harness the tawny, ruddy steed as he ranges around those that stand still; the bright lights shine in heaven.

225.s: yu̱ñjantya̍sya̱ kāmyā̱ harī̱ vipa̍kṣasā̱ rathe̍ | śoṇā̍ dhṛ̱ṣṇū nṛ̱vāha̍sā
225.d: यु̱ञ्जन्त्य̍स्य̱ काम्या̱ हरी̱ विप̍क्षसा̱ रथे̍ । शोणा̍ धृ̱ष्णू नृ̱वाह̍सा
225.m: They harness his two lovely bay horses on both sides of the chariot, ruddy, bold, carrying heroes.

225.s: yadvāto̍ a̱po aga̍nīganni̱ndra̍sya ta̱nva̍m e̱taḥ sto̱tṝnena̍ pa̱thā puna̱raśva̱māva̍rtayāsi naḥ
225.d: यद्वातो̍ अ̱पो अग̍नीगन्नि̱न्द्र̍स्य त̱न्व̍म् ए̱तः स्तो̱तॄनेन̍ प̱था पुन̱रश्व̱माव̍र्तयासि नः
225.m:
When the wind has made waters reach Indra’s beloved body,
by this path, O singer, turn the horse back again to us.

225.s: vasa̍vastvāñjantu gāya̱treṇa̱ chanda̍sā ru̱drāstvā̍ñjantu̱ traiṣṭu̍bhena̱ chanda̍sā ādi̱tyāstvā̍ñjantu jāga̍tena̱ chanda̍sā
225.d: वस̍वस्त्वाञ्जन्तु गाय̱त्रेण̱ छन्द̍सा रु̱द्रास्त्वा̍ञ्जन्तु̱ त्रैष्टु̍भेन̱ छन्द̍सा आदि̱त्यास्त्वा̍ञ्जन्तु जाग̍तेन̱ छन्द̍सा
225.m:
May the Vasus anoint you with the gāyatrī metre; may the Rudras anoint you with the triṣṭubh metre;
may the Ādityas anoint you with the jagatī metre.

225.s: bhūrbhuva̱ḥ svarlājī̍3ñchācī3nyavye̱ gavye̍ e̱tadanna̍matta devā e̱tadanna̍maddhi prajāpate
225.d: भूर्भुव̱ः स्वर्लाजी̍3ञ्छाची3न्यव्ये̱ गव्ये̍ ए̱तदन्न̍मत्त देवा ए̱तदन्न̍मद्धि प्रजापते
225.m:
Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svar! Parched grains, cooked foods, belonging to barley, belonging to cattle!
Eat this food, O gods; eat this food, O Prajāpati!

225.s: kaḥ svi̍dekā̱kī ca̍rati̱ ka u̍ svijjāyate̱ puna̍ḥ kim̐ svi̍ddhima̱sya̍ bheṣa̱jaṃ kimvāvapa̍naṃ ma̱hat
225.d: कः स्वि̍देका̱की च̍रति̱ क उ̍ स्विज्जायते̱ पुन̍ः किम्̐ स्वि̍द्धिम̱स्य̍ भेष̱जं किम्वावप̍नं म̱हत्
225.m:
Who indeed roams alone? And who indeed is born again?
What indeed is the medicine for cold? And what is the great sowing-place?

225.s: sūrya̍ ekā̱kī ca̍rati ca̱ndramā̍ jāyate̱ puna̍ḥ a̱gnirhi̍ma̱sya̍ bheṣa̱jaṃ bhūmi̍rāvapa̍naṃ ma̱hat
225.d: सूर्य̍ एका̱की च̍रति च̱न्द्रमा̍ जायते̱ पुन̍ः अ̱ग्निर्हि̍म̱स्य̍ भेष̱जं भूमि̍रावप̍नं म̱हत्
225.m:
The sun roams alone; the moon is born again.
Agni is the medicine for cold; the earth is the great sowing-place.

225.s: kā svi̍dāsītpūrvaci̍tti̱ḥ kim̐ svi̍dāsīd bṛhadvaya̍ḥ kā svi̍dāsītpilippi̱lā kā svi̍dāsītpiśaṅgi̱lā
225.d: का स्वि̍दासीत्पूर्वचि̍त्ति̱ः किम्̐ स्वि̍दासीद् बृहद्वय̍ः का स्वि̍दासीत्पिलिप्पि̱ला का स्वि̍दासीत्पिशङ्गि̱ला
225.m:
What indeed was the first conception? What indeed was the great bird?
Who indeed was the slippery one? Who indeed was the speckled one?

Heaven was the first conception; the horse was the great bird;
the ewe was the slippery one; the night was the speckled one.

226.m:
May Vāyu protect you with cooked offerings, black-necked [Agni] with goats,
the banyan tree with cups, the silk-cotton tree with growth.

226.s: e̱ṣa sya rā̱thyo vṛṣā̍ pa̱ḍbhiḥ śru̱tarbhi̱reda̍gan | bra̱hmā kṛ̱ṣṇaśca̍ no'vatu̱ namo̍'gnaye̍
226.d: ए̱ष स्य रा̱थ्यो वृषा̍ प̱ड्भिः श्रु̱तर्भि̱रेद̍गन् । ब्र̱ह्मा कृ̱ष्णश्च̍ नोऽवतु̱ नमो̍ऽग्नये̍
226.m:
This chariot-drawing stallion has come here on four feet.
May the priest and the dark one protect us. Homage to Agni!

226.s: sam̐śi̍to ra̱śminā̱ ratha̱ḥ sam̐śi̍to ra̱śminā̱ haya̍ḥ sam̐śi̍to a̱psva̍psu̱jā bra̱hmā soma̍purogavaḥ
226.d: सम्̐शि̍तो र̱श्मिना̱ रथ̱ः सम्̐शि̍तो र̱श्मिना̱ हय̍ः सम्̐शि̍तो अ̱प्स्व̍प्सु̱जा ब्र̱ह्मा सोम̍पुरोगवः
226.m:
Whetted by the rein is the chariot; whetted by the rein is the courser;
whetted in the waters is the water-born priest, with Soma at the head.

226.s: sva̱yaṃ vā̍jim̐sta̱nva̍ṃ kalpayasva sva̱yaṃ ya̍jasva sva̱yaṃ ju̍ṣasva mahi̱mā te̍'nyen na saṃna̍śe
226.d: स्व̱यं वा̍जिम्̐स्त̱न्व̍ं कल्पयस्व स्व̱यं य̍जस्व स्व̱यं जु̍षस्व महि̱मा ते̍ऽन्येन् न संन̍शे
226.m:
Fashion your own body yourself, O courser; sacrifice yourself; enjoy yourself!
Your greatness cannot be attained by any other.

226.s: na vā u̍ e̱tanmriyase̱ na ri̍ṣyasi de̱vām̐2 ide̍ṣi pa̱thibhi̍ḥ su̱gebhi̍ḥ yatrāsa̍te su̱kṛto̱ yatra̱ te ya̱yustatra̍ tvā de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā da̍dhātu
226.d: न वा उ̍ ए̱तन्म्रियसे̱ न रि̍ष्यसि दे̱वाम्̐2 इदे̍षि प̱थिभि̍ः सु̱गेभि̍ः यत्रास̍ते सु̱कृतो̱ यत्र̱ ते य̱युस्तत्र̍ त्वा दे̱वः स̍वि̱ता द̍धातु
226.m:
Indeed you do not die here, you suffer no injury; you go to the gods by easy paths.
Where the well-doers sit, where they have gone, there may god Savitṛ place you.

226.s: a̱gniḥ pa̱śurā̍sī̱ttenā̍yajanta̱ sa e̱taṃ lo̱kama̍jaya̱dyasmi̍nna̱gniḥ sa te̍ lo̱ko bha̍viṣya̱ti taṃ jeṣyasi̱ pibai̱tā a̱paḥ vā̱yuḥ pa̱śurā̍sī̱ttenā̍yajanta̱ sa e̱taṃ lo̱kama̍jaya̱dyasmi̍nvā̱yuḥ sa te̍ lo̱ko bha̍viṣya̱ti taṃ jeṣyasi̱ pibai̱tā a̱paḥ sū̱ryaḥ pa̱śurā̍sī̱ttenā̍yajanta̱ sa e̱taṃ lo̱kama̍jaya̱dyasmi̱nsūrya̍ḥ sa te̍ lo̱ko bha̍viṣya̱ti taṃ jeṣyasi̱ pibai̱tā a̱paḥ
226.d: अ̱ग्निः प̱शुरा̍सी̱त्तेना̍यजन्त̱ स ए̱तं लो̱कम̍जय̱द्यस्मि̍न्न̱ग्निः स ते̍ लो̱को भ̍विष्य̱ति तं जेष्यसि̱ पिबै̱ता अ̱पः वा̱युः प̱शुरा̍सी̱त्तेना̍यजन्त̱ स ए̱तं लो̱कम̍जय̱द्यस्मि̍न्वा̱युः स ते̍ लो̱को भ̍विष्य̱ति तं जेष्यसि̱ पिबै̱ता अ̱पः सू̱र्यः प̱शुरा̍सी̱त्तेना̍यजन्त̱ स ए̱तं लो̱कम̍जय̱द्यस्मि̱न्सूर्य̍ः स ते̍ लो̱को भ̍विष्य̱ति तं जेष्यसि̱ पिबै̱ता अ̱पः

227.s: (4) prā̱ṇāya̱ svāhā̍pā̱nāya̱ svāhā̍ vyā̱nāya̱ svāhā̍ | ambe̱ ambike'mbālike̱ na mā̍ nayati̱ kaśca̱na sasa̍styaśva̱kaḥ subha̍drikāṃ kāmpīlavā̱sinī̍m
227.d: (4) प्रा̱णाय̱ स्वाहा̍पा̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̍ व्या̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̍ । अम्बे̱ अम्बिकेऽम्बालिके̱ न मा̍ नयति̱ कश्च̱न सस̍स्त्यश्व̱कः सुभ̍द्रिकां काम्पीलवा̱सिनी̍म्
227.m:
To in-breath, svāhā! To out-breath, svāhā! To diffused breath, svāhā!
O mother, little mother, dear little mother, no one leads me!
The little horse sleeps with the auspicious woman dwelling in Kāmpīla.

227.s: ga̱ṇānā̍ṃ tvā ga̱ṇapa̍tim̐ havāmahe pri̱yāṇā̍ṃ tvā pri̱yapa̍tim̐ havāmahe nidhī̱nāṃ tvā̍ ni̱dhipa̍tim̐ havāmahe vaso mama
227.d: ग̱णाना̍ं त्वा ग̱णप̍तिम्̐ हवामहे प्रि̱याणा̍ं त्वा प्रि̱यप̍तिम्̐ हवामहे निधी̱नां त्वा̍ नि̱धिप̍तिम्̐ हवामहे वसो मम
227.m:
We call upon you, the troop-leader of troops; we call upon you, the dear lord of dear ones;
we call upon you, the treasure-lord of treasures, O my precious one!

227.s: āhama̍jāni garbha̱dhamā tvama̍jāsi garbha̱dham | tā u̱bhau ca̱tura̍ḥ pa̱daḥ saṃprasā̍rayāva sva̱rge lo̱ke prorṇvā̍thā̱ṃ vṛṣā̍ vā̱jī re̍to̱dhā reto̍ dadhātu
227.d: आहम̍जानि गर्भ̱धमा त्वम̍जासि गर्भ̱धम् । ता उ̱भौ च̱तुर̍ः प̱दः संप्रसा̍रयाव स्व̱र्गे लो̱के प्रोर्ण्वा̍था̱ं वृषा̍ वा̱जी रे̍तो̱धा रेतो̍ दधातु
227.m:
I urge on the placer of the seed; you urge on the placer of the seed. Let the two of us stretch out all four feet.
Cover yourselves in the heavenly world; may the vigorous, seed-bearing stallion deposit seed!

228.s: (5) utsa̍kthyā ava̍ gu̱daṃ dhe̍hi̱ sama̱ñjiṃ cā̍rayā vṛṣan | ya strī̱ṇāṃ jī̍va̱bhoja̍naḥ
228.d: (5) उत्स̍क्थ्या अव̍ गु̱दं धे̍हि̱ सम̱ञ्जिं चा̍रया वृषन् । य स्त्री̱णां जी̍व̱भोज̍नः
228.m:
Lift up the thighs, set down the passage; introduce the member, O stallion,
that which is the enjoyment of living women.

228.s: ya̱kāsa̱kau śa̍ku̱ntikāhalagi̱ti vañca̍ti | āha̍nti ga̱bhe paso̍ nigalgalīti̱ dhāra̍kā
228.d: य̱कास̱कौ श̍कु̱न्तिकाहलगि̱ति वञ्च̍ति । आह̍न्ति ग̱भे पसो̍ निगल्गलीति̱ धार̍का
228.m: That little bird yonder hops about, saying 'ahalag!' / The pestle drives into the cleft, the receptacle throbs.

228.s: ya̱kau'sa̱kau śa̍kunta̱ka āha̍lagi̱ti vañca̍ti viva̍kṣata iva te̱ mukha̍madhva̱ryo mā na̱stvama̱bhi bhā̍ṣathāḥ
228.d: य̱कौऽस̱कौ श̍कुन्त̱क आह̍लगि̱ति वञ्च̍ति विव̍क्षत इव ते̱ मुख̍मध्व̱र्यो मा न̱स्त्वम̱भि भा̍षथाः
228.m: That little bird yonder hops about, saying 'āhalag!' / Your mouth seems eager to speak, Adhvaryu; do not speak against us.

228.s: mā̱tā ca̍ te pi̱tā ca̱ te'gra̍ṃ vṛ̱kṣasya̍ rohataḥ prati̍lāmīti̍ te pi̱tā ga̱bhe mu̱ṣṭima̍tam̐sayat
228.d: मा̱ता च̍ ते पि̱ता च̱ तेऽग्र̍ं वृ̱क्षस्य̍ रोहतः प्रति̍लामीति̍ ते पि̱ता ग̱भे मु̱ष्टिम̍तम्̐सयत्
228.m: Your mother and your father climb to the top of the tree. / 'I am stroking,' your father said, as he thrust his fist into the cleft.

228.s: mā̱tā ca̍ te pi̱tā ca̱ te'gre̍ vṛ̱kṣasya̍ krīḷataḥ viva̍kṣata iva te̱ mukha̍ṃ brahma̱nmā tvaṃ va̍do ba̱hu
228.d: मा̱ता च̍ ते पि̱ता च̱ तेऽग्रे̍ वृ̱क्षस्य̍ क्रीऌअतः विव̍क्षत इव ते̱ मुख̍ं ब्रह्म̱न्मा त्वं व̍दो ब̱हु
228.m: Your mother and your father sport at the top of the tree. / Your mouth seems eager to speak, Brahman; do not talk too much.

228.s: ū̱rdhvāme̍nā̱mucchrā̍paya gi̱rau bhā̱ram̐ hara̍nniva athā̍syai̱ madhya̍medhatām̐ śī̱te vāte̍ pu̱nanni̍va
228.d: ऊ̱र्ध्वामे̍ना̱मुच्छ्रा̍पय गि̱रौ भा̱रम्̐ हर̍न्निव अथा̍स्यै̱ मध्य̍मेधताम्̐ शी̱ते वाते̍ पु̱नन्नि̍व
228.m: Raise her up high, as one carrying a load on a mountain; / then let her middle thrive, as one winnowing in a cool wind.

228.s: ū̱rdhvame̍na̱mucchrā̍yatādgi̱rau bhā̱ram̐ hara̍nniva athā̍sya̱ madhya̍mejatu śī̱te vāte̍ pu̱nanni̍va
228.d: ऊ̱र्ध्वमे̍न̱मुच्छ्रा̍यताद्गि̱रौ भा̱रम्̐ हर̍न्निव अथा̍स्य̱ मध्य̍मेजतु शी̱ते वाते̍ पु̱नन्नि̍व
228.m: Raise him up high, as one carrying a load on a mountain; / then let his middle stir, as one winnowing in a cool wind.

228.s: yada̍syā am̐hubhedyā̍ḥ kṛ̱dhu sthū̱lamupā̍tasat mu̱ṣkā ida̍syā ejato gośa̱phe śa̍ku̱lā i̍va
228.d: यद̍स्या अम्̐हुभेद्या̍ः कृ̱धु स्थू̱लमुपा̍तसत् मु̱ष्का इद̍स्या एजतो गोश̱फे श̍कु̱ला इ̍व
228.m: When the short, thick [member] rushed into her narrow cleft, / her testicles twitched like fish in a cow's hoofprint.

228.s: yadde̱vāso̍ lalāma̱guṃ pra vi̍ṣṭī̱mina̱māvi̍ṣuḥ sa̱kthnā de̍diśyate̱ nārī̍ sa̱tyasyā̍kṣibhu̱vau yathā̍
228.d: यद्दे̱वासो̍ ललाम̱गुं प्र वि̍ष्टी̱मिन̱मावि̍षुः स̱क्थ्ना दे̍दिश्यते̱ नारी̍ स̱त्यस्या̍क्षिभु̱वौ यथा̍
228.m: When the gods penetrated the spotted, penetrating [stallion], / the woman is pointed out by her thigh, like an eyewitness to the truth.

228.s: yaddha̍ri̱ṇo yava̱matti̱ na pu̱ṣṭaṃ pa̱śu manya̍te śū̱drā yada̍ryajā̱rā na poṣā̍ya dhanāyati
228.d: यद्ध̍रि̱णो यव̱मत्ति̱ न पु̱ष्टं प̱शु मन्य̍ते शू̱द्रा यद̍र्यजा̱रा न पोषा̍य धनायति
228.m: When the deer eats the barley, one does not think of the fattened beast; / when the Śūdrā woman has an Arya lover, she does not strive for prosperity.

228.s: yaddha̍ri̱ṇo yava̱matti̱ na pu̱ṣṭaṃ ba̱hu manya̍te śū̱dro yada̍ryā̱yai jā̱ro na poṣa̱manu̍ manyate
228.d: यद्ध̍रि̱णो यव̱मत्ति̱ न पु̱ष्टं ब̱हु मन्य̍ते शू̱द्रो यद̍र्या̱यै जा̱रो न पोष̱मनु̍ मन्यते
228.m: When the deer eats the barley, one does not think much of the fattened [beast]; / when the Śūdra is the lover of an Arya woman, he does not heed prosperity.

228.s: da̱dhi̱krāvṇo̍ akāriṣaṃ ji̱ṣṇoraśva̍sya vā̱jina̍ḥ su̱ra̱bhi no̱ mukhā̍ kara̱tpra ṇa̱ āyū̍m̐ṣi tāriṣat
228.d: द̱धि̱क्राव्णो̍ अकारिषं जि̱ष्णोरश्व̍स्य वा̱जिन̍ः सु̱र̱भि नो̱ मुखा̍ कर̱त्प्र ण̱ आयू̍म्̐षि तारिषत्
228.m: I have praised Dadhikrāvan, the victorious, swift steed; / may he make our mouths fragrant; may he prolong our lives.

229.s: (6) gā̱ya̱trī tri̱ṣṭubjaga̍tyanu̱ṣṭup pa̱ṅktyā sa̱ha bṛ̱hatyu̱ṣṇihā̍ ka̱kupsū̱cībhi̍ḥ śamyantu tvā
229.d: (6) गा̱य̱त्री त्रि̱ष्टुब्जग̍त्यनु̱ष्टुप् प̱ङ्क्त्या स̱ह बृ̱हत्यु̱ष्णिहा̍ क̱कुप्सू̱चीभि̍ः शम्यन्तु त्वा
229.m: May Gāyatrī, Triṣṭubh, Jagatī, Anuṣṭubh, along with Paṅkti, / Bṛhatī, Uṣṇih, and Kakubh appease you with needles.

229.s: dvi̱pa̱dā yāścatu̍ṣpadāstri̱padā̱ yāśca̱ ṣaṭpa̍dāḥ viccha̍ndā̱ yāśca̱ saccha̍ndāḥ sū̱cībhi̍ḥ śamyantu tvā
229.d: द्वि̱प̱दा याश्चतु̍ष्पदास्त्रि̱पदा̱ याश्च̱ षट्प̍दाः विच्छ̍न्दा̱ याश्च̱ सच्छ̍न्दाः सू̱चीभि̍ः शम्यन्तु त्वा
229.m: Those that are two-footed, four-footed, three-footed, and six-footed, / those of diverse metre and of uniform metre—may they appease you with needles.

229.s: ma̱hānā̍mnyo reva̱tyo̱ viśvā̱ āśā̍ḥ pra̱bhūva̍rīḥ maighī̍rvi̱dyuto̱ vāca̍ḥ sū̱cībhi̍ḥ śamyantu tvā
229.d: म̱हाना̍म्न्यो रेव̱त्यो̱ विश्वा̱ आशा̍ः प्र̱भूव̍रीः मैघी̍र्वि̱द्युतो̱ वाच̍ः सू̱चीभि̍ः शम्यन्तु त्वा
229.m: The Mahānāmnī verses, the Revatī verses, all the prevailing regions, / the voices of rain-cloud and lightning—may they appease you with needles.

229.s: nārya̍ste̱ patnyo̱ loma̱ vici̍nvantu manī̱ṣayā̍ de̱vānā̱ṃ patnyo̱ diśa̍ḥ sū̱cībhi̍ḥ śamyantu tvā
229.d: नार्य̍स्ते̱ पत्न्यो̱ लोम̱ विचि̍न्वन्तु मनी̱षया̍ दे̱वाना̱ं पत्न्यो̱ दिश̍ः सू̱चीभि̍ः शम्यन्तु त्वा
229.m: May women, your wives, pick out the hair with insight; / may the directions, wives of the gods, appease you with needles.

229.s: ra̱ja̱tā hari̍ṇīḥ sī̱sā yujo̍ yujyante̱ karma̍bhiḥ aśva̍sya vā̱jina̍stva̱ci simā̍ḥ śamyantu̱ śamya̍ntīḥ
229.d: र̱ज̱ता हरि̍णीः सी̱सा युजो̍ युज्यन्ते̱ कर्म̍भिः अश्व̍स्य वा̱जिन̍स्त्व̱चि सिमा̍ः शम्यन्तु̱ शम्य̍न्तीः
229.m: Silver, golden, and leaden companions are harnessed by ritual acts; / on the skin of the swift horse, may the soothing boundaries appease [it].

229.s: ku̱vida̱ṅga yava̍manto̱ yava̍ṃci̱dyathā̱ dāntya̍nupū̱rvaṃ vi̱yūya̍ i̱hehai̍ṣāṃ kṛṇuhi̱ bhoja̍nāni̱ ye ba̱rhiṣo̱ nama̍ u̱ktiṃ na ja̱gmuḥ
229.d: कु̱विद̱ङ्ग यव̍मन्तो̱ यव̍ंचि̱द्यथा̱ दान्त्य̍नुपू̱र्वं वि̱यूय̍ इ̱हेहै̍षां कृणुहि̱ भोज̍नानि̱ ये ब̱र्हिषो̱ नम̍ उ̱क्तिं न ज̱ग्मुः
229.m: Just as those who have barley reap the barley in due order, separating [the ears], / so prepare food here and now for those who did not go to utter homage to the sacred grass.

230.s: (7) kastvā̍ chyati̱ kastvā̱ viśā̍sti̱ kaste̱ gātrā̍ṇi śamyati | ka u̍ te śami̱tā ka̱viḥ
230.d: (7) कस्त्वा̍ छ्यति̱ कस्त्वा̱ विशा̍स्ति̱ कस्ते̱ गात्रा̍णि शम्यति । क उ̍ ते शमि̱ता क̱विः
230.m: Who cuts you up? Who carves you? Who appeases your limbs? / Who is your wise slaughterer?

230.s: ṛ̱tava̍sta ṛtu̱thā parva̍ śami̱tāro̱ vi śā̍satu sa̱ṃva̱tsa̱rasya̱ teja̍sā śa̱mībhi̍ḥ śamyantu tvā
230.d: ऋ̱तव̍स्त ऋतु̱था पर्व̍ शमि̱तारो̱ वि शा̍सतु स̱ंव̱त्स̱रस्य̱ तेज̍सा श̱मीभि̍ः शम्यन्तु त्वा
230.m: Let the seasons, the slaughterers, carve your joint season by season; / with the splendor of the year, through appeasing rites may they appease you.

230.s: a̱rdha̱mā̱sāḥ parū̍m̐ṣi te̱ māsā̍ ā chyantu̱ śamya̍ntaḥ a̱ho̱rā̱trāṇi̍ ma̱ruto̱ vili̍ṣṭam̐ sūdayantu te
230.d: अ̱र्ध̱मा̱साः परू̍म्̐षि ते̱ मासा̍ आ छ्यन्तु̱ शम्य̍न्तः अ̱हो̱रा̱त्राणि̍ म̱रुतो̱ विलि̍ष्टम्̐ सूदयन्तु ते
230.m: Let the half-months cut your joints, let the months cut [them], appeasing [you]; / let the days and nights and the Maruts make whole what is injured of you.

230.s: daivyā̍ adhva̱ryava̍stvā chyantu̱ vi ca̍ śāsatu gātrā̍ṇi̱ parva̍śaste si̱māḥ kṛ̍ṇvantu̱ śamya̍ntīḥ
230.d: दैव्या̍ अध्व̱र्यव̍स्त्वा छ्यन्तु̱ वि च̍ शासतु गात्रा̍णि̱ पर्व̍शस्ते सि̱माः कृ̍ण्वन्तु̱ शम्य̍न्तीः
230.m: Let the divine Adhvaryus cut you up and carve you; / limb by limb, joint by joint, may the soothing boundaries appease [you].

230.s: dyaustai pṛthi̱vyantarkṣaṃ vā̱yuśchi̱draṃ pṛ̍ṇātu te sūrya̍ste̱ nakṣa̍traiḥ sa̱ha lo̱kaṃ kṛ̍ṇotu sādhu̱yā
230.d: द्यौस्तै पृथि̱व्यन्तर्क्षं वा̱युश्छि̱द्रं पृ̍णातु ते सूर्य̍स्ते̱ नक्ष̍त्रैः स̱ह लो̱कं कृ̍णोतु साधु̱या
230.m: May heaven, earth, mid-air, and Vāyu fill your aperture; / may Sūrya together with the lunar mansions properly prepare a place for you.

230.s: śaṃ te̱ pare̍bhyo̱ gātre̍bhya̱ḥ śama̱stvava̍rebhyaḥ śama̱sthabhyo̍ ma̱jjabhya̱ḥ śamva̍stu ta̱nvai tava̍
230.d: शं ते̱ परे̍भ्यो̱ गात्रे̍भ्य̱ः शम̱स्त्वव̍रेभ्यः शम̱स्थभ्यो̍ म̱ज्जभ्य̱ः शम्व̍स्तु त̱न्वै तव̍
230.m: Well-being to your upper limbs; well-being be to your lower [limbs]; / well-being to your bones and to your marrow; well-being be to your body.

231.s: (8) kaḥ svi̍dekā̱kī ca̍rati̱ ka u̍ svijjāyate̱ puna̍ḥ kim̐ svi̍ddhi̱masya̍ bheṣa̱jaṃ kimvā̱vapa̍naṃ ma̱hat
231.d: (8) कः स्वि̍देका̱की च̍रति̱ क उ̍ स्विज्जायते̱ पुन̍ः किम्̐ स्वि̍द्धि̱मस्य̍ भेष̱जं किम्वा̱वप̍नं म̱हत्
231.m: Who roams alone? And who is born again? / What is the remedy for cold? And what is the great sowing-ground?

231.s: sūrya̍ ekā̱kī ca̍rati ca̱ndramā̍ jāyate̱ puna̍ḥ a̱gnirhi̱masya̍ bheṣa̱jaṃ bhūmi̍rāva̱pa̍naṃ ma̱hat
231.d: सूर्य̍ एका̱की च̍रति च̱न्द्रमा̍ जायते̱ पुन̍ः अ̱ग्निर्हि̱मस्य̍ भेष̱जं भूमि̍राव̱प̍नं म̱हत्
231.m: The sun roams alone, and the moon is born again. / Agni is the remedy for cold; the earth is the great sowing-ground.

231.s: kim̐ svitsūrya̍sa̱maṃ jyota̍iḥ kim̐ sa̍mu̱drasa̍mam̐ sara̍ḥ kim̐ svi̍tpṛthi̱vyai varṣī̍ya̱ḥ kasya̱ mātrā̍ na vi̍dyate
231.d: किम्̐ स्वित्सूर्य̍स̱मं ज्योत̍इः किम्̐ स̍मु̱द्रस̍मम्̐ सर̍ः किम्̐ स्वि̍त्पृथि̱व्यै वर्षी̍य̱ः कस्य̱ मात्रा̍ न वि̍द्यते
231.m: What light is equal to the sun? What lake is equal to the ocean? / What is higher than the earth? And of what is no measure found?

231.s: brahma̱ sūrya̍sa̱maṃ jyota̍i̱dyauḥ sa̍mu̱drasa̍mam̐ sara̍ḥ indra̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyai varṣī̍yā̱n gostu mātrā̍ na vi̍dyate
231.d: ब्रह्म̱ सूर्य̍स̱मं ज्योत̍इ̱द्यौः स̍मु̱द्रस̍मम्̐ सर̍ः इन्द्र̍ः पृथि̱व्यै वर्षी̍या̱न् गोस्तु मात्रा̍ न वि̍द्यते
231.m: Brahman is the light equal to the sun; heaven is the lake equal to the ocean; / Indra is higher than the earth; but of the cow no measure is found.

231.s: pṛ̱cchāmi̍ tvā cita̱ye̍ devasakha̱ yadi̱ tvamatra̱ mana̍sā ja̱gantha̍ yeṣu̱ viṣṇu̍stri̱ṣu pa̱deṣveṣṭa̱steṣu̱ viśva̱ṃ bhuva̍na̱mā vi̍veśa3
231.d: पृ̱च्छामि̍ त्वा चित̱ये̍ देवसख̱ यदि̱ त्वमत्र̱ मन̍सा ज̱गन्थ̍ येषु̱ विष्णु̍स्त्रि̱षु प̱देष्वेष्ट̱स्तेषु̱ विश्व̱ं भुव̍न̱मा वि̍वेश3
231.m: I ask you, friend of the gods, for the sake of discernment, if you have arrived here in mind: / in which three strides where Viṣṇu is sought did all the world enter?

231.s: api̱ teṣu̍ tri̱ṣu pa̱deṣva̍smi̱ yeṣu̱ viśva̱ṃ bhuva̍na̱mā vi̱veśa̍ sa̱dyaḥ paryai̍mi pṛthi̱vīmu̱ta dyāmeke̱nāṅge̍na di̱vo a̱sya pṛ̱ṣṭham
231.d: अपि̱ तेषु̍ त्रि̱षु प̱देष्व̍स्मि̱ येषु̱ विश्व̱ं भुव̍न̱मा वि̱वेश̍ स̱द्यः पर्यै̍मि पृथि̱वीमु̱त द्यामेके̱नाङ्गे̍न दि̱वो अ̱स्य पृ̱ष्ठम्
231.m: I am in those three strides in which all the world entered; / today I encompass earth and heaven, and with one limb the back of this sky.

231.s: keṣva̱ntaḥ puru̍ṣa̱ ā vi̍veśa̱ kānya̱ntaḥ puru̍ṣe arpi̍tāni e̱tad bra̍hma̱nnupa̍ valgāmasi tvā̱ kim̐ svi̍nna̱ḥ prati̍ vocā̱syatra̍
231.d: केष्व̱न्तः पुरु̍ष̱ आ वि̍वेश̱ कान्य̱न्तः पुरु̍षे अर्पि̍तानि ए̱तद् ब्र̍ह्म̱न्नुप̍ वल्गामसि त्वा̱ किम्̐ स्वि̍न्न̱ः प्रति̍ वोचा̱स्यत्र̍
231.m: Into what did the Person enter? What are fixed inside the Person? / This, O Brahman, we riddle to you; what will you answer us here?

231.s: pa̱ñcasva̱ntaḥ puru̍ṣa̱ ā vi̍veśa̱ tānya̱ntaḥ puru̍ṣe arpi̍tāni e̱tattvātra̍ pratimanvā̱no a̍smi̱ na mā̱yayā̍ bhava̱syutta̍ro̱ mat
231.d: प̱ञ्चस्व̱न्तः पुरु̍ष̱ आ वि̍वेश̱ तान्य̱न्तः पुरु̍षे अर्पि̍तानि ए̱तत्त्वात्र̍ प्रतिमन्वा̱नो अ̍स्मि̱ न मा̱यया̍ भव̱स्युत्त̍रो̱ मत्
231.m: Into the five did the Person enter; they are fixed inside the Person. / Reflecting on this in return to you here, you will not be superior to me in magical skill.

232.s: (9) kā svi̍dāsītpūrvaci̍tti̱ḥ kim̐ svi̍dāsīd bṛhadvaya̍ḥ kā svi̍dāsītpilippi̱lā kā svi̍dāsītpiśaṅgi̱lā
232.d: (9) का स्वि̍दासीत्पूर्वचि̍त्ति̱ः किम्̐ स्वि̍दासीद् बृहद्वय̍ः का स्वि̍दासीत्पिलिप्पि̱ला का स्वि̍दासीत्पिशङ्गि̱ला
232.m: What was the first conception? What was the great bird? / What was the smooth one? What was the tawny one?
Heaven was the first conception; the horse was the great bird; / the sheep was the smooth one; the night was the tawny one.

232.s: kā ī̍ṃmare piśaṅgi̱lā kā ī̍ṃ kuru piśaṅgi̱lā ka ī̱ṃmā skanda̍marṣati̱ ka ī̱ṃ panthā̱ṃ vi sa̍rpati
232.d: का ई̍ंमरे पिशङ्गि̱ला का ई̍ं कुरु पिशङ्गि̱ला क ई̱ंमा स्कन्द̍मर्षति̱ क ई̱ं पन्था̱ं वि स̍र्पति
232.m: Who is the tawny one over yonder? Who is the tawny one in Kuru? / Who rushes along leaping? Who glides along the path?

232.s: a̱jārai̍ piśa̱ṅgilā śvāvi̱tkuru̍ piśa̱ṅgilā śa̱śa āska̱ndama̍rṣa̱tyahi̱ḥ panthā̱ṃ vi sa̍rpati
232.d: अ̱जारै̍ पिश̱ङ्गिला श्वावि̱त्कुरु̍ पिश̱ङ्गिला श̱श आस्क̱न्दम̍र्ष̱त्यहि̱ः पन्था̱ं वि स̍र्पति
232.m: The she-goat is the tawny one over yonder; the porcupine is the tawny one in Kuru; / the hare rushes along leaping; the serpent glides along the path.

232.s: katya̍sya vi̱ṣṭhāḥ katya̱kṣarā̍ṇi̱ kati̱ homā̍saḥ kati̱dhā sami̍ddhaḥ ya̱jñasya̍ tvā vi̱dathā̍ pṛccha̱matra̱ kati̱ hotā̍ra ṛtu̱śo ya̍janti
232.d: कत्य̍स्य वि̱ष्ठाः कत्य̱क्षरा̍णि̱ कति̱ होमा̍सः कति̱धा समि̍द्धः य̱ज्ञस्य̍ त्वा वि̱दथा̍ पृच्छ̱मत्र̱ कति̱ होता̍र ऋतु̱शो य̍जन्ति
232.m: How many are its resting-places? How many its syllables? How many its oblations? In how many ways is it kindled? / We ask you here of the ordinances of the sacrifice: how many Hotṛs sacrifice in season?

232.s: ṣaḷa̍sya vi̱ṣṭhāḥ śa̱tama̱kṣarā̍ṇyaśī̱tirhomā̍ḥ sa̱midho̍ ha ti̱sraḥ ya̱jñasya̍ te vi̱dathā̱ pra bra̍vīmi sa̱pta hotā̍ra ṛtu̱śo ya̍janti
232.d: षऌअ̍स्य वि̱ष्ठाः श̱तम̱क्षरा̍ण्यशी̱तिर्होमा̍ः स̱मिधो̍ ह ति̱स्रः य̱ज्ञस्य̍ ते वि̱दथा̱ प्र ब्र̍वीमि स̱प्त होता̍र ऋतु̱शो य̍जन्ति
232.m: Six are its resting-places, a hundred its syllables, eighty its oblations, and three its kindling-sticks. / I proclaim to you the ordinances of the sacrifice: seven Hotṛs sacrifice in season.

232.s: ko a̱sya ve̍da̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ nābhi̱ṃ ko dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī a̱ntari̍kṣam kaḥ sūrya̍sya veda bṛha̱to ja̱nitra̱ṃ ko ve̍da ca̱ndrama̍saṃ yato̱jāḥ
232.d: को अ̱स्य वे̍द̱ भुव̍नस्य̱ नाभि̱ं को द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी अ̱न्तरि̍क्षम् कः सूर्य̍स्य वेद बृह̱तो ज̱नित्र̱ं को वे̍द च̱न्द्रम̍सं यतो̱जाः
232.m: Who knows the navel of this world? Who [knows] heaven and earth and mid-air? / Who knows the birthplace of the mighty sun? Who knows whence the moon was born?

232.s: vedā̱hamasya̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ nābhi̱ṃ veda̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī a̱ntari̍kṣam veda̱ sūrya̍sya bṛha̱to ja̱nitra̱matho̍ veda ca̱ndrama̍saṃ yato̱jāḥ
232.d: वेदा̱हमस्य̱ भुव̍नस्य̱ नाभि̱ं वेद̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी अ̱न्तरि̍क्षम् वेद̱ सूर्य̍स्य बृह̱तो ज̱नित्र̱मथो̍ वेद च̱न्द्रम̍सं यतो̱जाः
232.m: I know the navel of this world; I know heaven and earth and mid-air; / I know the birthplace of the mighty sun, and I know whence the moon was born.

232.s: pṛ̱cchāmi̍ tvā̱ paramanta̍ṃ pṛthi̱vyāḥ pṛ̱cchāmi̱ yatra̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ nābhi̍ḥ pṛ̱cchāmi̍ tvā̱ vṛṣṇo̱ aśva̍sya̱ reta̍ḥ pṛ̱cchāmi̍ vā̱caḥ pa̍ra̱maṃ vyo̍ma
232.d: पृ̱च्छामि̍ त्वा̱ परमन्त̍ं पृथि̱व्याः पृ̱च्छामि̱ यत्र̱ भुव̍नस्य̱ नाभि̍ः पृ̱च्छामि̍ त्वा̱ वृष्णो̱ अश्व̍स्य̱ रेत̍ः पृ̱च्छामि̍ वा̱चः प̍र̱मं व्यो̍म
232.m:
I ask you about the furthest limit of the earth; I ask where is the navel of the world;
I ask you about the seed of the vigorous stallion; I ask about the highest heaven of speech.

232.s: i̱yaṃ vedi̱ḥ paro̱ anta̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyā a̱yaṃ ya̱jño bhuva̍nasya̱ nābhi̍ḥ a̱yam̐ somo̱ vṛṣṇo̱ aśva̍sya̱ reto̍ bra̱hmāyaṃ vā̱caḥ pa̍ra̱maṃ vyo̍ma
232.d: इ̱यं वेदि̱ः परो̱ अन्त̍ः पृथि̱व्या अ̱यं य̱ज्ञो भुव̍नस्य̱ नाभि̍ः अ̱यम्̐ सोमो̱ वृष्णो̱ अश्व̍स्य̱ रेतो̍ ब्र̱ह्मायं वा̱चः प̍र̱मं व्यो̍म
232.m:
This altar is the furthest limit of the earth; this sacrifice is the navel of the world;
This soma is the seed of the vigorous stallion; this brahman is the highest heaven of speech.

232.s: su̱bhūḥ sva̍ya̱mbhūḥ pra̍tha̱mo'ntarma̍ha̱tya̍rṇa̱ve da̱dhe ha̱ garbha̍mṛ̱tviya̱ṃ yato̍ jā̱taḥ pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ
232.d: सु̱भूः स्व̍य̱म्भूः प्र̍थ̱मोऽन्तर्म̍ह̱त्य̍र्ण̱वे द̱धे ह̱ गर्भ̍मृ̱त्विय̱ं यतो̍ जा̱तः प्र̱जाप̍तिः
232.m:
Fair-born, self-existent, the first within the great ocean,
He placed indeed the timely embryo from which Prajāpati was born.

232.s: hotā̍ yakṣatpra̱jāpa̍tim̐ so̱masya̍ mahi̱mnaḥ juṣa̱tāṃ piba̍tu so̱mam̐ hota̱ryaja̍
232.d: होता̍ यक्षत्प्र̱जाप̍तिम्̐ सो̱मस्य̍ महि̱म्नः जुष̱तां पिब̍तु सो̱मम्̐ होत̱र्यज̍
232.m:
Let the Hotṛ priest sacrifice to Prajāpati from the greatness of Soma.
Let him enjoy; let him drink the soma! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

232.s: prajā̍pate̱ na tvade̱tānya̱nyo viśvā̍ rū̱pāṇi̱ pari̱ tā ba̍bhūva yatkā̍māste juhu̱mastanno̍ astu va̱yam̐ syā̍ma̱ pata̍yo rayī̱ṇām
232.d: प्रजा̍पते̱ न त्वदे̱तान्य̱न्यो विश्वा̍ रू̱पाणि̱ परि̱ ता ब̍भूव यत्का̍मास्ते जुहु̱मस्तन्नो̍ अस्तु व̱यम्̐ स्या̍म̱ पत̍यो रयी̱णाम्
232.m:
O Prajāpati, none other than you has encompassed all these forms.
That with desire of which we offer to you, let that be ours; may we be masters of riches.

232.s:
(10)
hiraṇyagarbho dve
yaḥ prāṇato dve
yuñjanti nava
vāyuṣṭvā ṣaṭ
prāṇāya tisraḥ
utsakthyā dvādaśa
gāyatrī ṣaṭ
katsyā ṣaṭ
kaḥ sviddaṣṭa
kā svit trayodaśa
daśānuvākeṣu saptaṣaṣṭiḥ
232.d:
(10)
हिरण्यगर्भो द्वे
यः प्राणतो द्वे
युञ्जन्ति नव
वायुष्ट्वा षट्
प्राणाय तिस्रः
उत्सक्थ्या द्वादश
गायत्री षट्
कत्स्या षट्
कः स्विद्दष्ट
का स्वित् त्रयोदश
दशानुवाकेषु सप्तषष्टिः
